articleTitle: Highly polarization-dependent periodic mechanical mode coupling in air-silica fibers
abstract: We report highly polarization-dependent mode coupling in hexagonal and circular air-silica microstructured fibers under periodic mechanical gratings. Coupling changes in terms of micro-structure spatial symmetry are investigated for PDL compensation.

articleTitle: Raman-tweezers sensing: fast detection and discrimination of bacterial spores and vegetative cells
abstract: Raman-tweezers spectroscopy has been used for the rapid detection of dipicolinic acid (DPA) of single bacterial spores and reagentless discrimination of different species of bacterial cells with principal component analysis and cluster analysis.

articleTitle: IIIinitride ultraviolet micro- and nano-photonics
abstract: This paper provides a brief overview on recent advances in the ultraviolet (UV) photonic materials and devices based upon III-nitrides and the exploitation of chip- level innovation, such as the incorporation of micro- and nano-scale photonic device integration and photonic crystals (PCs), to enhance the extraction efficiency of UV light emitting diodes (LEDs). By inserting a high quality AlN epilayer that serves as a template for the subsequent growth of AlGaN alloys and adopting delta-doping scheme, we have greatly reduced the dislocation density and thereby enhanced the doping efficiency. By incorporating AlN and highly conductive n-AlGaN into the actual device structure, we have significantly improved the performance of deep UV LEDs (/spl lambda/<300 nm). It was shown that III-nitride PCs provide 3 times enhancement in output power and 4 times enhancement in modulation speed in UV LEDs. The demonstration of photonic band-gap (PBG) materials active in the UV and visible wavelengths opens many new applications.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave and mode-locked laser operation of epitaxially grown Yb:KLu(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ composites
abstract: Epitaxial layers of Yb:KLu(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ were grown on KLu(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ substrates and highly efficient cw (66% slope efficiency and 415 mW output power) and passively mode-locked (114 fs pulse duration) operation at 1030 nm is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Efficient optical parametric chirped pulse amplification at 1 kHz using periodically poled stoichiometric LiTaO/sub 3/
abstract: We demonstrate all-diode-pumped optical parametric chirped pulse amplification at 1-kHz repetition rate in periodically poled 1% MgO-doped stoichiometric LiTaO/sub 3/ achieving /spl ap/63 dB single pass gain and 315 fs long pulses at 1.57 /spl mu/m after recompression.

articleTitle: Semiconductor laser pumping of a continuous-wave Pr/sup 3+/:LiYF/sub 4/ laser emitting at several wavelengths
abstract: We report continuous-wave laser operation of Pr/sup 3+/:LiYF/sub 4/ at 639.7 nm, 607.3 nm, and 522.6 nm using a frequency-doubled optically pumped semiconductor laser as pump source. Furthermore, a red continuous-wave Pr/sup 3+/:LiYF/sub 4/ laser was realized under GaN laser diode pumping.

articleTitle: Room temperature intersubband electroluminescence near 3 /spl mu/m from InAs/AlSb quantum cascade structures
abstract: Intersubband electroluminescence from InAs/AlSb quantum cascade structures has been obtained between 2.8 and 3.2 mum up to room temperature with full widths at half maximum of the emission spectra less than 30 meV at 90 K

articleTitle: Amplification in a bismuth-doped silica glass at second telecommunication windows
abstract: We have demonstrated an amplification phenomenon in a bismuth-doped silica glass at 1300 nm with 800 nm excitation and discussed its potential application in optical communication, which may be increased further through its use as core-fiber material.

articleTitle: Variable group delay using a novel integrated optoelectronic filter
abstract: We present both time and frequency domain measurements of current-controlled optical group delay using a novel multi-cavity optoelectronic filter. The measurements demonstrate variable delay of optical signals with a 5 GHz sinusoidal modulation

articleTitle: Phase-imaging digital holographic movies of animal cells
abstract: Multi-wavelength phase imaging digital holography is applied in acquiring holographic movies of animal microbes. Two or three lasers of different wavelengths are used to generate movies of phase maps without 2 pi discontinuities.

articleTitle: Broadband-response and frequency-tunable terahertz photonic transmitters with high efficiency
abstract: We demonstrate broadband-response terahertz photonic transmitters with an ultrawide frequency tuning range. Combining with coherently controlled quasi-continuous-wave optical excitation, these devices exhibit record-high light-terahertz external quantum efficiency (>290%).

articleTitle: High power ytterbium disk laser
abstract: A novel diode-pumped disk laser yielded 490 W in a quasi-cw mode. Electrical efficiency of the laser was found to be 9.4%. Heating of the laser disk was only 2.7% of the absorbed optical power.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effects of lattice irregularity in photonic crystal fibers
abstract: Fabrication induced lattice imperfections in photonic crystal fibers are shown through numerical simulations to significantly change the coupling length of a two-core structure while confinement loss and dispersion of a typical fiber are more robust.

articleTitle: Thermally-edge-controlled slab laser for inertial fusion energy and applications
abstract: A 1053-nm thermally-edge-controlled slab laser pumped by 800 kW peak power from 8,000 diode bars has been designed for the HALNA project. 20 J pulse energy in 10 ns at 10 Hz is being demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhancement of FDOCT imaging range by sub-pixel spectral shifting
abstract: Spectral shifting increases the axial image range of Fourier domain optical coherence tomography. Second measurement of the spectral interference after shifting by one-half pixel doubles the imaging range and increases the signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: 14-nJ pulses from a femtosecond Yb fiber laser
abstract: Chirped pulses with energies up to 14 nJ are generated by Yb fiber oscillators. These are dechirped to /spl sim/100 fs duration. The pulse energy and peak power are the highest produced by short-pulse fiber oscillators.

articleTitle: Excitation of non-degenerate resonances through breaking of mirror symmetry in photonic crystal slabs
abstract: Non-degenerate resonances in a photonic crystal slab that are uncoupled in a symmetric structure are excited in a mirror symmetry lacking structure. The coupling to these resonances is controlled by the degree of asymmetry.

articleTitle: Dimensional scaling of nonlinear optical absorption in silicon waveguides
abstract: A model describing dimensional scaling of carrier lifetime and hence nonlinear optical absorption is presented. It is shown that nonlinear absorption, at a given optical intensity, can be mitigated with proper design of waveguide dimensions

articleTitle: All-fiber single-mode hollow-core gas cells for stimulated raman scattering and laser frequency stabilization
abstract: Gas-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber (HC-PCF) is hermetically spliced to standard single-mode fiber with low insertion-loss. A hydrogen-filled HC-PCF based quasi-CW Raman converter and an acetylene-filled HC-PCF based frequency stabilization system are reported

articleTitle: Routes to all-fiber format femtosecond compression in microstructured fibers around 1/spl mu/m
abstract: We demonstrate approaches to all-fibre pulse compression of ps Yb-fibre lasers by using solid and air-core microstructured fibers. Pulse durations of 100 fs, tunability from 1113-1220 nm and peak powers of up to 60 kW are obtained.

articleTitle: Precise cavity length control in fiber optic extrinsic Fabry-Perot interferometers
abstract: A technique to precisely control the cavity length in fiber optic extrinsic Fabry-Perot interferometric structures by CO/sub 2/ laser is described. The white light monitored laser bonding system can achieve a 3 nm cavity control resolution.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical harmonic oscillator results in frequency conversion
abstract: A resonance phenomenon for nonlinear frequency conversion in a directional coupler can be explained by a driven harmonic-oscillator model. We present this model and extend it to obtain the conditions necessary for efficient third-harmonic generation.

articleTitle: The optical equivalent to a microwave frequency synthesizer
abstract: We present an arbitrary optical single-frequency generator based on a femtosecond optical frequency comb. The absolute frequency accuracy is around 1 kHz at 282 THz, the stability is 2/spl middot/10/sup -14/ at 100 s and the tuning speed exceeds 30 GHz/s.

articleTitle: Space-variant polarization manipulation for polarimetric measurement by use of subwavelength gratings
abstract: We present two unique methods for real-time polarization measurement. These methods are based on measurement and analysis of either the near-field or the far-field of a beam emerging from a discrete space-variant subwavelength dielectric gratings.

articleTitle: The transport of photoexcited electrons in photoconductive THz sources with spatially patterned excitation
abstract: We studied the transport properties of photoexcited electrons in an electrically biased photoconductor with different spatially patterned excitations using spatially resolve Monte Carlo simulations coupled with a self-consistent Poisson solver.

articleTitle: Passive stabilization technique applied to continuous-wave picosecond mode-locked Yb:YAG and Nd:BaY/sub 2/F/sub 8/ lasers
abstract: We present new experimental results of a nonlinear optical technique recently introduced for the stabilization of passive mode-locking in continuous-wave (cw) diode-pumped rare-earth doped lasers.

articleTitle: Adiabatic mode transitions in photonic crystal fiber tapers
abstract: We report on experimental measurements of fundamental mode cutoff in photonic crystal fiber (PCF) tapers. The results are compared with theory, with implications on the adiabaticity of PCF tapers.

articleTitle: Efficient quantum-well pumping of semiconductor disk lasers at 920 nm
abstract: We report on semiconductor disk lasers at 920 nm with optical pumping of the quantum wells at 308 nm. 5 W cw output power with good beam quality and an optical-to-optical conversion efficiency of 39% have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: An optimized Er all-fiber chirped pulse amplification system producing 570-fs, 310-nJ pulses
abstract: We report an all-fiber CPA system based on pulse stretching in dispersion-engineered FBG and compression in photonic band gap fiber (PBGF). We analyze the design trade-offs and estimate pulse energy limit due to PBGF nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Efficient room temperature cw laser oscillation of crystalline Yb:Sc/sub 2/O/sub 3/ at 1041.6 and 1094.6 nm
abstract: Extremely high pump (62.2%) and slope (72.7%) efficiencies are obtained with a cw Yb:Sc/sub 2/O/sub 3/ crystal laser operating at 1041.6 and 1094.6 nm and delivering maximum powers of 1.55 and 1.35 W, respectively, without special cooling.

articleTitle: Optical regenerative amplifier based on amplification of femtosecond chirped laser pulse
abstract: A regenerative amplifier based on parametric amplification of a chirped femtosecond signal pulse and pumped by a nanosecond frequency doubled Q-switched Nd :YAG laser is demonstrated. The amplified signal pulses are bandwidth limited.

articleTitle: Efficient sum-frequency generation with quasi-intracavity configuration
abstract: Quasi-intracavity sum-frequency-generation was demonstrated. Output power at 589 nm reached to 1 W mixing 1064 and 1319 nm of cw Nd:YAG lasers. The output power was ten times higher than that by extracavity sum-frequency-generation.

articleTitle: Compression of femtosecond pulses in the ultraviolet by an impulsively excited rotational wavepacket in nitrogen
abstract: Pulse shortening by impulsive high-order stimulated Raman scattering is experimentally demonstrated in the deep ultraviolet for the first time. A single probe pulse at 266 nm is shortened down to 23 fs in N/sub 2/.

articleTitle: Imaging intact tissue microstructures using a multimodal, high-resolution microscope
abstract: We describe a custom microscope which utilizes autofluorescence and light scattering to interrogate whole tissue specimens. Preliminary studies using human and animal tissues demonstrate the feasibility of this approach for real-time imaging of tissue microstructures.

articleTitle: Rayleigh-Mie lidar for accurate temperature profiling of the troposphere
abstract: A Rayleigh-Mie scattering lidar system has been developed for temperature profiling of the troposphere using a new multi-cavity Fabry-Perot filter at 355 nm wavelength. The temperature error less than 1 K was obtained at 3.0 km altitude with a compact system.

articleTitle: A widely tunable 1.3-/spl mu/m, high repetition rate picosecond pulse source and frequency up-conversion to the red
abstract: A compact 1284-1330-nm, 20-GHz, 9-ps fiber ring laser based on a semiconductor amplifier and a Mach-Zehnder amplitude modulator is realized. Following Raman amplification, second-harmonic generation to the red was achieved in a PPKTP waveguide.

articleTitle: Environmentally-stable femtosecond ytterbium fiber laser with birefringent photonic bandgap fiber
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time an environmentally-stable, passively mode-locked ytterbium fiber laser with a birefringent hollow-core fiber for polarization and dispersion control. The laser generates 1-nJ pulses, which are dechirped to 70 fs.

articleTitle: Terahertz pigtail using lens duct to facilitate launching of terahertz radiation into plastic photonic crystal fiber waveguide
abstract: THz pigtail using lens duct is designed to facilitate launching THz radiation into a plastic photonic crystal fiber waveguide. It is found that the spectral width of the THz pigtail extends up to 1 THz.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked Yb:KLu(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ laser
abstract: We report the shortest pulses (81 fs) ever produced with an Yb-doped tungstate laser using a semiconductor saturable absorber by passive mode-locking of monoclinic Yb:KLu(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ achieving an average power of 70 m W at 1046 nm.

articleTitle: Spatial-polarization state scrambling for image encryption obtained with subwavelength gratings
abstract: We present an optical encryption/decryption methods based on geometrical phase produced by space-variant polarization manipulation. The elements are formed by use of computer-generated space-variant subwavelength dielectric gratings.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulse generation using fast intersubband saturable absorbers in semiconductor modelocked lasers
abstract: A novel scheme is proposed for generating highly stable sub-70 fs pulses in semiconductor modelocked lasers at near-IR wavelengths (1.1-1.6 /spl mu/m) with pulse energies up to 10 pJ using fast intersubband saturable absorbers.

articleTitle: 50-kW, 100-fs pulse generation by large-mode-area erbium-ytterbium-doped photonic-crystal fiber amplifier
abstract: A high-energy femtosecond fiber amplifier using a large-mode-area single-mode erbium-ytterbium-codoped photonic-crystal fiber is presented. 700-fs pulses at 1557 nm were amplified and compressed to near-transform-limited 100-fs, 7.4-nJ pulses with >50-kW peak powers without chirped-pulse amplification.

articleTitle: Design of adiabatic matching stages for efficient light coupling to propagating modes of photonic crystals
abstract: We propose a general, robust, and easy-to-implement scheme to design adiabatic buffer stages to couple light into and out of arbitrary photonic crystal (PC) structures. This buffer layer can be used as an intermediate layer to reduce the reflection for coupling the incident beam to PCs, extracting the light from PCs, or coupling light from one PC to another PC. The design is based on gradually changing the structure from the incident region to the PC in order to minimize the reflection due to modal mismatch. The results are compared with those with no matching stage used, and show considerable reflection reduction in a broad range of frequencies. We show that the resulting adiabatic design is insensitive to the frequency and angle of incident light, and is therefore superior to other schemes proposed to date that are designed for a specific incident angle and frequency.

articleTitle: High efficiency continuous-wave Holey-fiber Raman laser
abstract: A linear-cavity totally-fiber-integrated continuous-wave holey-fiber Raman laser, with short, 100 m, length of holey-fiber as the gain medium, is reported. Slope efficiencies of up to 77%, thresholds of 2.7 W and output powers of 3.6 W are achieved

articleTitle: Bending-insensitive single-mode hole-assisted fibers with reduced splice loss
abstract: We propose a novel type of bending-insensitive single-mode hole-assisted fiber with a mode field diameter of 9.3 mum and a bending loss of 0.011 dB/turn at 1.55 mum for bending diameter of 10 mm

articleTitle: Generation and propagation of surface plasmon polaritons in periodic metallic structures using fs-THz pulses
abstract: The generation of surface plasmon polaritons in periodic metallic structures is investigated theoretically and experimentally. The surface plasmon polaritons are excited with fs THz-pulses in different periodic metallic structures and propagation and resonance effects are observed.

articleTitle: Spectral line-by-line pulse shaping
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate spectral line-by-line pulse shaping. The shaped pulses overlap in time, which leads to observation of a new time-dependent noise process directly linked to variations in the comb-offset frequency.

articleTitle: Gated heterodyne coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering with phase-locked tunable femtosecond pulses
abstract: We propose and demonstrate heterodyne CARS chemical imaging as a novel application of phase-coherent femtosecond supercontinua. With proper timing of three phase-locked pulses this technique achieves efficient background suppression.

articleTitle: Evolution of terahertz radiation spectrum stimulated by emergence of magneto-plasma effect on various InAs surfaces under the Voigt configuration
abstract: Magnetically induced evolution of terahertz (THz) radiation spectrum from various InAs wafers under the Voigt configuration is investigated. It is found that peak shifting of THz-radiation spectrum toward lower frequency is due to magneto-plasma effect.

articleTitle: Practical visible broadband generation in PCF using a frequency doubled 770 nm fiber laser pump
abstract: We report on 430 to 1450 nm broadband generation by pumping highly nonlinear PCF with 420 mW average power frequency doubled pulses from a 20 kW peak-power, all fiber integrated Yb-Er 1 ps pulse source.

articleTitle: Raman spectroscopy of niobium-phosphate glasses with large bandwidth for Raman gain applications
abstract: Spontaneous Raman spectra of binary niobium-phosphate glasses with large gain bandwidth (>1000 cm/sup -1/) are measured down to low wavenumbers. Correlations of enhanced low frequency scattering with molecular structure and medium range order are investigated.

articleTitle: Efficient waveguide amplifier and laser operating in the C-band directly fabricated by using ultrafast laser pulses
abstract: We demonstrated for the first time effective net amplification and laser action in the full C-band (1530-1565 nm) by using a 20-mm-long waveguide fabricated on a erbium-ytterbium-doped phosphate glass by means of femtosecond laser pulses.

articleTitle: Monolithic device for carrier-envelope phase stabilization
abstract: A new scheme for stabilizing the carrier-envelope phase (CEP) of a few-cycle laser pulse train is demonstrated. Self-phase modulation and difference-frequency generation in a single periodically-poled crystal allows CEP locking directly in the usable output.

articleTitle: Development and application of an injection-seeded, nano-second, pulsed, optical parametric oscillator (OPO) for high resolution spectroscopy
abstract: Development and characterization of a nanosecond pulse-length, injection-seeded, single-mode, optical parametric oscillator system is discussed. High resolution measurements of nitric oxide performed using single and two-photon laser induced fluorescence spectroscopy are presented.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband self-phase-stabilized pulses by difference frequency generation
abstract: Ultrabroadband near-infrared (800-1700 nm) pulses are obtained by type-II difference-frequency generation between two synchronized non-collinear optical parametric amplifiers. Self-stabilization of the carrier-envelope offset phase, as expected from the difference frequency process, is demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Modeling and optimization of multimode microstructure optical fibers
abstract: Microstructure optical fibers have potential advantages for many applications including multimode transmission. Perturbative modeling methods are extended to optimization of group-velocity. Velocity-matched multimode microstructure fibers with extremely high index contrast are presented.

articleTitle: Spectral compression of ultrafast pulses using transiently aligned molecules
abstract: We demonstrate temporal phase modulation of an ultrafast pulse by a time-dependent refractive index of transiently aligned anisotropic gas molecules. This allows for the generation of transform limited pulses that are tunable in duration.

articleTitle: Towards noise robustness in optimal quantum control experiments
abstract: Optimal control operates in the presence of noise. Enhancement of the signal to noise ratio through optimized control is demonstrated for two condensed phase systems: the concept was demonstrated for second harmonic generation (SHG) in a nonlinear optical crystal and stimulated emission pumping (SEP) in a dye solution. Management of inherent control noise in the manipulation of quantum system is a subject of basic concern in virtually all applications of manipulating quantum dynamics phenomena. The cases of SHG and SEP in this work serve as illustrations of this capability. For control lasers operating at a kHz repetition rate, readily available electronics can handle this data stream.

articleTitle: Active and adaptive optics in confocal microscopy
Programmably repetition tunable low pedestal femtosecond pulse train generation using comb-like profiled fiber
abstract: We demonstrated programmably repetition tunability from 5 MHz to 500 MHz on low pedestal 300 fs pulse train generation through the compression of gain-switched laser diode pulse by comb-like profiled fiber with normal-dispersion Er doped fiber.

articleTitle: 2D photonic crystal four-port directional coupler
abstract: We have fabricated and measured a four-port coupled channel-guide device using W1 channel-waveguides oriented along-/spl Gamma/K directions in a two-dimensional (2D) hole-based planar photonic-crystal fabricated in silicon-on-insulator (SOI) material, with operation at wavelengths around 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Internal loss as a limiting factor for the maximum power of a quantum dot laser
abstract: The free-carrier-density dependent internal loss is shown to strongly limit the output power of a quantum dot laser. The maximum optical power is calculated as a decreasing function of the internal absorption loss cross section.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive fluorescence detection from optimized liquid-core ARROW waveguides
abstract: We report loss improvement and fluorescence detection of integrated liquid-core optical ARROW waveguides. Waveguide loss is reduced to 0.33/cm and fluorescence from as low as 500 molecules with collection efficiencies up to 15.6% was detected.

articleTitle: Compression of megawatt optical pulses in a Xe-filled hollow-core photonic band-gap fiber
abstract: We used a hollow-core photonic band-gap fiber filled with Xe to perform soliton-compression and to generate higher-order solitons. We find that the large third-order dispersion limits the optimal compression ratio.

articleTitle: Why is the room temperature optical differential gain of zero, one and two dimensional semiconductor lasers nearly identical
abstract: We model the differential gain in nano-structure semiconductor lasers. Quantum dots, wires and wells are compared and are found to have nearly the same room temperature differential gain.

articleTitle: Optical labeling system using FSK for label encoding and PPM for payload modulation
abstract: We demonstrate an optical labeling system using frequency-shift-keying (FSK) for label encoding and pulse-position-modulation (PPM) for payload modulation. The scheme relieves the extinction-ratio impairment in systems using FSK for labeling and on-off-keying for payload modulation.

articleTitle: Measurement of co- and cross-polarized Raman spectra in silica fiber for small detunings
abstract: We report measurement of co- and cross-polarized Raman spectra of standard dispersion-shifted fiber for detunings down to 0.17 THz (5.7 cm/sup -1/) on both Stokes and anti-Stokes sides by using a photon-counting technique.

articleTitle: Engineering intersubband nonlinearities in GaN/AlGaN coupled quantum wells for optimised performance in wide bandwidth applications
abstract: We investigate nonlinear optical properties of coupled GaN/AlGaN quantum wells and show that one can engineer the response time and nonlinear phase shift within wide limits and thus achieve optimised performance for a given symbol rate.

articleTitle: Electro-optical control of the directional switching based on degenerate state splitting in photonic crystal
abstract: We study degenerate defect state splitting inside two-dimensional photonic crystal. Using group-theory analysis we determined perturbation potentials that split the degeneracy most efficiently. Application of the effect in optical switch waveguide devices is presented.

articleTitle: Fabrication of periodically poled stoichiometric lithium tantalate
abstract: Periodical poling process in stoichiometric lithium tantalate is described. Appropriate poling parameters allow high uniformity of domain structures along the length and the depth, leading to high efficiency and extended effective aperture

articleTitle: Measurement of record-low residual jitter in 40-GHz monolithic mode-locked lasers
abstract: We have performed residual phase-noise measurements on 40-GHz mode-locked lasers. The intrinsic jitter of lasers with 1, 2 and 3 QWs is compared and a minimum of 39 fs is found for the 1-QW device.

articleTitle: White light supercontinuum optical tweezer
abstract: White light optical tweezer by using the supercontinuum generated from photonic crystal fiber is described. Optical scattering spectra of single 3D-trapped particle are measured which can be potentially used to simultaneously characterize the trapped particle.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the self-starting stochastic behavior of passive mode-locking
abstract: We present an experimental study of the self-starting probabilistic behavior of passively mode-locked lasers.

articleTitle: Pulse retiming using cross-phase modulation by orthogonal polarized pulses in an anomalous-dispersion polarization-maintaining fiber
abstract: We demonstrate retiming of pulses by orthogonal-polarized control pulses co-propagating in an anomalous-dispersion polarization-maintaining fiber. Through walk-off free cross-phase modulation in 500-m long fiber, 2.2-ps pulses at 10-GHz-rate are retime by as much as /spl plusmn/2 ps.

articleTitle: Stokes amplification regimes in rotational SRS in hydrogen gas filled hollow-core PCF pumped with quasi-cw pulses
abstract: Rotational SRS spectrum containing nine spectral components is generated using quasi-cw pulses with energies ranging around 100-300 nJ. Observation of both transient and steady-state behavior in Stokes amplification is reported. Transition from the transient to the steady-state is observed with pulse as long as 13 ns.

articleTitle: High repetition rate, high energy fiber CPA system for material processing
abstract: We report on a fiber based CPA system generating 100 /spl mu/J of ultra-short pulses at high repetition rates (56 kHz). In a first application, the pulses are used for high speed hole drilling in steel.

articleTitle: From stopping light to all-optical signal processing; leveraging coherent light-matter interactions
abstract: All-optical devices including optical buffers, wavelength converters, optical logic gates and ultra-low Vpi optical modulators can be enabled by leveraging coherent light-matter interactions to create tailorable dispersion characteristics in semiconductors. Recent advances will be discussed.

articleTitle: Differential gain and non-linear gain compression of GaInNAsSb/GaAs lasers at 1.5/spl mu/m
abstract: We present temperature dependent measurements of differential gain, dg/dn, and nonlinear gain compression, /spl epsiv/. At 20/spl deg/C, dg/dn=92/spl times/10/sup -16/cm/sup 2/ and /spl epsiv/=1.4/spl times/10/sup -16/cm/sup 3/. The 57K characteristic temperature of dg/dn limited T/sub 0/. Large /spl epsiv/ caused spectral broadening at high power.

articleTitle: Characterization of carrier-envelope phase noise from grating-based stretcher/compressors for chirped-pulse amplification
abstract: We investigate carrier-envelope phase (CEP) stability of femtosecond pulses propagating through a grating based stretcher/compressor (SC) (Thomann, E, et al., 2004), We do not find CEP noise intrinsic to the SC. Preliminary results on CEP stabilized amplified pulses are presented.

articleTitle: Optical amplification in silicon quantum dot superlattices
abstract: We report results on optical gain in superlattices containing nm-thick Si quantum dot layers. Using VSL method a fast (nsec) ASE component appears above a threshold under intense pulsed pumping. Gain up to 100 cm/sup -1/ is measured.

articleTitle: Air-clad multimode holely fiber coupler for high power transmission
abstract: We report fabrication of a 2/spl times/2 air-clad multimode coupler. It has an insertion loss of 6.5 dB, excess loss of 3.5 dB over broadband. Potential application in high power combiner was confirmed.

articleTitle: Transiently aligned molecular gases for efficient nonlinear frequency conversion
abstract: We demonstrate that nonlinear gratings formed by a spatially modulated alignment pulse enable quasi phase-matched frequency conversion in aligned molecular gases. This process is simulated for third harmonic generation in a gas of linear molecules.

articleTitle: Multi-watt, 780 nm, single-frequency CW fiber-based by SHG in PPLN and PPKTP
abstract: SHG of single-frequency CW Yb/Er fiber source in PPKTP and PPLN is investigated. 30% conversion efficiency and 9 W output power at 780 nm are demonstrated in single pass configuration. Possible applications for laser cooling are discussed.

articleTitle: Beam clean-up and combining using orientational stimulated scattering in liquid crystals
abstract: Beam clean-up and combining using stimulated orientational scattering in nematics is considered. Dynamics of the process is studied, high conversion efficiency and stability with respect to pump fluctuations is demonstrated. Thus, we have demonstrated the possibility of beam clean-up by modeling the process of SOS in NLC. We showed that high conversion efficiency can be achieved, and that the shape and wave-front of the amplified output signal are robust with respect to amplitude and phase distortions of the input pump. We found that the process is limited in longitudinal direction due to the emerging power back-transfer from amplified signal into the pump wave. In summary, Stimulated Orientational Scattering in nematic liquid crystals promises very good prospects for beam clean-up and combining.

articleTitle: Tunable transmission filters based on corrugated sidewall Bragg gratings in polymer waveguides
abstract: We fabricate different bandpass filters based on polymeric waveguide gratings by introducing phase shift defects and integrating with a 3 dB MMI coupler. We also use thermo-optic effects to dynamically tune the designed filter

articleTitle: Determination of the refractive index profile in VCSELs by spatial-spectral mode imaging
abstract: We imaged the near-field intensity distribution of vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) to determine the spatial and spectral distribution of the modes. These mode distributions were used to calculate the refractive index distribution of broad-area VCSELs.

articleTitle: Measurement of standard and microstructured fibers with Fourier domain optical coherence tomography
abstract: Cross sectional imaging with Fourier domain OCT is demonstrated as a technology platform to measure tension, and glass and coating dimensions of standard optical fibers, and the size and pitch of holes in microstructured fibers.

articleTitle: Highly dispersive photonic-crystal waveguides
abstract: We obtain both large group index and group velocity dispersion in a low-index contrast photonic crystal waveguide operated below the light cone. We present experimental results and compare with theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Physics and simulation of semiconductor lasers
abstract: This talk reviews the physics of the semiconductor-laser gain medium. The optical and electronic properties of quantum-confined semiconductor heterostructures are discussed and nonequilibrium simulations of quantum-well and quantum-dot laser systems are presented.

articleTitle: Enhanced parametric processes in 2D GaAs photonic crystal waveguides
abstract: Enhanced nonlinear parametric conversion is demonstrated via doubly resonant coupling to leaky eigenmodes in photonic crystal waveguides. In particular, we show an example of sum-frequency generation. This technique can be extended into a useful spectroscopic tool to access more wavelengths and wavevectors by considering difference-frequency generation and non-collinear geometries.

articleTitle: An all-optical packet-switched ring network
abstract: We demonstrated an all-optical packet add-drop node for a uni-directional all-optical packet-switched ring network. All-optical add, drop, and clearance of packets are performed based on all-optical processing of packet headers. The header and payload rates are 5 Gb/s and 10 Gb/s respectively.

articleTitle: Application of confocal light scattering spectroscopic microscopy to monitor subcellular organelles
Thermally poled germanosilicate films with high second-order nonlinearity
abstract: Accurate measurements of the second-order nonlinearity profile of thermally poled low-loss germanosilicate films grown on fused-silica substrates are reported, of interest as potential electro-optic devices. After optimization, we demonstrate a record high nonlinear coefficient d/sub 33/ /spl ap/ 1.6 pm/V, a two-fold improvement over highest reported d/sub 33/ value in fused silica that we attribute to the presence of germanium.

articleTitle: High speed cavity ringdown spectroscopy by simultaneous laser and cavity tuning: towards O/sub 2/ sensing in blow-down wind tunnels
abstract: We present a high speed cavity ringdown scheme involving simultaneous laser and cavity sweeping. By performing fast O/sub 2/ measurements, we show that our system fulfils the requirements to analyze transient flows in hypersonic wind tunnels.

articleTitle: Towards reconstruction of embedded objects with multiple speckle images for medical diagnostics
abstract: A new method of seeing objects hidden in scattering medium from multiple speckle images is demonstrated. The entire noisy images from lens array are digitally processed to obtain the desired image of the hidden objects.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of 5-mm-thick periodically poled MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ device
abstract: Fabrication of 5 mm-thick periodically poled MgO-doped LiNbO/sub 3/ device with 32.1 /spl mu/m period was demonstrated by temperature-elevated field poling technique. The periodic-structure quality was evaluated by second-harmonic generation of 954 nm using d/sub 31/-coefficient.

articleTitle: Guided resonances in photonic crystal slabs studied with terahertz time domain spectroscopy
abstract: Photonic crystal slabs with hexagonal-lattice air-hole arrays are studied experimentally using coherent single-cycle terahertz pulses. Transmission measurements reveal the properties of guided resonances, in both time and frequency domain.

articleTitle: Surface emitting terahertz quantum cascade lasers
abstract: Design and simulation results for surface-emitting terahertz quantum cascade lasers using phase-shifted second-order gratings are presented. Analysis shows performance superior to edge-emitting devices, with outcoupling efficiencies nearly twice as large, and narrow output beam widths.

articleTitle: Nanodomain engineering in two-dimensional /spl Lambda//sup (2)/ nonlinear photonic crystal on bulk lithium niobate
abstract: Four-to-six fold rotation-symmetry with sub-mum domain size is observed in periodically-poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. Depth-resolved pyroelectric microscopy analysis indicates the 2D-confinement of inverted domains is ascribed to selective nucleation and minimized fringe-field effect by flattened polystyrene spheres on the surface

articleTitle: Investigation of supercontinuum generation in a two-dimensional photonic kagome crystal
abstract: We investigate the generation of white-light continua in a kagome lattice structure. The dependence on pump power, propagation length, and polarization state of both, pump and continuum radiation is analyzed.

articleTitle: Solid-state lighting: lamps, chips and materials for tomorrow
abstract: In this talk, we give an overview of some of the key challenges that solid-state lighting technology faces if it is to achieve its potential for general white lighting.

articleTitle: Optical fiber with an acoustic guiding layer for stimulated Brillouin scattering suppression
abstract: Experimental results are presented demonstrating significant suppression of stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) in a specially designed fiber structure. SBS suppression is achieved using an acoustic guiding layer surrounding an optical core.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact dispersion compensated femtosecond fiber oscillators and amplifiers
abstract: Dispersion-compensated fully integrated Er and Yb femtosecond fiber oscillators are described. Yb MOPAs produce 100 fs pulses at repetition rates of 60 MHz with average output powers up to 200 mW. Er MOPAs generate 100 fs pulses with average output powers up to 100 mW.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic oscillator using push-pull Mach-Zehnder modulator biased at null point for optical two-tone signal generation
abstract: We propose a novel optoelectronic oscillator (OHO) made of a push-pull Mach-Zehnder modulator biased at null point, oscillating at half the frequency of feedback signal. Optical two-tone signal with 10.5-GHz frequency difference is experimentally generated.

articleTitle: Tunable all-optical delays via Brillouin slow light in an optical fiber
abstract: We have demonstrated that stimulated Brillouin scattering can be used to generate all-optical slow-light pulse delays of greater than a pulse length for pulses as short as 16 ns in a single-mode fiber. Since the induced delay is generated for wavelengths detuned from the pump field by the Brillouin frequency, tuning near an electronic resonance of the material is not required and thus delays can be induced at telecommunication wavelengths. This represents a significant improvement over previous demonstrations of slow light in solids and is an important step towards developing an all-optical tunable delay line for telecommunications. In addition, these results strongly suggest that analogous delays can be achieved using stimulated Raman scattering at telecommunication data rates.

articleTitle: 200 W self-organized coherent fiber arrays
abstract: We report producing 200 W coherent fiber laser arrays without active control. This outcome is obtained via self-organization using a non-fiber coupler for two- to ten-laser arrays.

articleTitle: Aperture averaging experiment for optimizing receiver design and analyzing turbulence on free space optical communication links
abstract: We describe an experiment for studying aperture averaging of a Gaussian-beam propagating through free-space. A digital camera system is used to evaluate scintillation and aperture averaging. These studies provide parametric data to enhance receiver performance.

articleTitle: High power LED packaging
abstract: In this presentation, the development of high power LEDs will be reviewed, including a review of the power LED chip technologies being used for high power applications, leadframe and submount technologies, injection molded plastics used for power applications and encapsulation materials. Aspects of high volume manufacturing for power LEDs will be discussed and emerging markets for high power LED light engines will be described

articleTitle: High-speed 850 nm AlGaAs/GaAs vertical cavity surface emitting laser with low parasitic capacitance fabricated using BCB planarization technique
abstract: 12.5 Gbps operation of low-k benzocyclobutene (BCB)-planarized 850 nm AIGaAs-based VCSEL is presented. The chip capacitance is 70% reduced from that of conventional SiN-passivated one. The VCSEL exhibits very high relaxation oscillation frequency of 12 GHz with stable operation at 70/spl deg/C over 750 hours.

articleTitle: Efficient coupling of nano-plasmonics to micro-photonic circuitry
abstract: An ultrashort (2.5 microns) tapered plasmon waveguide coupler with overall 70% coupling efficiency from a micron size dielectric waveguide to a 50 nm metal-clad plasmon waveguide was proposed, and related plasmonic-oscillatory modes interactions were investigated.

articleTitle: Modeling intensity noise caused by stimulated Brillouin scattering in optical fibers
abstract: Increased intensity noise in light transmitted through optical fiber is attributed to the conversion of phase modulation to intensity modulation by SBS. The conversion is caused by a phase shift of the optical carrier relative to the sidebands.

articleTitle: Femtosecond mode-locking of a ytterbium-doped fiber laser using a carbon-nanotube-based mode-locker with ultra-wide absorption band
abstract: We demonstrate the first mode-locked femtosecond ytterbium-doped fiber laser using a carbon-nanotube-based mode-locker at 1 /spl mu/m wavelength regime. The laser produces nearly transform-limited hyperbolic-secant pulse with 180 fs pulse width at a repetition rate of 23.3 MHz.

articleTitle: Microring-resonator filter with doubled free-spectral-range by two-point coupling
abstract: Two-point coupling is used to double the free-spectral-range (FSR) of a microring-resonator filter. The filter, designed using rigorous electromagnetic simulations and fabricated using e-beam lithography, demonstrates 22 dB resonance suppression yielding a 40.8 nm FSR

articleTitle: 640 Gb/s OTDM transmission and demultiplexing using a NOLM with commercially available highly non-linear fiber
abstract: Demultiplexing of a 640 Gb/s single-polarization optical time-division multiplexed (OTDM) signal and a 640 Gb/s signal with two alternating polarizations transmitted through 77 km of non-zero dispersion shifted fiber (NZDSF) are realized using a non-linear optical loop mirrors (NOLM) based on 500 m of highly non-linear fiber (HNLF).

articleTitle: 20 dB on-off Raman amplification in silicon waveguides
abstract: We report on-off optical gains of 20 dB in silicon-on-insulator waveguides. Free carrier and two photon absorption of 4 dB is measured indicating an intrinsic Raman gain of 24 dB

articleTitle: A novel 40 Gb/s NRZ all-optical clock recovery
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate 40 GHz all-optical clock recovery from a common 40 Gb/s NRZ signal. We first exploit a non-linear optical pre-processor and then use a semiconductor-assisted Fabry-Perot filter (FPF) for clock extraction

articleTitle: Bismuth-based extra-high nonlinear optical fiber
abstract: We report on a bismuth-based nonlinear optical fiber which has a low propagation loss and fusion splicing loss. The nonlinear coefficient of 1200 W/sup -1/ km/sup -1/ is measured by the bi-directional four-wave-mixing method.

articleTitle: Comparison of crosstalk in amplitude- and phase-modulated hyperfine WDM fiber optic links
abstract: We investigated RF crosstalk levels at 12.5 GHz optical channel spacing for a 34 km, Er-amplified fiber optic link. For two different link configurations, experimental results are presented for both amplitude and phase modulation.

articleTitle: 11.1 W average power, 20 ps pulses at 1 GHz repetition rate from a fiber-amplified gain-switched 1.06 /spl mu/m Fabry-Perot laser diode
abstract: 20 ps pulses at 1 GHz repetition rate were obtained from a gain-switched 1.06 /spl mu/m semiconductor laser utilizing pulse compression with normally dispersive fiber. The pulses were amplified in fiber to give average output power 11.1 W.

articleTitle: Narrow-linewidth, high-power 1556-nm slab-coupled optical waveguide external-cavity laser
abstract: We demonstrate an external-cavity laser comprised of a novel InGaAsP/InP curved-channel slab-coupled optical waveguide amplifier and a fiber Bragg grating. The laser exhibits a technical-noise-limited linewidth of 130 kHz with 88-mW output power at 1556 nm

articleTitle: Time reversal and phase conjugation with acoustic waves: industrial and medical applications
abstract: Time-reversal invariance, a fundamental symmetry that holds nearly everywhere in microscopic physics, can be exploited in a unique way in acoustics, to create a variety of useful instruments. In the past years, taking advantage of the reversibility of the acoustic propagation that holds in many situations (to the extent that everything is adiabatic) time reversal mirrors (TRMs) have been developed that create time reversed waves. Applications of time reversal to medical therapy are also under study. The focal spot of a TRM can track a kidney stone during a lithotripsy treatment. New improvement of this technique have recently be obtained due to time reversal pulse amplification in solid waveguide. Taking advantage of wave dispersion in the waveguide, a time-reversal operation made on a small number of transducers transforms the long-lasting low-level dispersed wave forms into a sharp intense pulse that can easily destroy kidney stones. Others applications of TRMs to brain therapy are also under study and first in vivo tissue necrosis of brain tissue have been obtained through skull on sheep with ultrasonic time reversal mirrors

articleTitle: Experimental XPM, SPM, FWM penalty evaluation in very dense WDM optical systems
abstract: Experimental SPM, FWM and XPM contributions are separately measured. Evaluation of Q penalties is performed on a 2000-km, 33-GHz, 66-GHz and 100-GHz-spaced DWDM system. XPM is found to be the major constrain.

articleTitle: Investigation of 42.7-Gb/s quadrature phase-shift keying (QPSK) signals using linear optical sampling
abstract: The properties of 42.7-Gb/s quadrature phase-shift keying signals are investigated using linear optical sampling. The effects of ASE, chromatic dispersion, and nonlinear propagation on the electric field are demonstrated.

articleTitle: All-optical, continuously tunable, nanosecond pulse delay using wavelength conversion and fiber dispersion
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical tunable delay based on wavelength shifting in a fiber- parametric amplifier followed by a dispersive fiber. The device operates near 1550 nm and generates delays as large as 1.2 ns.

articleTitle: Optical microfiber loop resonator
abstract: We demonstrate a microloop resonator created from the subwavelength-diameter microfiber in free space. The resonator was tuned to exhibit Q-factor 15000 and to the critical coupling regime with the magnitude of transmission oscillations 34 dB

articleTitle: Mode-area scaling of helical-core dual-clad fiber lasers and amplifiers
abstract: Helical-core, dual-clad fibers have been designed for single-mode operation with 60-/spl mu/m cores and 0.10 NA. Helical fibers are shown to perform where conventional coiled fibers cannot operate, with possible scaling to 200-/spl mu/m-diameter helical cores.

articleTitle: Integrated optical parametric oscillators with Ti:PPLN waveguides
abstract: The state of the art of integrated optical parametric oscillators with Ti-indiffused waveguides in periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) is reviewed with emphasis on devices for the mid infrared spectral range (2700 nm<λ/sub s.i/<3500 nm).

articleTitle: Timing jitter analysis for clock recovery circuits based on an optoelectronic phase-locked loop (OPLL)
abstract: Timing jitter of an OPLL based clock recovery is investigated. We demonstrate how loop gain, input and VCO signal jitter, loop filter bandwidth and a loop time delay influence jitter of the extracted clock signal

articleTitle: All-optical modulation format conversion from frequency-shift-keying to phase-shift-keying by using optical double-sideband modulation technique
abstract: We propose a novel optical modulation format conversion technique using double-sideband suppressed-carrier modulation. An optical 10 Gbps frequency-shift-keying signal was directly converted into a phase-shift-keying signal.

articleTitle: XPM-induced impairments in RZ-DPSK transmission in a multi-modulation format WDM system
abstract: We investigate the impact of XPM-induced penalties on a RZ-DPSK channel due to NRZ-ASK neighbors in a WDM transmission system, and examine the dependence on channel spacing and launch polarization.

articleTitle: Terahertz-wave generation in periodically-inverted GaAs
abstract: Efficient generation of narrow-band terahertz-wave pulses tunable in the 2-3 THz frequency range was achieved in periodically-inverted GaAs; structures pumped by 100-fs pulses tunable between 2 and 4 microns, via mechanism of quasi-phase-matched optical rectification.

articleTitle: Development of Nd-doped optical gain material based on silica glass with a high thermal shock parameter for high-average-power laser
abstract: This paper reports demonstrations of laser amplification and oscillation at 1.06 /spl mu/m in a bulk-type Nd-doped silica glass (Nd/sub 2/O/sub 3/: 1.25 wt%, Al/sub 2/O/sub 3/: 2.72 wt%, SiO/sub 2/: 96.03 wt%) with a high thermal shock parameter, 12.0 W/cm.

articleTitle: Optical waveguide lens with modulated width designed by wavefront matching method
abstract: We use our recently proposed wavefront matching method to design waveguide lenses with modulated widths. We fabricated a waveguide lens pair in a silica waveguide, and confirmed its operational principle experimentally.

articleTitle: Low noise 10-W cw OPO generation near 3 /spl mu/m MgO doped PPLN
abstract: Over 10 W of near diffraction-limited output at 3-/spl mu/m was achieved from a singly resonant OPO pumped by a 50-W ytterbium fiber laser. Excellent frequency and power stabilities were observed using 5% MgO doped PPLN.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal with diamond-like structure fabricated by holographic lithography
abstract: Photonic crystal with diamond-like structure, which exists a large absolute band gap and at lower refractive index contrast of n/spl ges/2.05 is enough to open a complete band gap, was fabricated by holographic lithography.

articleTitle: 3D Analysis of scattering losses due to sidewall roughness in microphotonic waveguides: high index-contrast
abstract: We present a 3D analysis of scattering losses due to sidewall roughness in rectangular dielectric waveguides valid for any refractive-index-contrast and field polarization. We show that the typical 2D analyses can substantially over-estimate scattering losses.

articleTitle: Polarization insensitive 40 GHz self-pulsating DBR lasers with enhanced nonlinearities and wide self-pulsation frequency tunability
abstract: 40 GHz self-pulsating distributed Bragg reflector lasers with a polarization insensitive bulk active layer of 0.7/spl times/0.5 /spl mu/m/sup 2/ showed enhanced non-linear behavior at low power level, and nearly 1 GHz of continuous self-pulsation frequency tunability using two active sections.

articleTitle: Generation of quasi-single-cycle THz pulses based on broadband-phase-matched difference-frequency generation: high conversion efficiencies and output powers
abstract: Quasi-single-cycle THz pulses are generated with high conversion efficiencies and output powers, using ultrafast infrared pulses, in a second-order nonlinear medium, by utilizing broadband-phase-matched difference-frequency generation and optimizing the pump pulse widths.

articleTitle: Large-signal analog modulation response of monolithic optical injection-locked DFB lasers
abstract: A monolithic optical injection-locked distributed feedback laser with bent-waveguide is demonstrated to achieve large optical extinction ratio (>12 dB) with DC to 2-GHz bandwidth. The extinction ratio is 6 dB higher than that of the free-running laser.

articleTitle: A low power, low delay TIA for on-chip applications
abstract: A low power, low delay TIA for on-chip optical fanout applications is presented. Through the testing results, our earlier theoretical predictions on the advantages of optical fanout at short distances are confirmed for small loads.

articleTitle: All-optical digital half-subtracter/adder using semiconductor optical amplifiers and a PPLN waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical digital half-subtracter/adder that performs bit-wise subtraction and addition of two binary data streams. Two SOAs and a periodically-poled lithium-niobate waveguide generate borrow, difference/sum, and carry outputs with maximum 1.0-dB power penalty.

articleTitle: Ultrafast gain recovery dynamics of the excited state in InGaAs quantum dot amplifiers
abstract: The gain dynamics in electrically-pumped InGaAs quantum dot amplifiers at 300 K is measured to be in the subpicosecond range for both ground and excited state transitions, promising for all-optical signal processing at >40 GHz repetition rates.

articleTitle: Chirped-pulse frequency conversion of ultrafast pulses to the deep-UV
abstract: We report a 10-fold increase in energy in the generation of ultrafast UV pulses through frequency mixing in a hollow waveguide. The UV, blue and ER pulses are characterized with a novel transient-grating FROG apparatus.

articleTitle: Dynamic control of liquid-core/liquid-cladding optical waveguides
abstract: Liquid-core/liquid-cladding waveguides are dynamic; their operation depends on a continuous, laminar flow of a core and cladding fluid. We demonstrate single-mode and multi-mode waveguiding, switching and tunable evanescent coupling between liquid cores.

articleTitle: Rapidly reconfigurable 8-bit chip-scale true-time-delay module for high-bandwidth-preserving, multi-aperture, free-space laser-communication transmitter
abstract: Using a true-time-delay chip-scale module, free-space 1.55-/spl mu/m beam-steering over /spl plusmn/40/spl deg/ field-of-view with 2-ps laser pulses is reported. The measured reconfiguration speed of this 8-bit-programmable module (0 ps to 256 ps, 1-ps increments) is /spl sim/400/spl mu/s.

articleTitle: Theoretical and experimental study of improved catastrophic optical damage performance in 830nm high power lasers with non-absorbing mirrors
abstract: We carry out a systematic theoretical and experimental study on the improvement in catastrophic optical damage of 830 nm lasers with non-absorbing mirrors. We find a three-fold increase in COD optical power level compared to conventional lasers

articleTitle: Dual wavelength free space optical communications
abstract: We present a technique to correct for atmospheric scintillation noise in free space optical communications. Common mode rejection is used to remove co-channel noise, where each channel is transmitted on separate, but closely spaced, wavelengths.

articleTitle: High speed, high switching contrast quantum well saturable absorber for 160 Gbit/s operation
abstract: We report on a novel quantum well saturable absorber device whose measured response time of 1.5 psec and contrast of at least 4 dB make it suitable for all-optical extinction ratio enhancement at 160 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: High-speed electrical modulator in high-index-contrast (HIC) Si-waveguides
abstract: A CMOS-compatible Mach-Zehnder modulator based on strongly forward biased PIN-diodes is proposed, resulting in small signal modulation bandwidths beyond 20 GHz, a figure of merit of V/sub /spl pi/L/=0.5 V/spl middot/cm and an insertion loss of about 4 dB.

articleTitle: 80 GSPS photonic analogue to digital conversion system using broadband continuous wave source
abstract: An 80 GSPS photonic ADC system is demonstrated, using broadband mode-locked lasers (MLL) and dispersive fibre to form a continuous waveform with time-wavelength mapping, and array waveguide gratings (AWG) to channelise. Tests are carried out for RF signals up to 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Low voltage, high repetition rate electro-optic Q-switch
abstract: A low voltage, high repetition rate electro-optic Q-switch using OptoCeramic/spl reg/ PMN-PT was developed. A solid-state laser with repetition rate as high as 200 KHz with switching voltage as low as 48 volts has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Efficiency increase of silicon-on-insulator Raman lasers by reduction of free-carrier absorption in tapered waveguides
abstract: The efficiency of continuous-wave SOI Raman lasers can he increased significantly by using a waveguide with a longitudinally varying (as opposed to a constant) effective area, thus reducing the impact of free-carrier absorption.

articleTitle: Entangled cavity optical parametric oscillator : OPO supreme for spectroscopy in the mid-IR
abstract: Mode overlap engineering in entangled cavity optical parametric oscillator is shown as a powerful approach to fulfil requirements for high resolution spectroscopy. Demonstration experiments are given in the mid-IR spectral range.

articleTitle: High energy fiber chirped pulse amplification system based on cubicons
abstract: The generation of stretched 20 pJ pulses with 200 kW peak power is demonstrated in an in-line Yb fiber chirped pulse amplification system at a repetition rate of 50 kHz. The pulses are compressible down to 400 fs using nonlinear cubical dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Multistage high-order microring-resonator filters with relaxed tolerances for high through-port extinction
abstract: We demonstrate that add/drop filter designs comprising cascaded coupled-microring stages permit reduced drop-loss and relaxed tolerances for high through-port extinction. We report on high-index-contrast filters with 20 nm FSR, 2.5 dB drop loss and 30 dB of extinction

articleTitle: Terahertz polarimetry
abstract: We present a simple and reliable technique to fully characterize the polarization state of a terahertz wave over a wide range of frequencies. Application to polarization ratio and crystal birefringence measurements is given.

articleTitle: Fundamental noise limit in dual-pump fiber-optic parametric amplifiers and wavelength converters
abstract: Raman scattering induces considerable noise on dual-pump fiber-optic parametric amplifiers (FOPAs) and wavelength converters. Noise figure of such FOPAs is around 4 dB over the flat portion of gain spectrum and increases as pumps are separated farther apart. Such noise is significantly reduced in FOPAs with cross-polarized pumps.

articleTitle: Self-imaging waveguide lasers
abstract: Self-imaging waveguide technology offers the high efficiency and brightness of a fiber laser, combined with higher pulse energies available from bulk laser. This paper describes performance trades, latest data for >100 W operation, and power-scaling potential

articleTitle: Experimental characterization of wavelength separation for "QKD+WDM" co-existence
abstract: The minimum wavelength separation for multiplexing 1.3 /spl mu/m QKD with 1.5 /spl mu/m classical optical channels is experimentally determined for impairment-free QKD+WDM transmission.

articleTitle: High-power, diode edge-pumped, single-crystal Yb:YAG / ceramic YAG composite microchip Yb:YAG laser for material processing
abstract: High-power (>100W CW and 380W QCW) operation of diode edge-pumped, microchip Yb:YAG laser was demonstrated. The 300/spl mu/m-thick microchip has a new composite structure consisting of 5mm-diameter, cylindrical single-crystal Yb:YAG core and surrounding transparent, undoped ceramic YAG pump waveguide.

articleTitle: 43 Gb/s 264 km field fiber transmission using 2R regeneration in a tunable all-optical signal regenerator
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical 2R regeneration for 43 Gb/s signal after 264 km field fiber transmission. The experimental results show that the all-optical 2R regenerator creates a negative power penalty and achieves an all-optical RZ-to-NRZ conversion.

articleTitle: High performance uncooled 1.3 /spl mu/m VCSELs for RF-over-fiber applications
abstract: Uncooled directly-modulated 1.3 /spl mu/m VCSELs are shown to exhibit dynamic range, linearity and noise performance required for wireless LAN applications. A multimode fiber based WLAN 802.11 b system shows performances comparable to systems with state-of-the-art DFB lasers.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation of the optimum decision threshold for varying numbers of active users in a 2D t-/spl lambda/, asynchronous O-CDMA system
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that tuning the decision threshold in an O-CDMA receiver to an optimal point based on the active-user-count improves receiver sensitivity by >3-dB, and demonstrate an active-user-count monitoring technique, allowing dynamic threshold adjustment.

articleTitle: Broadband access using wireless over fibre systems
abstract: Optical fibre provides a future-proof method for distributing broadband wireless signals in such formats as IEEE 802.11 and 802.16. This paper reviews technologies for this application ranging from currently deployed narrowband cellular systems to future millimetre-wave systems.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of all-optical regeneration using a polarization bistable VCSEL
abstract: All-optical signal regeneration was experimentally demonstrated using a polarization bistable vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser by injection of a signal pulse and two orthogonally polarized clock pulses. Wavelengths of these injection pulses were independently optimized.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband spectral transfer in extended focal zones: truncated few-cycle Bessel-Gauss beams
abstract: By self-apodized truncation of few-cycle pulsed Bessel-Gauss beams, focal zones of decimeter decay lengths were shaped. Both, theoretical and experimental results indicate more robust spatio-spectral characteristics at ultrabroad bandwidths compared to Gaussian beam foci.

articleTitle: Fiber laser fiber
abstract: Fiber lasers performance continues to increase due to advances in fiber design, with developments such as large mode area fibers, all-glass pump combiners, microstructured fiber and air-clad fiber allowing higher peak and average power.

articleTitle: Complete modal decomposition for optical waveguides
abstract: We present a novel approach to complete modal decomposition of the vectorial field in optical waveguide based on the phase retrieval algorithm. Experimental confirmation is provided by examining mode interaction in a photonic bandgap fiber.

articleTitle: A monolithically integrated optical heterodyne receiver
abstract: We demonstrated a monolithically integrated heterodyne receiver consisting of a single frequency laser, a 3 dB coupler, and waveguide photodiodes using a single epitaxial growth. A 3 GHz frequency modulated optical link was realized using this receiver.

articleTitle: Static and dynamic measurements of the Henry factor of 5-quantum dot layer single mode lasers emitting at 1.3 /spl mu/m on GaAs
abstract: The "material" and "device" linewidth enhancement factor of 5 quantum-dot layer single mode lasers emitting at 1.3 /spl mu/m are investigated using two methods for the first time, demonstrating a record value of 0.67 for this wavelength.

articleTitle: Vector bending sensors based on fiber Bragg gratings inscribed by an infrared femtosecond laser
abstract: A direction-sensitive bend sensor in standard single-mode fiber is demonstrated for the first time based on an axially-offset fiber Bragg grating, directly written by an infrared femtosecond laser.

articleTitle: Wavelength-independent high-extinction fibre mode convertor
abstract: We have used photonic crystal fibre techniques to construct a mode converter. It couples light from LP/sub 01/ to LP/sub 11/ modes with extinction ratio >30 dB at all wavelengths from 650-1750 nm.

articleTitle: Continuous comparison of two fiber based fs-frequency combs
abstract: Erbium-doped femtosecond fiber lasers are ideal comb generators for optical frequency metrology. We compare two such systems and find agreement within 2/spl times/10/sup -16/. This is to our knowledge the first thorough test of fiber-based frequency combs.

articleTitle: An optically clocked transistor array for dual serial-to- parallel and parallel-to-serial conversion of optical packets
abstract: We propose an optically clocked transistor array which performs both serial-to-parallel and parallel-to-serial conversion (time demux/mux) of incoming/outgoing packets, enabling a low cost, low power, compact optical label processor for asynchronous burst optical packets.

articleTitle: Changes in refractive index and size of Bacillus subtilis spores during activation, measured by light transmission
abstract: Refractive index and size changes in Bacillus subtilis spores were measured during heat shock activation by light scattering. The refractive index decreased from 1.51 to 1.38 while the size increased from 0.37 to 0.6 microns.

articleTitle: Y-branch optical coupler monolithically integrated with DFB quantum cascade lasers
abstract: A Y-branch optical coupler monolithically integrated with two DFB quantum cascade lasers has been demonstrated and studied.

articleTitle: Demodulation of co-polarized 20-Gbit/s QPSK signals with 16-GHz spacing after 200-km transmission using coherent detection and digital signal processing
abstract: Coherent detection and digital signal processing can effectively recover optical QPSK signals with nearly ideal filtering characteristics. We demonstrate the demodulation of co-polarized 20-Gbit/s QPSK signals with 16-GHz spacing after 200-km transmission.

articleTitle: Simultaneous spatial and temporal focusing of femtosecond pulses
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the concept of simultaneous spatial and temporal focusing of femtosecond pulses. Our technique has the potential to significantly reduce background excitation which fundamentally limits the imaging depth in scattering biological specimens.

articleTitle: T-ray reflection computed tomography
abstract: We describe a powerful new imaging modality for terahertz radiation, T-ray reflection computed tomography. Edge maps of an object's cross-section are reconstructed from a series of time-domain reflection measurements at different viewing angles.

articleTitle: High-brightness, high-efficiency 940-980nm InGaAs/AlGaAs/GaAs broad waveguide diode lasers
abstract: High brightness, weak temperature dependent, InGaAs/AlGaAs/GaAs broad waveguide lasers with 100-mum aperture are presented. A record high CW output power of 15 W and a high slope efficiency of 1.0 W/A were achieved at 25 degC

articleTitle: Demonstration of data-rate flexible OCDMA with record-long 511-chip SSFBG en/decoder
abstract: Impairments of inter-symbol interference and beat noise in coherent time-spreading optical code-division-multiple-access are investigated theoretically and experimentally by sweeping the data-rate from 622 Mbps up to 10 Gbps with a record-long 511-chip 640 Gchip/s superstructured fiber Bragg grating.

articleTitle: In-phase coherently coupled 2D arrays of defect cavities within a photonic crystal VCSEL
abstract: We report the first in-phase coherently coupled 2-dimensional arrays of defect cavities within a photonic crystal vertical cavity surface-emitting laser. The array elements exhibit a central on-axis intensity maximum measured in the far field.

articleTitle: All-optical pump-seed synchronization for few-cycle OPCPA
abstract: We suggest and experimentally verify a simple method for timing-jitter-free synchronization of the seed and pump pulses in an optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier. A fraction of a broadband seed pulse centered at 800 nm was frequency-shifted in a photonic crystal fiber to enable synchronized seeding of a picosecond Nd:YAG pump laser.

articleTitle: Electrooptic single-sideband modulator using resonant electrodes and polarization-reversed structure
abstract: New electrooptic single-sideband modulators are proposed and demonstrated. Adopting polarization-reversed structure to electrooptic modulators with long standing-wave resonant electrodes, it is possible to control a modulation phase arbitrarily, which leads to compact low-power single-sideband modulators.

articleTitle: Simple and compact Hz-level linewidth laser system via improved mounting configuration of a reference cavity
abstract: We report a simple, robust 1-Hz linewidth laser system enabled by an improved mounting strategy for optical reference cavities used for laser frequency stabilization.

articleTitle: Infrared (3.75 /spl mu/m) interband cascade light emitting diode arrays with high brightness
abstract: The interband cascade (IC) IR LED light with 0.65% efficiency is reported. We believe this is the highest efficiency from IC LED structure reported so far. We discussed various device structures for enhanced light intensity

articleTitle: Continuous and simultaneous multigas monitoring using a highly sensitive and selective photoacoustic sensor
abstract: A multi-gas photoacoustic sensor is reported. Simultaneous measurement of ammonia, carbon dioxide and water vapor is demonstrated at ppm level using semiconductor lasers. In-situ measurements to control the housing conditions of laboratory animals are presented.

articleTitle: Optimization of ultra-long MQW semiconductor optical amplifiers for all-optical 40-Gb/s wavelength conversion
abstract: Detailed study of cross-phase modulation wavelength conversion based on ultra-long semiconductor optical amplifier is implemented to optimize the extinction ratio and pattern dependence. Error free 40 Gb/s wavelength conversion is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of an all-optical clock recovery and data resampling stage for NRZ data signals
abstract: A novel actively modelocked gain-clamped semiconductor optical amplifier based ring scheme able to recover non-return-to-zero formats at 10 Gbit/s data rate is experimentally evaluated in terms of jitter, bit-error-rate and locking time using a deployed cable

articleTitle: Optical atomic clocks: a revolution in performance
abstract: Optical atomic clocks using cold atoms, stable lasers and femtosecond laser frequency combs provide high accuracy and stability from RF to the ultraviolet. They have unprecedented performance: ultrahigh stability, sub-fs timing jitter, low-noise microwaves, and several new uses.

articleTitle: Profilometry using a frequency-shifted feedback laser
abstract: A frequency-shifted feedback laser is used as chirped light source for optical profilometry based on optical frequency-domain reflectometry. Measurement ranges of 1 m and accuracies better than 50 /spl mu/m have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical micro- and nano-structures using fibre tapers
abstract: Tapering of conventional and photonic crystal fibres can be used to make glass-air waveguides down to submicron scales, and gives them ready-made low-loss interfaces to simplify input and output coupling.

articleTitle: 100 Gb/s (10/spl times/10 Gb/s) DWDM photonic integrated circuit transmitters and receivers
abstract: 100 Gb/s transmitters and receivers are realized through the monolithic integration of over 50 discrete functions onto a single InP chip. The modules are capable of simultaneously transmitting and receiving 10 DWDM wavelengths at >10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Watt-level red and UV output from a CW diode array pumped tunable alexandrite laser
abstract: Powers in excess of 1.3 W at 750 nm and 670 mW at 375 nm have been achieved with a diode bar-pumped alexandrite laser. These CW powers are the highest achieved to date with such a tunable system.

articleTitle: Sequence estimation with run-length coding for VCSEL-based multimode fiber links
abstract: We demonstrate an electronic equalization technique using sequence estimation that can compensate severe intersymbol interference for run-length coded multimode VCSEL-based links.

articleTitle: Temporal behavior of radiation-pressure-induced RF oscillation of an optical micro-cavity phonon mode
abstract: We analyze experimentally and theoretically mechanical oscillation at RF frequency within an optical cavity stimulated by the pressure of circulating optical radiation. Oscillations and chaos were observed in output power.

articleTitle: Multichannel wavelength conversion of DPSK signals using four-wave mixing in highly-nonlinear fiber without crossgainmodulation penalty
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous wavelength conversion of multiple DPSK channels using four-wave mixing in highly-nonlinear fiber. We achieve 20 nm converter bandwidth with 85% maximum efficiency. Three 10 Gb/s channels are converted without cross-modulation penalty

articleTitle: Simulation of the nonlinear phase noise in saturated semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: The nonlinear phase noise in saturated semiconductor optical amplifiers with DPSK modulation is studied by numerical simulation. It is found that the phase noise can be significantly reduced by increasing the carrier lifetime.

articleTitle: Dominant causes of linewidth in DFB fiber lasers
abstract: We present experimental arid theoretical results on the linewidth of an Er-Yb doped DFB fiber laser. Recently observed dependencies on pump configuration and power are explained by pump noise induced temperature fluctuations.

articleTitle: Efficient quasi-phase matching in periodically-twinned quartz
abstract: We demonstrate 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-order QPM SHG in periodically-twinned quartz under tight focusing condition of a Nd:YAG laser. Owing to large temperature bandwidth, stable and efficient green light of 31 mW was obtained without temperature control

articleTitle: Two-dimensional self-imaging in silicon-based square MMI waveguides
abstract: With 100/spl times/100 /spl mu/m/sup 2/ cross-sectional MMI waveguides, N/spl times/N matrices of replicated images based on symmetric multimode interference are experimentally observed for N ranging from 4 to 11 at various waveguide lengths.

articleTitle: 130 mJ, 10 Hz, Q-switched diode-pumped Ho:Tm:LuLiF laser oscillator at 2.05 /spl mu/m
abstract: A Q-switched diode-pumped Ho:Tm:LuLiF laser oscillator with output pulse energy of 130-mJ per pulse at a repetition frequency of 10 Hz and at optical pumping pulse energy of 3.5 J has been developed.

articleTitle: Measuring Kleinman-disallowed hyperpolarizabilities by time-resolved hyper-Rayleigh scattering
abstract: Time-resolved single photon counting is used for measuring Kleinman-disallowed nonlinear tensor components in order to evaluate molecular materials for chiral axial organic nonlinear optical materials. The experimental setup and results are described.

articleTitle: Tunable fiber parametric wavelength converter with 24 nm conversion band and 4.5 dB noise figure
abstract: We present a noise figure map of a tunable fiber wavelength converter, based on parametric amplification, with over 24 nm bandwidth. The noise figure, typically 4.5 dB, deteriorates to 10 dB for small wavelength shifts.

articleTitle: Cavity-enhanced spectroscopy using pump-probe differencing
abstract: We present a relatively simple experimental technique enabling mechanical-noise free, cavity-enhanced spectroscopic measurements of an atomic transition and its hyperfine structure. We demonstrate this technique at 532 nm with an iodine vapour cell.

articleTitle: Symmetric waveguides written in Er/sup 3+/-doped B/sub 2/O/sub 3/-based glass using femtosecond laser pulses
abstract: Single-mode channel waveguides are fabricated in Er/sup 3+/-doped Bi/sub 2/O/sub 3/-based glass using femtosecond laser pulses at 800 nm. A waveguide with circular transverse profile is demonstrated without using any beam shaping technique.

articleTitle: Generation of photonic crystal laser mode by Lorentz-dispersive finite-difference time-domain method
abstract: Photonic-crystal single-cell laser dynamics has been studied for the first time using a Lorentz-dispersive FDTD simulation, which includes rate equations with carrier ambipolar-diffusion. The generation of the laser mode and relaxation oscillations has been investigated.

articleTitle: Measurement of the phase of pulses after transmission through scattering tissue
abstract: Spectral phase deformation caused by transmission of femtosecond laser pulses through scattering tissue is measured directly. We show how slight deviations in phase consequently allow experimentally selective fluorescence imaging through tissue by binary phase shaping.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an environmental sensor based on an integrated optical whispering gallery mode resonator
abstract: We have designed and fabricated integrated optical whispering gallery mode disk resonators in silicon oxy-nitride. We demonstrate their potential as evanescent-field environmental sensors through tests using sucrose solutions and protein suspensions.

articleTitle: Temperature-insensitive ultrafast optical integrated semiconductor switch based on plasma-dispersion effect
abstract: We present novel optical integrated semiconductor switches based on plasma-dispersion effect, which is capable of providing temperature insensitivity and ultrafast temporal response independent from the electronic recombination speed. We show theoretical analysis and experimental results.

articleTitle: Piezoelectricity in (100) III-V semiconductors
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the presence of internal piezoelectric fields in (100)-oriented III-V semiconductor heterostructures. The piezoelectric fields are produced by internal shear strain engineered in InGaAs quantum well microbridges.

articleTitle: Compact 120 TW Ti:sapphire laser with a high gain final amplifier
abstract: A compact 120 TW/36 fs Ti:sapphire chirped pulse amplification laser was established. Using the pumping pulse with accurate synchronization in final amplifier, 5.98 J/220 ps output was achieved for /spl sim/300 mJ incident pulse, the single amplifier gain reaches /spl sim/20.

articleTitle: Semiconductor reflection modulator synchronizes mode-locked fiber oscillators
