abstract: Using the absorption modulation of an optically-driven nonlinear semiconductor mirror, we have synchronized 1.56 /spl mu/m mode-locked erbium fiber laser to the pulse train from a mode-locked ytterbium fiber laser operating at 1.06-/spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Structural and optical studies of In(Ga)P nanowires grown on Si(111) substrates by MOCVD
abstract: We demonstrated the synthesis of In(Ga)P nanowires on silicon using MOCVD at temperatures 350/spl sim/430 /spl deg/C. PL studies on the In(Ga)P nanowires indicate their tenability of optical properties in spite of a large lattice mismatch 8.07%.

articleTitle: LOA based multiwavelength laser source
abstract: We propose a multiwavelength laser source based on a linear optical amplifier (LOA). Thirty eight wavelengths covering C+L-band with 0.8 nm channel spacing are generated at room temperature. Simultaneous tuning of multiwavelengths is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: 622Mbps testing of an 8-channel hyperfine WDM demux with ~ 3 Ghz channel spacing
abstract: We demonstrate an 8-channel ~3 GHz-spaced wavelength demux in hyperfine WDM (HWDM) experiments with 622 Mbps (OC-12) transmission using a virtually-imaged phased-array (VIPA) wavelength demultiplexer. We achieve low power penalties <0.5 dB from adjacent channel crosstalk

articleTitle: Characterization of ultrashort pulses with spatio-temporal and angular resolution
abstract: Recent progress in wavefront autocorrelation of ultrashort pulses is reported. The Shack-Hartmann wavefront sensor concept is extended to spatially resolved autocorrelation. Specific advantages and limitations of system design, dynamic range, and optical components are discussed.

articleTitle: Random quasi phase-matching in bulk polycrystalline zinc selenide
abstract: We experimentally show that the use of random motion of the relative phases in high purity polycrystalline materials (zinc selenide here) may be a good strategy to achieve phase matching in isotropic nonlinear materials.

articleTitle: Interferometric FROG for characterization of few-cycle laser pulses
abstract: We retrieve and evaluate the standard SHG-FROG trace and a new phase-sensitive modulational component from a spectrally resolved interferometric autocorrelation. We demonstrate this novel FROG method with 7.5-fs pulses from a white-light continuum.

articleTitle: Maximum-likelihood surface reconstruction with Viterbi algorithm for volume holographic profilometry
abstract: We use maximum-likelihood (ML) estimation to clean up the depth-variant image blur in volume holographic profilometry and to reconstruct the surface with high accuracy. Viterbi algorithm is used in ML estimation to reduce computational complexity and bit error rate.

articleTitle: Photorefractivity of hafnium-doped congruent lithium niobate crystals
abstract: Reduction of photorefractivity in Hf:LiNbO/sub 3/ crystals is demonstrated to be due to increased photoconductivity; threshold value of HfO/sub 2/ doping is found to be 4 mol %. Heating effects must be carefully considered for measurements interpretation.

articleTitle: Suppression of excited state absorption (ESA) in lasing materials and non-linear optical pulse propagation dynamics in the media subject to ESA
abstract: A method of suppression of excited state absorption (ESA) by means of electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) is proposed. Optical pulse propagation in the medium subject to ESA is considered and relaxation soliton-type solutions are found.

articleTitle: Monolithic PPLN crystal for simultaneous laser Q-switching and parametric oscillation in a Nd:YVO/sub 4/ laser
abstract: We succeed in integrating a low-voltage Pockels cell and an optical parametric gain medium in a periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) monolithic crystal in a diode-pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ laser, producing multi-kilowatt peak power at eye-safe wavelength.

articleTitle: Optical nonlinearities in CdTe quantum-dot doped glass for optical switching
abstract: We have studied the nonlinear absorption and refractive index in CdTe quantum dots in glass. We find that the nonlinearities differ from those of bulk CdTe. An ultrafast polarization-rotation switch with on-off ratio of 42:1 is demonstrated. We showed that quantum confinement lowers the two-photon absorption coefficient and raises the nonlinear refraction index, both of which are good for all-optical switching devices.

articleTitle: 3D photonic bandgap templating using holography and direct laser writing
abstract: We review our work on fabricating templates for photonic band gap materials at telecommunication wavelengths via holography and direct laser writing. Measured optical spectra are compared with theory, revealing the excellent quality of these structures.

articleTitle: Molecular imaging of cancer cells using plasmon-resonant-enhanced third-harmonic-generation microscopy with silver nanoparticles
abstract: We demonstrate molecular-specific third-harmonic-generation microscopy in cultured oral squamous cell carcinoma lines by using silver nano-particles as contrast agent. Through surface plasmon resonance enhancement, cancer cells are clearly identified with their molecular signature.

articleTitle: Loss and the accuracy of the photonic crystal model in holey VCSELs
abstract: A comprehensive parametric study of VCSELs incorporating etched holes for lateral confinement was conducted. Results from over two thousand devices reveal the role of loss and verify the predictive abilities of the photonic crystal model.

articleTitle: Optimized pumping of Nd:YVO/sub 4/ with polarizationinsensitive absorption for high power applications
abstract: We present a method of pumping Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> for high power applications, providing insensitivity to pump polarization state and optimal handling of the thermal load. A high power oscillator and its thermal lensing characteristics are investigated

articleTitle: Doubly-resonant photonic crystal laser: pumping and lasing at low group velocity photonic modes
abstract: In an InP-based two-dimensional photonic crystal slab laser effect is improved 10-fold by optically pumping at a low group velocity mode situated one longitudinal optical phonon energy below the lasing mode.

articleTitle: Spatial coherence of a light beam in a turbid medium
abstract: We study the optical spatial coherence in a turbid medium using the radiative transfer equation. The coherence length of the diffuse light strongly depends on the transport regime. Implications for biological imaging are discussed.

articleTitle: Advances in the performance assessment of a tunable diode laser absorption spectrometer for airborne measurements of CH/sub 2/O
abstract: An airborne tunable diode laser absorption spectrometer was deployed to measure CH/sub 2/O during NASA's 2004 Intercontinental Chemical Transport Experiment. Retrieved time series CH/sub 2/O data are analyzed to assess instrument performance, minimum detection limits, and quality of data.

articleTitle: A single-material glass-web optical fiber
abstract: We present a glass-web fiber waveguide made by the stack and draw method used in photonic crystal fiber manufacturing. Nonlinear behavior such as the cancellation of self-frequency shift are reported.

articleTitle: Measurement of electro-optic coefficients of stoichiometric LiTaO/sub 3/ prepared by vapor transport equilibrium
abstract: The electro-optic coefficients of stoichiometric lithium tantalate were discovered to dramatically depend on electrodes used. r/sub 33/ of 35.8/spl plusmn/0.1 pm/V and 2.0/spl plusmn/0.2pm/V respectively for liquid electrode and Pt electrode were measured using Mach-Zehnder interferometer.

articleTitle: Fiber strain sensor using low reflective fiber Bragg gratings
abstract: Fiber sensor using low reflective FBG was investigated to measure >100 sensing points. Pulsed light with single wavelength using OTDR realized multi-point detection of the strain of the fiber.

articleTitle: Engineering localised plasmons on nanostructured metallic surfaces for surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy
abstract: Reproducible SERS-active substrates with Raman enhancements >10,000 are designed by nano-templating gold and silver surfaces. Optimisation of the surface and localised plasmons matched to the exciting laser provide highly specific control, opening new applications spaces.

articleTitle: Investigation of the carrier dynamics of strain compensated InGaAsN quantum wells
abstract: A quantum dot-like behavior in the dynamics of carrier recombination is observed in InGaAsN quantum wells at temperatures at and below /spl sim/ 150 K. At higher temperatures defect recombination plays a dominant role.

articleTitle: Widely tunable CW and Q-switched operation of thin-rod Yb:YAG laser
abstract: A diode end-pumped, thin-rod, tunable Yb:YAG laser has been developed for CW and Q-switched operation. A wide tuning range of 51 nm for CW and 14 nm for Q-switched operation at 8 kHz was obtained. A high peak power tunable laser is very useful for materials processing applications. In addition, it can be used for efficient wavelength conversion, without the need for temperature control of the non-linear crystal.

articleTitle: Enhanced mode extraction in AlO/sub x//GaAs microcavity pillars and circular gratings
abstract: Here we report enhanced spontaneous emission intensity in AlOx/GaAs micropillars with InGaAs quantum dot (QD) ensemble emitters, measured using photoluminescence (PL). The PL from the QD ensemble was emitted into discrete transverse micropillar modes. We then measured the PL spectrum of pillars whose outer rim is replaced with an increasing number of concentric rings to form a high-order circular grating. As more periods were added to the grating, narrow transverse micropillar mode emission was suppressed and became dominated by a broad grating-extracted mode.

articleTitle: Adaptive optical coherence-domain reflectometry using InGaAs quantum wells
abstract: We demonstrate the possibility to use an InGaAs/GaAs quantum well as an adaptive beam combiner in optical coherence-domain reflectometry (OCDR). The insensitivity of the quantum well to environmental vibrations is compared to that of a non-adaptive system.

articleTitle: Multiphoton in vivo flow cytometry
abstract: Flow cytometry using two-photon excitation is demonstrated for detection of particles and cells circulating in the blood stream of a live mouse. With appropriate dye labeling, two-photon excitation enables quantitative cytometry in vivo.

articleTitle: Broadband femtosecond-seeded optical parametric amplifier based on chirped frequency conversion in MgO:APPLN
abstract: A femtosecond-seeded optical parametric amplifier based on MgO:APPLN is described which employs a chirped-pulse amplification approach to produce a low coherence length, nanosecond output at 1.55 /spl mu/m with >80 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: High-Q buried heterostructure resonators for photonic integrated circuits
abstract: High Q buried ring InGaAsP/lnP resonators and buried waveguide buses form a low loss platform for photonic integrated circuits. Including gain in the resonators or buses enables tunable and narrow line lasers and tunable filters.

articleTitle: A novel PDL-free all-fiber acousto-optic wavelength monitor
abstract: A compact all-fiber wavelength monitor with a resolution of 0.01 nm was demonstrated using a fiber acousto-optic tunable filter. The polarization-dependent wavelength shift was eliminated through the use of a fiber Sagnac interferometer

articleTitle: Determining thickness independently from optical constants using ultrafast spectral interferometry
abstract: We show that the application of ultrafast techniques, specially femtosecond lasers, allow simultaneous measurements of material thickness and optical constants from transmission measurements using a frequency interferometer.

articleTitle: Generation of high average power, 7.5-fs blue pulses at 5 kHz by adaptive phase control
abstract: High average power (1 W), 7.5-fs blue pulses have been generated at 5 kHz from broadband frequency doubling of a spectrally-broadened Ti:sapphire laser by using adaptive phase control with genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Second-harmonic characterization of Si/Hf(/sub 1-x/)Si/sub x/O/sub 2/ interfaces
abstract: We present a second-harmonic generation study of a set of device quality Si/Hf(/sub 1-x/)Si/sub x/O/sub 2/ interfaces for different x values and annealing treatments. Rotationally-anisotropic, spectroscopic and time-dependent SHG depend strongly on dielectric composition and annealing.

articleTitle: Optical-feedback-delay dependence of power dropouts in vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
abstract: The influence of delay time on low-frequency fluctuations (LFF) in external-cavity vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers is studied experimentally. With increased external cavity length the average period of LFF increases linearly and power dropouts occur more regularly.

articleTitle: All optical histology using femtosecond laser pulses
abstract: We discuss the use of femtosecond laser pulses for serial histology. Successive iterations of multiphoton imaging and ablation provide diffraction-limited volumetric data that is used to reconstruct the architectonics of labeled cells or microvasculature.

articleTitle: InP based colliding pulse mode locked laser synchronized by electrical subharmonic hybrid mode locking
abstract: We report electrical subharmonic hybrid mode locking of an InP colliding pulse mode locked laser emitting low-jitter, nearly transform-limited 1.26 ps output pulses at 28 GHz with optimized RF and DC biasing conditions.

articleTitle: Optimization of the performance of frequency-modulated DFB semiconductor laser: theory and experiment
abstract: We have developed a model of frequency modulated DFB laser with intra-cavity phase modulator and identified the combination of parameters leading to high FM efficiency. The results of our initial experiments support these conclusions.

articleTitle: Quantitative evaluation of nanoshells as a contrast agent for optical coherence tomography
abstract: We have quantitatively assessed the effectiveness of nanoshells to enhance the quality of optical coherence tomography images. Depending on the scattering characteristics of the sample, nanoshells can increase image signal intensities by 2-5 decibels.

articleTitle: Continuous wave four wave mixing in a holey fiber with two zero dispersion wavelengths using a fiber integrated configuration
abstract: We demonstrate CW four-wave mixing in a holey fiber with two zero dispersion wavelengths using a fiber integrated configuration. The generated signal power is 1.6 mW at a wavelength of 1013 nm.

articleTitle: Efficient photoconductive THz source with spatially shaped excitation
abstract: Reduced screening and improved efficiency in terahertz power generation are achieved by line excitation of photoconductive sources. Screening limitations are explored computationally to optimize the source with highest efficiency reported to date.

articleTitle: Shining infrared light on isotope ratio measurements in applications from earthbound to the atmospheric
abstract: We present accurate water isotope ratio measurements using DFB diode lasers in laboratory based studies in biomedicine, paleoclimatology (ice-cores), and ecology (plant leave water), to airborne, in-situ, stratospheric measurements using optical-feedback cavity enhanced absorption spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Linear electro-optic conversion of sampled voltage signals using a low-temperature-grown GaAs MSM and a multiple quantum well modulator
abstract: We present the hybrid integration of a low-temperature-grown GaAs metal-semiconductor-metal photoconductive switch with a GaAs SEED optical modulator, for sampling input voltages with potentially >40-GHz bandwidth and performing linear electro-optic conversion at a rate >500 megasamples/sec.

articleTitle: Temporal evolution of self-phase modulation dynamics in a semiconductor optical amplifier under multiwavelength pulse amplification
abstract: The temporal evolution of self-phase modulation dynamics in a semiconductor optical amplifier is studied for the amplification of multiwavelength pulses using pump-probe techniques. Two photon absorption and four wave mixing effects are observed as well.

articleTitle: High-power optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier system with 1.6-/spl mu/m signal and 1.064-/spl mu/m pump
abstract: Optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifiers utilizing a 300-ps Nd:YAG pump system, a tunable 1.6-/spl mu/m fiber signal, and KNbO/sub 3/, KTA, RTP, or BBO nonlinear crystals were designed and built. Gain >10/sup 9/, and peak powers >30 GW were obtained.

articleTitle: Organic semiconductor based two-dimensional photonic crystal with a single defect
abstract: A two-dimensional organic photonic crystal with a single defect was fabricated on silicon dioxide membranes. Light emission from the single defect in the organic photonic crystal was observed for the first time.

articleTitle: Optical phase locking among multi-color femtosecond pulses for Fourier synthesis
abstract: We have generated phase-coherent multicolor femtosecond pulses by using an optical parametric oscillator and a two-wavelength laser consisting of Ti:sapphire and Cr:forsterite lasers for an attosecond pulse train generation by Fourier synthesis.

articleTitle: Single cell detection using a microfluidic, passive, Fabry-Perot interferometer based biosensor
abstract: Polystyrene spheres, yeast cells, and blood cells in a microfluidic Fabry-Perot cavity constructed using thermocompressive gold bonding show unique transmission spectra that can be used for differentiation and are approximately consistent with modeling results.

articleTitle: Optimisation of NOPA output pulse shaping using an AOPDF with dispersion self-correction
abstract: Shaping of ultrashort visible pulses (500-680 nm) has been performed using an acousto-optic programmable dispersive filter. 50% diffraction efficiency, pulse duration shorter than 30 fs and pulse shaping on 4 ps have been obtained.

articleTitle: Thin-film double-side heat removal laser diodes
abstract: Effective heat removal is a key factor to achieve high-efficiency and high-power lasers. We propose a new thin-film double-side heat removal laser diode scheme and demonstrate some initial results in fabricating the thin-film laser.

articleTitle: Sorting and identification of food-borne microorganisms using Raman-tweezers spectroscopy
abstract: We demonstrated that food-borne bacteria and microorganisms existing in aqueous environment can be rapidly discriminated from the other food particles by Raman spectroscopy and sorted to a new chamber by optical manipulation.

articleTitle: Base rate electrical clock recovery and demultiplexing of 40 Gb/s OTDM signals with injection locked Fabry-Perot laser and electronic feedback
abstract: We demonstrate stable base rate electrical clock recovery at 10 GHz from 40 Gb/s OTDM data streams using an injection locked Fabry-Perot laser diode with electronic feedback and show 40 to 10 Gb/s demultiplexing after fiber transmission using the recovered clock

articleTitle: Polaritonic bandgap materials fabricated and tested with femtosecond laser machining and polariton imaging
abstract: We have fabricated photonic bandgap materials for THz radiation, generated THz waves by impulsive stimulated Raman scattering, and imaged the spatio-temporal evolution of the fields within the structures with polariton imaging

articleTitle: Demonstration of a microwave spectrum analyzer based on time domain processing of ultrafast pulses
abstract: We perform microwave spectrum analysis by dispersing ultrashort pulses to several nanoseconds in duration. Modulating with an arbitrary microwave signal and correlating with a reference provides an output trace containing a discrete version of the microwave spectrum.

articleTitle: Waveguide-enhanced THz parametric generation and oscillation in thin lithium niobate wafers
abstract: We observed 2-time efficiency increase in THz parametric generation when reducing the thickness of a lithium-niobate waveguide from 1 to 0.5 mm. Efficient THz emitted from such a waveguide OPO with an intracavity grazing-incidence grating.

articleTitle: Analysis of interchannel crosstalk in a dispersion-managed analog transmission link
abstract: Using small-signal linearization, we obtain an expression for crosstalk in a dispersion-managed analog link including loss and gain. Our theory is validated both by full simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Solid-immersion imaging of a silicon flip-chip with a resolution of 325 nm using the optical-beam induced current method
abstract: We report high resolution solid-immersion sub-surface imaging of a flip-chip by detecting the two-photon photocurrent generated by a 1530 nm femtosecond Er:fiber laser. Features show high contrast and a resolution of 325 nm.

articleTitle: InGaN-based quantum-well LEDs: explanation of anomalous electro-optical characteristics
abstract: Charge transport and luminescence in InGaN-based short-wavelength light-emitting diodes feature some anomalies: 1) low-temperature quenching of luminescence yield; 2) very large ideality factor of I-V curves. These observations are explained in terms of electron ballistic overflow and injection-induced conductivity on p-side.

articleTitle: Fabrication of waveguide-based vibration sensors by femtosecond laser micromachining
abstract: We report on the fabrication of vibration sensors using femtosecond laser-micromachined waveguides. We micromachine an optically connected waveguide across three pieces of glass using a nJ high-repetition rate femtosecond laser oscillator in a transverse writing geometry. The three pieces are placed in close proximity of one another such that there is low loss across the segmented waveguide. The middle piece is mounted on a flexible beam and hence is affected by external forces. Vibration and acceleration are detected by monitoring the induced change in transmission through the assembly. These sensors have a linear frequency response to input vibrations and an acceleration sensitivity below 0.01 m/s/sup 2/. Moreover, the sensors exhibit a negligible temperature dependence, overcoming a serious limitation encountered in the widely used fiber Bragg grating optical sensors.

articleTitle: 20 GHz colliding pulse mode-locking of InGaAs quantum dot lasers
abstract: Colliding pulse mode-locking is demonstrated for the first time in quantum-dot lasers. Close to transform limited, 7 ps, 20 GHz pulses are achieved using an absorber length considerably longer than typically used in similar quantum-well lasers.

articleTitle: Cascaded second order nonlinearity for the generation of blue/green laser using ZnO:PPLN crystal fiber
abstract: A novel technique, using cascaded first-order second harmonic generation and third-order sum frequency generation in a ZnO:PPLN crystal fiber, was demonstrated for the generation of tunable blue/green laser from 471.3 nm to 515 nm.

articleTitle: A novel mid-infrared light emitting device
abstract: A new cw light source for the mid-infrared with output powers exceeding 1 mW is described. It is based on an optically pumped narrow gap semiconductor. For efficient light extraction optimised surface structure is adopted

articleTitle: Plasma sources & sensors of near terahertz radiation
abstract: Terahertz radiation from optically-induced plasmas on metal, semiconductor, and dielectric surfaces is compared to electron-hole plasma radiation from GaAs and Ge. Electro-optic sampling and electric-field probes measure radiated field waveforms and distributions to 0.350 THz.

articleTitle: Raman-mediated pulsed amplification in silicon wires
abstract: We present the first full theoretical study of pulsed stimulated Raman scattering in silicon wires. Free carrier and two-photon absorption effects are included. Raman amplification and pulse interaction are also discussed

articleTitle: Analysis of supercontinuum generation in soft glass photonic crystal fibers with cross-correlation frequency-resolved optical gating
abstract: Initial stages of supercontinuum generation in SF6 extruded photonic crystal fiber are experimentally studied with X-FROG and spectral measurements. Self-steepening is clearly observed and its role in generation of anti-Stokes blue shifted spectral components is highlighted.

articleTitle: Size-, position-, and separation-controlled one-dimensional alignment of nanoparticles using an optical near field
abstract: Colloidal gold nanoparticles were aligned with the desired position and separation on the edge of a Si wedge by controlling the particle-substrate and particle-particle interactions using an optical near field.

articleTitle: Microfluidics with near infrared fluid handling
abstract: We have constructed a near infrared optical system to induce thermal gradients sufficient to controllably manipulate small aqueous droplets. We have fused droplets, and observed rapid mixing, and absorption changes from a biological assay.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional multicolored periodic-wave arrays generation in a quadratic nonlinear medium
abstract: Two-dimensional multicolored periodic-wave arrays were observed in a quadratic nonlinear medium. By seeding with weak second harmonic pulses, the arrays could be controlled and demonstrated independence upon the relative phase of the seeded pulses.

articleTitle: Fabrication of all-epitaxial semiconductor laser using selective interface fermi-level pinning
abstract: All epitaxial fully planarized GaAs based semiconductor lasers are demonstrated using a selective Fermi-level pinning at a heterointerface. The results show that this method provides efficient self-aligned current- and mode-confinement and mode controllability by intracavity patterning.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics of femtosecond laser-modified fused silica - applications to waveguide fabrication
abstract: Absorption and photoluminescence spectroscopy, and third-harmonic confocal microscopy are used for the first time to characterize the linear and non-linear properties, crucial for the fabrication of active elements, of femtosecond laser-written waveguides in fused silica.

articleTitle: Label-free optical sensing of proteins with porous silicon microcavities
abstract: We demonstrate a label free optical biosensor based on macroporous silicon microcavity. The biosensor is tested and characterized by using the streptavidin-biotin couple as a model system.

articleTitle: Nanoporous semiconductor-based metamaterials
abstract: Growth of periodic nanoporous CdTe and ZnO metamaterials is developed and characterised. We model the induced birefringence and measure the charge transport and density of surface states in the films.

articleTitle: New hetero-bonding crystal YAG/spl par/SYS:Yb, from the cw to the fs diode-pumped laser operation
abstract: We report the first cw and femtosecond laser operations of a diffusion-bonding hetero-composite Yb-doped crystal: Yb/sup 3+/:SrY/sub 4/(SiO/sub 4/)/sub 3/O/spl par/Y/sub 2/Al/sub 5/O/sub 12/ {YAG/spl par/SYS:Yb}. 130-fs pulses at 1070 nm have been obtained in the watt range.

articleTitle: Strong near-ultraviolet and blue emissions at room temperature from In-rich InGaN/GaN multi-quantum well structures
abstract: We obtained strong near-UV and blue emissions at room temperature from In-rich InGaN/GaN MQW structures. We believe that use of less than 2-nm-thick In-rich InGaN QW layer can be a new candidate for near-UV and visible sources, which might replace the conventional Ga-rich, thicker InGaN QW layer.

articleTitle: An intelligent, synchronously pumped optical parametric oscillator using adaptive pulse-shaping techniques
abstract: We present a synchronously pumped optical parametric oscillator whose output characteristics have been controlled using adaptive pulse-shaping techniques. The principles for applying adaptive-control are explored, including the use of simulated-annealing algorithms and various feedback parameters.

articleTitle: InAs/AlGaSb quantum cascade lasers
abstract: We report our recent experimental results on mid-infrared InAs/AlGaSb quantum cascade lasers. InAs/AlGaSb superlattice structures that provide large oscillator strength are used as active layers. Observed minimum threshold current density is 0.42kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and the maximum operation temperature is 270K

articleTitle: 1.2 degree narrow divergence intense directional lasing from extremely deformed non-circular micro-ring cavities
abstract: Ultra-narrow divergence directional lasing with high Q factor was observed from a peanut-shaped ring cavity. The 1.2 degree divergence was one order less than the best published results. Emission direction was also controllable.

articleTitle: Short-wavelength ultraviolet light-emitting diodes based on AlGaN
abstract: We review our progress toward realization of highly-efficient ultraviolet light-emitting diodes (UV LEDs) based on high Al-composition Al/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/N. Milliwatt level optical output powers have been measured at wavelengths as short as 247 nm.

articleTitle: Fizeau optical coherence tomography: sensitivity optimization and system analysis
abstract: We demonstrate a compact all-fiber Fizeau OCT system and theoretically analyze sensitivity optimization in unbalanced and balanced detection. Interestingly, our analysis predicts existence of unusually high beat noise in Fizeau OCT as compared to the conventional OCT.

articleTitle: Linear-polarization, CW generation of 60 W power in a single-mode, Tm fibre laser
abstract: Stable, 60 W average power, single-mode CW generation in the spectral range 1800-2050 nm in linear-polarization format is achieved in Tm-doped fibre pumped at 1567 nm. Polarization extinction ratios in excess of 23 dB are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generation of terahertz radiation from photoconductive switch on zinc oxide single crystal
abstract: Terahertz pulses generated from photoconductive switch fabricated on zinc oxide (ZnO) single crystal is presented. High transparent nature of ZnO in visible, near-infrared, mid-infrared and terahertz regions will pave the way for integrated active optics.

articleTitle: Transition between parametric and raman oscillation in high-Q silica toroidal microcavities
abstract: A controlled and reversible transition between parametric and Raman oscillation in a high-Q silica toroidal microcavity is demonstrated. By changing cavity loading and frequency detuning, parametric or Raman oscillation can be accessed without any modification of cavity geometry

articleTitle: Enhancement of laser assisted fabrication of devices by a thin film two-photon absorbing filter
abstract: Multiphoton processes are playing a significant role in micro fabrication, patterning of nanostructures. We show that significantly reduced spot sizes are achieved through the use of various thickness of a thin film nonlinear absorbing filter.

articleTitle: 990 mW average power, 52% efficient, high-repetition-rate picosecond pulse generation in the blue with BiB/sub 3/O/sub 6/
abstract: Efficient high-average-power picosecond pulse generation in the blue is reported in BiB/sub 3/O/sub 6/ for the first time. Single-pass conversion efficiencies of 52% and average powers as much as 990 mW have been generated in 2.8-ps pulses tunable over 375-445 nm at 76 MHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: 136-fs pulses from a passively mode-locked Yb:YAG laser
abstract: We generate 136-fs pulses from a passively mode-locked diode-pumped Yb:YAG laser. This is to our knowledge the shortest pulse from a Yb:YAG laser. To obtain a broader spectrum, we shift the laser center wavelength to 1050 nm.

articleTitle: Microring resonators for biochemical sensing
abstract: A vertically coupled glass microring resonator biosensor is introduced with Q /spl sim/ 12000. Wc demonstrated sensitivity to refractive index change in medium and reproducibility. Theoretical refractive index sensitivity from flow experiments is determined to be 2/spl times/10/sup -5/.

articleTitle: InGaAsP/InP dual wavelength bipolar cascade lasers with 100 nm wavelength spacing
abstract: Simultaneous dual-wavelength (1350 nm and 1450 nm) lasing is achieved from an InGaAsP/InP bipolar cascade laser, which includes two different active regions and a low resistance hetero-tunnel-junction. Ultra-broadband gain materials can be obtained with such a structure.

articleTitle: Writing optical waveguides with a 0.1-5 MHz repetition rate femtosecond fiber laser
abstract: A novel femtosecond Yb-fiber laser with variable repetition rate of 0.1 to 5 MHz is shown to control the onset of heat accumulation effects instrumental in forming symmetric and low-loss optical waveguides in borosilicate glasses.

articleTitle: Optofluidic microscopy
abstract: This research aims to integrate optical microscopy with microfluidic systems and create a device which is potentially capable of achieving sub wavelength resolution. This paper reports on our initial results of this optofluidic microscope (OFM).

articleTitle: Nonlinear beam propagation in quadratic nonlinear materials
abstract: Quadratically [/spl chi//sup (2)/] media have historically been used to generate new frequencies. Although textbook analysis has focused on small conversion with plane waves, many additional effects (cascading, beam distortion, multi-soliton generation, etc.) occur for high intensity, finite beams. They will be explained and reviewed.

articleTitle: Very low threshold, carrier- and index-confined semiconductor lasers by one single selective-area-growth
abstract: We demonstrated very low threshold carrier- and index-confined semiconductor lasers made of a single selective-area-growth without regrowths. The threshold current is as low as 2.7 mA with excellent uniformity and reproducibility.

articleTitle: Development of a novel femtosecond micromachining workstation using spectral interferometry
abstract: A workstation that enables real-time measurement of the ablation depth while micromachining with femtosecond laser pulses is demonstrated. This method uses spectral interferometry to measure the ablation depth while cutting with an amplified pulse.

articleTitle: Biochemical sensors using high-Q polymer microring resonators fabricated by an imprinting technique
abstract: High Q-factor polymer microrings, fabricated using imprinting technique, were demonstrated as biochemical sensors. They could provide label-free detection and capability of detecting small and large biomolecules with a detection limit as small as 250 pg/mm/sup 2/.

articleTitle: Oscillation property of disk-type Nd/Cr:YAG ceramic lasers with quasi-solar pumping
abstract: Lasing of highly sensitized Nd/Cr:YAG ceramic disk with imitated solar radiation pumping has been observed. The material is promising for space solar power station because of its scalability on high power density handling capability.

articleTitle: 80 Gb/s optical clock recovery using two-photon absorption
abstract: We report a polarization-insensitive optical clock recovery system that uses two-photon absorption in a silicon photodiode to synchronize a 10 GHz optical clock to an 80 Gb/s RZ data signal

articleTitle: First demonstration of a diode-pumped gas (alkali vapor) laser
abstract: We report the first diode-pumped gas laser-rubidium vapor. A short cell charged with a Rb/ethane/He mixture pumped at 780 nm produced several mW in a near-confocal cavity. Issues involved in power-scaling will be discussed

articleTitle: Low optical overlap mode (LOOM) propagation in InP nanoscale membrane waveguides
abstract: A guided low optical overlap mode (LOOM) has a modal confinement factor below 1% and potential for extremely low loss. We demonstrate TM LOOM propagation in planar 50-nm-thick InP membrane waveguides and compare to theory.

articleTitle: Investigation of laser-induced damage in KDP crystals under simultaneous exposure to laser harmonics
abstract: We investigate the laser-induced damage behavior of KDP and DKDP crystals under simultaneous multi-wavelength irradiation as a function of laser fluences to approximate conditions during frequency conversion. Our results reveal fundamental behaviors of damage initiation

articleTitle: Surface-emitted THz-wave generation from two-dimensional PPLN
abstract: We report on the demonstration of surface-emitted THz-wave DFG from a two-dimensional (2D) PPLN. The two orthogonal periodic structures individually compensate for both the phase mismatch of the launched lasers and generated THz-wave.

articleTitle: Femtosecond filamentation in air at low pressures
abstract: We investigate the influence of air pressure on femtosecond filamentation in the laboratory, in the pressure range between 0.2 and 1 bar. Numerical simulations reproduce the main features of the experimental results.

articleTitle: UVLED based on carrier localization in AlGaN
abstract: AlGaN samples show intense room temperature photoluminescence from localized states that is significantly red-shifted, 200-400 meV, from band edge. Double-heterostructure light-emitting diodes were fabricated using this unique layer, with electroluminescence peak at 325 nm.

articleTitle: Accurate measurement of pulse power in low duty cycle MOPA
abstract: There can be a significant amount of interpulse signal present in low-duty cycle MOPA. This requires that both spectral and temporal filtering be used to accurately determine signal power within the pulse width.

articleTitle: Three dimensional waveguide splitters fabricated in glass using a femtosecond laser oscillator
abstract: Three-dimensional optical waveguide devices are fabricated in glass using femtosecond pulses from an extended cavity Ti:sapphire laser oscillator. We demonstrate increased device densities by fabricating highly symmetric 1:N waveguide splitters in three dimensions.

articleTitle: High speed, ultrahigh resolution retinal imaging using spectral/Fourier domain OCT
abstract: High speed, ultrahigh resolution OCT retinal imaging using spectral/Fourier detection enables /spl sim/2 um axial resolutions and /spl sim/24,000 axial scans/second. These high speeds and resolutions achieve dramatic improvements in image quality and enable 3D OCT imaging.

articleTitle: Integrated microcavity klystrons for generating high power coherent terahertz radiation
abstract: Theoretical and experimental results are presented to show that integrated microcavity klystrons can be used to generate high power (1-100 mW) coherent radiation in the 0.5-2.0 THz frequency range at room temperature.

articleTitle: 1.8 micron continuous-wave Raman laser
abstract: A diode-pumped, far-off-resonance cw Raman laser emitting at 1.8 micron is reported. Producing tunable and narrow-linevvidth laser light. CW Raman laser is an attractive laser source at near and mid-infrared

articleTitle: Dispersion micro-managed holey fiber and coherent blue-violet continuum generation
abstract: Sub-mm scale dispersion micro-management is introduced and demonstrated to generate coherent blue-violet continuum in a short holey fiber. The longitudinal variations of phase-matching conditions of Cherenkov radiation and four-wave mixing are the reasons.

articleTitle: Near field effects in visible and UV laser assisted deposition of DLC
abstract: Near-field enhanced deposition of diamond-like carbon (DLC) films on tungsten nanoscale tips were achieved by a CW green argon laser in liquid benzene and by a UV excimer laser in benzene gas vapor ambient.

articleTitle: Backward quasi phase matched second harmonic generation in sub-micron periodically poled KTiOPO/sub 4/
abstract: 1 mm thick KTiOPO/sub 4/ was poled with 720 nm domain period by employing UV-lithography, chemical patterning and electric field poling. The structure was used to demonstrate 6 and 7 order quasi-phase matched backward second harmonic generation.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse propagation in a high index inclusion microstructured optical fiber
abstract: We experimentally and numerically investigate femtosecond pulse propagation in high index inclusion microstructured optical fibers, which feature both, a resonant dispersion with strong wavelength dependence and a high nonlinearity.

articleTitle: A 600 MHz octave-spanning femtosecond laser for optical frequency measurements and comparisons
abstract: We demonstrate a self-referenced 600 MHz, octave-spanning laser capable of measuring beat signals against atomic standards over an optical bandwidth from (532 nm - 1200 nm) without additional broadening in optical fiber.

articleTitle: Measurement system for the high-throughput characterization of metal nanoparticles for biosensors
abstract: We present a system for the rapid characterization of nanoparticles for biosensors, providing concurrent atomic force microscopy and scattering spectra of individual nanoparticles and simultaneous spectra from various nanostructures created by electron beam lithography.

articleTitle: Multi-color spatial solitons through seeded optical parametric amplification tailored with chirped-period quasi-phase-matching gratings
abstract: We demonstrate the tailoring of quadratic spatial solitons using chirped gratings of periodically-poled lithium niobate, providing a method for creating solitons at large wavevector mismatch that are difficult to launch in uniform crystals.

articleTitle: Temperature dependent performance of 1.55 /spl mu/m AlGaInAs laser diodes
abstract: 1.55 /spl mu/m AlGaInAs multi-quantum-well lasers with varying quantum well strain and number of quantum wells are studied. Results show that high strain and more quantum wells lead to a high T/sub 0/ and high injection efficiency.

articleTitle: Nanolayer characterization through wavelength multiplexing a microsphere resonator
abstract: Hydrogel nanolayer (<150 nm) formation on a silica microsphere is optically characterized while forming in situ by simultaneously following the shifts of whispering gallery modes at two wavelengths.

articleTitle: Evaluating the quantum confinement effect of isolated ZnO nanorod single-quantum-well structures using near-field ultraviolet photoluminescence spectroscopy
abstract: Using low-temperature near-field spectroscopy of ZnO nanorod single-quantum-well structures, the dependence of the quantum confinement effect of the photoluminescence peak on the well width was observed and the homogeneous linewidth was determined as 3 meV.

articleTitle: Accurate prediction of Q vs. OSNR for linear and nonlinear propagation
abstract: We investigate the effects of self-phase-modulation on the pulse characteristics of an RZ channel in a WDM loop. Even in the case of significant spectral broadening, the Q-value can be predicted from the linear theory.

articleTitle: High power /spl lambda/ = 9 /spl mu/m quantum cascade lasers
abstract: We report high performance InP -based quantum-cascade-lasers, processed with electroplated-gold-layer to improve heat dissipation. Devices with back-facet high-reflection-coated show maximum output power of 175mW at 40% duty cycle at 300K and CW operation up to 270K

articleTitle: Surface-emitted continuous THz-wave generation from PPLN
abstract: The operating principles and a practical demonstration of surface-emitted THz waves via difference frequency mixing are discussed. We developed periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) THz-wave generators and an optical source based on 1.5-/spl mu/m diode lasers.

articleTitle: Photoelectrochemical oxidation enhances optical output power in GaN-based light emitting diodes
abstract: Using the photoelectrochemical (PEC) oxidation process, the output power was increased by about 40%, caused by a reduced index reflectance from the GaN material to the outside air, and an increased roughness in the oxidized sidewalls. In addition, the enhanced output power was decreased when the PEC oxidation time was increased. These PEC treated InGaN/GaN MQW LEDs are suitable for all Nitride-based LED lighting applications.

articleTitle: High power tunable femtosecond pulse source based on amplification in Tm fiber
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable (1930-2018 nm and 965-1009 nm) femtosecond source based on amplification in Tm fiber. Average powers of 1.8 W and 530 mW are obtained at 1994 nm and 997 nm, respectively.

articleTitle: Variation of the amplitude modulation transfer across the locking range of a DFB semiconductor laser
abstract: The magnitude of the modulation of a DFB laser output that is injection locked with an amplitude modulated signal is measured across its locking range. This magnitude is used to stabilize the locking process.

articleTitle: Time-resolved measurement of Raman amplification in highly confined silicon-on-insulator waveguides
abstract: We show ultra-fast Raman gain dynamics in submicron-size SOI strip waveguide. Using high confinement structures and pico-second pump pulses, we show 6-dB net nonlinear gain with 20.7-W peak pump power in a 7-mm long waveguide.

articleTitle: Real-time ultrahigh-resolution lateral-priority OCT imaging with a broad spectrum throughput acousto-optic modulation
abstract: We describe a generic method to optimize the optical spectrum throughput of acousto-optic modulators for performing real-time lateral-priority OCT imaging with an axial resolution of /spl sim/2.3 /spl mu/m. Ultrahigh-resolution imaging of biological tissues is demonstrated.

articleTitle: True time delay w/3D MEMs
abstract: A fiber delay integrated switch (FIDELIS) photonic beamformer using a large optical switch allows compact implementation of true time delay for phased array radars. The use of a three-level subarray architecture enables very large beamformer arrays using only a small number of photonic time delays.

articleTitle: High power ultrafast fibre laser in the 920 nm spectral range
abstract: We describe an ultrafast Nd-doped fibre laser capable of generating 170 fs pulses in the 920 nm spectral range with output power of 0.8 W.

articleTitle: Coded excitation of broadband terahertz using optical rectification in poled lithium niobate
abstract: We demonstrate coded excitation of broadband terahertz using optical rectification in poled lithium niobate patterned with a 53-bit binary phase code. Digital pulse compression produces near single-cycle terahertz pulses at 1.2 THz.

articleTitle: All-UV time-resolved CARS
abstract: Time-resolved, coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering from internal vibrations in calcite is reported with all the wavelengths in the ultraviolet. Two-photon absorption, excitation-dependent dephasing times, and a comparison of ultraviolet and visible efficiencies are described

articleTitle: Large mode area Nd-doped single transverse mode dual wavelength microstructured fiber laser (NFL)
abstract: We demonstrate a MFL with a single 5-air-hole annulus yielding a 280-mW output power at 52% slope efficiency. This high efficiency is attributed to a novel doping process and a special design of the MFL

articleTitle: Photonic-crystal-fiber-based femtosecond parametric oscillator with 200 nm tunability around 1/spl mu/m
abstract: Pulses as short as /spl sim/460 fs, tuning range as wide as /spl sim/200 nm around 1/spl mu/m have been achieved from a photonic-crystal-fiber-based parametric oscillator by using the modulation instability gain in normal dispersion regime.

articleTitle: Optical properties of SiO/sub x/ nanostructured films by pulsed-laser deposition
abstract: SiO/sub x/ nanostructured films were formed by pulsed-laser deposition (PLD) of Si. The photoluminescence band at 1.6-2.1 eV shifts with ambient gas pressure, substrate temperature and post-deposition processing, which supports the quantum confinement effect theory.

articleTitle: THz Bragg grating in a parallel plate metal waveguide
abstract: A Bragg grating is lithographically fabricated, and inserted into a parallel plate metal waveguide. THz time-domain spectroscopy is used to study the effects of the Bragg grating and frequency selection is observed.

articleTitle: Microjoule picosecond laser pulses from a diode-pumped oscillator with cavity-dumping
abstract: A diode-pumped Nd:YVO/sub 4/ picosecond laser oscillator with electro-optical cavity dumping generates pulses with energies of up to 3.5 /spl mu/J/1.8 /spl mu/J at dumping frequencies of 0.4 MHz/1 MHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Unidirectional beam emission from confocal quasi-stadium laser diodes
abstract: Unidirectional beam emission was obtained from strained InGaAsP multiple-quantum-well quasi-stadium laser diodes. The unidirectional beam emission can be explained by the phase locking of two resonator modes with different symmetry classes.

articleTitle: Nonlinear effects due to interface modes in a hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
abstract: We report strong nonlinear effects when launching fs laser pulses into hollow-core PCF. They result from the large overlap of interface modes with the glass surrounding the core.

articleTitle: Stimulated emission in the blue from dense arrays of InGaN MQWs nanoposts
abstract: Emission from dense arrays of sub-100 nm nanoposts embedding InGaN MQW active gain media has been investigated. Strong microscale stimulated emission has been observed near 400 nm wavelength in this "resonatorless", subwavelength size system.

articleTitle: Laser activity at 1.18, 1.07, and 0.97 /spl mu/m and depopulation mechanisms of the lower laser levels in Nd/sup 3+/ doped KPb/sub 2/Br/sub 5/ and RbPb/sub 2/Br/sub 5/
abstract: Laser activity has been achieved in low-phonon energy, moisture-resistant neodymium-doped bromide host crystals, also resulting from the /sup 4/F/sub 5/2/+/sup 2/H/sub 9/2/ level for the first time in any solid-state material. Pump-probe spectra reveal mechanisms feasible for more efficient laser operation.

articleTitle: High-power terahertz radiation source based on difference frequency mixing of CO/sub 2/ laser lines
abstract: A /spl sim/2 MW, 250 ps terahertz pulse was generated in a noncollinear phase-matched GaAs crystal at room temperature. Tunable CO/sub 2/ lasers in combination with this technique should yield a source in the 0.1 -3.0 THz range.

articleTitle: MOVPE grown quantum cascade lasers: single mode performance and structural quality
abstract: We report single longitudinal mode, T> 300K operation of MOVPE-grown InGaAs/ AlInAs DFB quantum cascade lasers. Structural investigation indicates the epitaxial quality of the active region to be equivalent to high performance MBE grown structures

articleTitle: ISI equalization for a coherent optical MIMO (COMIMO) system
abstract: We report the first demonstration of coherent optical MIMO utilizing adaptive equalization for ISI. Coherent optics implementation is essential to ensure the necessary diversity and hence MIMO benefits, independent of fiber length and data rate.

articleTitle: Combination of AFM with IR-ATR spectroscopy for measurements in liquid environment
abstract: We present the instrumental combination of atomic force microscopy with infrared attenuated total reflectance spectroscopy. This is the first time to demonstrate AFM scanning while recording IR-spectra in a liquid environment.

articleTitle: Prospects of wide-gap fluoride hetero-structures for deep ultraviolet optical devices
abstract: The variation of band gap energy and band structure with respect to composition of Li/sub (1-x)/K/sub x/Ba/sub (1-y)/Mg/sub y/F/sub 3/ perovskite-like fluorides is investigated. Analysis of energy chart shows the feasibility of fabricating Li/sub (1-x)/K/sub x/Ba/sub (1-y)/Mg/sub y/F/sub 3/ on either LiBaF/sub 3/ or KMgF/sub 3/.

articleTitle: An analytic technique for investigating mode-locked lasers
abstract: We present an analytic theory capable of predicting pulse parameters in mode-locked lasers in the presence of dispersion and nonlinearity. Excellent agreement is obtained between this approach and full numerical solutions.

articleTitle: Development of cw-diode pumped amplifier for over 1-kW-average-power solid-state laser system
abstract: We have developed and evaluated a cw-diode pumped amplifier for a high-average-power solid-state laser system. The output of the amplifiers reaches an average power of 1 kW with a 10-kHz repetition rate at 1064-nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Multiple period resonances of long period gratings in photonic crystal fiber
abstract: A comprehensive eigenmode analysis is performed of the guided modes supported by typical photonic crystal fiber. These modes exhibit unusual phase matching conditions requiring multiple grating periods for resonant coupling. All the signature features of the experimentally observed transmission spectra are explained by multiple-period resonances.

articleTitle: Power scaling of diode end-pumped Nd:YAG lasers via multi-segmented rods
abstract: A method for scaling end-pumped rod lasers to high output powers by employing multi-segmented crystals is presented. In first experiments, an output power of 137 W was achieved with 52% optical-to-optical efficiency.

articleTitle: Proof-of-concept free-space 3D all-optical cross-connect based on 3-state MEMS
abstract: We demonstrate a 4/spl times/8 free-space 3D OXC architecture based on a White cell that uses a digital MEMS. We use manually reconfigurable mirrors for the MEMS. Experimental loss, redundancy and beam quality results are presented.

articleTitle: Sagnac loop interferometer using polarization maintaining photonic crystal fiber
abstract: A Sagnac loop interferometer using polarization maintaining (PM) photonic crystal fiber was experimentally demonstrated and analyzed. Different filtering functions and reduced temperature dependence were observed. Experimental results agree well with simulations.

articleTitle: Very efficient diode-pumped Yb/sup 3+/:Y/sub 2/SiO/sub 5/ and Yb/sup 3+/: Lu/sub 2/SiO/sub 5/ femtosecond laser
abstract: We report the mode-locked operation of the two Yb-doped oxyorthosilicates Y/sub 2/SiO/sub 5/ (YSO) and Lu/sub 2/SiO/sub 5/ (LSO). YSO provided 122 fs pulses at 1040 nm, with an average power of 410 mW. LSO provided up to 2.6 W at 1058 nm, with 260 fs pulses, corresponding to an optical-to-optical efficiency greater than 17%.

articleTitle: 10x voltage reduction in an electrooptic prism scanner in thin-film LiNbO/sub 3/ using crystal-ion-slicing
abstract: We demonstrate a 10x reduction in the driving voltage of an electrooptical scanner in LiNbO/sub 3/. The scanner is made by exfoliating a 10/spl mu/m thick crystal slab off the surface of a bulk device using crystal-ion-slicing.

articleTitle: Novel inverse saturable absorption for improved passive mode locking
abstract: Inverse saturable absorption stronger than two-photon absorption is observed in 1.5-/spl mu/m semiconductor saturable absorber mirrors (SESAMs) measured with pulse durations of 190 fs to 20 ps and repetition rates of 60 MHz to 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Quantum well saturation in ultra short absorptive waveguide section formed by quantum well intermixing
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication of ultra-short absorptive sections in strongly confined waveguide employing quantum well intermixing technique, which could lead to the realization of nanoscale waveguides with selective saturable area for nonlinear optical device applications.

articleTitle: Ambient atmosphere effect on dry laser cleaning efficiencies for sub-micron particles on critical surfaces
abstract: The effects of viscous air drag and Brownian particle motion on dry laser cleaning efficiencies are discussed for 10/sup -2/-1 /spl mu/m spherical particle contaminants on critical surfaces.

articleTitle: Terahertz surface plasmon polariton generation with metallic gratings and silicon prisms
abstract: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy is used to generate surface plasmon polaritons via metallic gratings and silicon prisms. Grating measurements indicate efficient, narrowband coupling. Prism measurements show broadband coupling with substantial promise for guided-wave spectroscopy applications.

articleTitle: Characterizing printed protein biolayers using adaptive spinning-disk interferometry
abstract: The optical thickness and refractive index of a monolayer of protein, printed using soft lithography on glass, is measured by spinning-disk adaptive homodyne detection, a sensitive new materials characterization tool, and validated by AFM.

articleTitle: Study of the THz Sommerfeld wave on single metal wires
abstract: Optoelectronic generation and measurement of the THz Sommerfeld wave on single copper wires shows exceptionally low attenuation and group velocity dispersion. Theoretical analysis is consistent with our experimental results.

articleTitle: Dual-passive mode-locking of a high-power,TEM/sub 00/-mode, Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser
abstract: The novel combination of a saturable Bragg mirror (amplitude modulation) and a weak second-harmonic nonlinear mirror (phase locker) generates very stable 10-30 ps pulses at 76 MHz from a 7 W, TEM/sub 00/-mode, shaped, diode-pumped, Brewster Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser.

articleTitle: Design and demonstration of high-power and high-speed evanescently coupled photodiodes with partially p-doped photo-absorption layer
abstract: An evanescently-coupled-photodiode with partially p-doped photo-absorption layer was demonstrated and designed by a bandwidth simulation model to optimize its speed performance. Excellent performance of speed, saturation-power, and responsivity can be achieved simultaneously at 1.55 /spl mu/m wavelength.

articleTitle: Automatic feedback control of an Er-doped fiber laser with an intracavity loss modulator
abstract: Saturable absorber mode-locking of an Er-doped fiber laser is achieved over the entire parameter range with automatic gain control and active feedback stabilization using an intracavity loss modulator.

articleTitle: Near-infrared femtosecond laser-processed thin-film transistor
abstract: Near-infrared (800 nm wavelength) femtosecond laser annealing (FLA) is employed on crystallization and activation of amorphous Si regions of thin film transistors (TFT). The transfer, and output characteristics for FLA-processed TFTs show promising performances.

articleTitle: Raman gain measurements of thallium-tellurium oxide glasses
abstract: Several different compositions of tellurium-thallium glasses were fabricated and tested for their Raman gain performance. The maximum Raman gain experimentally obtained was (58/spl plusmn/3) higher than the peak Raman gain of fused silica.

articleTitle: Measurement and modeling of the transfer function of a monolithic SOA-EA 2R-regenerator
abstract: We have measured steep power transfer characteristics with tunable threshold for a monolithic 2R-regenerator combining amplifying and absorbing sections. Modeling results explain the basic characteristics.

articleTitle: Active waveguide fabrication in novel erbium doped glasses using focussed femtosecond pulses
abstract: We present the results of optical characterisation experiments conducted on erbium doped waveguide amplifiers (EDWAs) fabricated in novel erbium doped bulk glasses using femtosecond pulses to modify the refractive index of the glass.

articleTitle: High-power, rapidly-tunable ZnGeP/sub 2/ intracavity optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We report a CrZnSe laser pump-tuned, intracavity ZnGeP/sub 2/ optical parametric oscillator (OPO) with signal tunable from 4.08 to 4.85 /spl mu/m and total output power greater than 4 W.

articleTitle: Chirped-pulse amplification system providing electric-field-controlled optical pulses
abstract: We demonstrated control of full electric-field shapes of optical pulses by combining a carrier-envelope-phase stabilized chirped-pulse amplification system with a pulse-shaper that controls both the carrier-envelope phase and the pulse envelope.

articleTitle: Generation of continuous-wave blue light by sum-frequency mixing of diode pumped dual-wavelength lasers
abstract: Simultaneous emissions were demonstrated with a Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ crystal (912-nm and 1063-nm) and with two crystals: Nd:YLF (1047-nm) and Nd:GdVO/sub 4/(912-nm). Blue light was generated by sum-frequency mixing up to 93-mW at 487-nm.

articleTitle: Electric field reconstruction using coherent transients in a two-level system
abstract: We have implemented a new approach for measuring the time-dependent intensity and phase of ultrashort optical pulses. It is based on the interaction between shaped pulses and a two-level system, leading to coherent transients.

articleTitle: Photo-electromotive-force sensor-based laser vibrometer with gain-switched laser diode
abstract: We demonstrated vibration measurement using photo-electromotive-force detector and gain-switched laser diode. This configuration can lead to laser vibrometer with easy-to-setup optical train, low average optical power, compact design, and higher vibration frequency.

articleTitle: Single-mode fiber source of 0.8-/spl mu/J, 150-fs pulses at 1 /spl mu/m
abstract: A Yb fiber laser and amplifier system based entirely on single-mode fiber generates 150-fs pulses with energies up to 0.8 /spl mu/J. This source combines high pulse energy with the simplicity and integrability of single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Localised recombination and gain in quantum dots
abstract: We have computed light-current (L-I) characteristics of a system of 106 dots with localised recombination processes. The L-I curves cannot be analysed assuming the processes have simple power law dependences on electron number.

articleTitle: Hollow waveguides on planar substrates with selectable geometry cores
abstract: We report the fabrication of hollow waveguide structures with various core geometries. These structures are suitable for low-loss anti-resonant reflecting (ARROW) and photonic crystal waveguides, and integration with microfluidic systems.

articleTitle: Polarization gated high order harmonic generation approaching the single attosecond pulse emission
abstract: The confinement of high-harmonic-generation pulse train by modulation of the fundamental beam polarization is studied temporally and spectrally. We observe a clear effect, being the maximal confinement compatible with l-or-2 subfemtosecond pulse emission.

articleTitle: Gain and photoluminescence dynamics in dilute nitride semiconductor laser materials
abstract: The gain and photoluminescence dynamics is calculated microscopically for several GaInNAs structures. Carrier scattering rates are computed microscopically and implemented into a nonequilibrium gain model.

articleTitle: Multistage linear add/drop (LAD) architecture for high capacity WDM-PON network testbed
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a flexible, scalable and high capacity multistage LAD architecture for PONs which provides WDM traffic in both directions. It's fully symmetric operating at 2.5 Gbps and capable of broadcasting complete video band.

articleTitle: Characterization on broadband chromium-doped fiber amplifier
abstract: Up to 16-dB of gross gain at a wavelength of 1.47 /spl mu/m was achieved by a broadband Cr/sup 4+/:YAG fiber amplifier. The simulation indicates that the minimum noise figure is close to 3-dB at 1.24-1.6 /spl mu/m range.

articleTitle: Passive and hybrid modelocking of a grating-coupled surface-emitting laser (GCSEL)
abstract: We report the first passive and hybrid modelocking of a grating-coupled surface-emitting laser (GCSEL), exploiting the unpumped grating section of the GCSEL as a saturable absorber to generate short pulses, is demonstrated. Pulsewidths 2.8 psec with 1.1 nm bandwidth at 980 nm are obtained.

articleTitle: Ultra-flattened dispersion holey fibers: genetic algorithm design and fabrication tolerances
abstract: We design practical nonlinear holey fibers through a genetic algorithm, achieving dispersions of 0plusmn0.1 ps/nm/km between 1.5 and 1.6 mum. The fabrication tolerances are also estimated through a dispersion sensitivity analysis

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation in photonic crystal fibers: the role of the second zero dispersion wavelength
abstract: We study supercontinuum generation in photonic crystal fibers with various distances between the two zero dispersion wavelengths. Controllable generation of a red-shifted, nearly Gaussian shaped spectrum with a 3-dB bandwidth of 200 nm is found.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked multi-GHz 1.3-/spl mu/m Nd:vanadate lasers with low timing jitter
abstract: We demonstrate diode-pumped, passively mode-locked 1.34-/spl mu/m Nd: YVO/sub 4/ lasers with repetition rates of 5 and 10 GHz and low timing jitter. Passive mode locking is achieved by using a novel GaInNAs-based saturable absorber mirror.

articleTitle: Pedestal-free, nearly exact optical-beat-to-soliton train conversion based on comb-like profiled fiber emulating 5/sup th/ order polynomial dispersion decreasing profile
abstract: We show that nearly exact beat-to-soliton conversion is possible in a compression fiber with a 5/sup th/ order polynomial dispersion decreasing profile, and generate an almost perfect 160-GHz soliton train through a 40-pair comb-like profiled fiber.

articleTitle: Time resolved spectral characteristics of linear and nonlinear, 1550-nm quantum dash optical amplifiers
abstract: Time resolved spectra (chirp) were measured in quantum dash optical amplifiers and were found to depend on the amplified pulse width and the degree of saturation.

articleTitle: Fabrication of photonic crystal membranes in chalcogenide glasses by focused ion beam milling
abstract: Free-standing films of AMTIR-1 chalcogenide glass have been patterned using a focused ion beam, to produce a photonic crystal. Optical measurements of Fano resonances indicated that the resulting structures had strongly modified guided modes.

articleTitle: Noise effect on the measurement of polarization-mode dispersion in a system with polarization-dependent loss using a generalized Poincare sphere method
abstract: We simulate the measurement statistics of differential group delay and differential attenuation slope in a long-haul fiber communication system using a generalized Poincare sphere method and found them to be sensitive to Stokes noise.

articleTitle: Fiber laser driven EUV generation
abstract: Laser-plasma-produced EUV-radiation has been demonstrated using a pulsed fiber laser. Generated radiation is in the spectral range compatible with 13.5-nm EUV lithography. Fiber lasers can overcome power-scaling limitations of current LPP sources for EUV lithography.

articleTitle: Efficient broadband near-infrared emission from Ni/sup 2+/-doped Li/sub 2/O-Ga/sub 2/O/sub 3/-SiO/sub 2/ transparent glass-ceramics
abstract: Transparent silicate glass-ceramics embedding Ni/sup 2+/-doped Li/sub 2/Ga/sub 5/O/sub 8/ nano-crystallites have been prepared by heat-treatment of NiO-doped Li/sub 2/O-Ga/sub 2/O/sub 3/-SiO/sub 2/ (LGS) glass. The quantum efficiency of near-infrared emission was estimated as about 9 % at room temperature.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope-phase-controlled optical poling
abstract: The efficiency of optical poling process is controlled by the self-stabilized carrier-envelope phase of the idler output from our noncollinear optical parametric amplifier system.

articleTitle: Wide field of view image amplifier based on Yb-doped multi-core phosphate optical fiber
abstract: We demonstrate a 3/spl times/3 optical image amplifier array based on high gain per unit length ytterbium-doped phosphate glass fiber. Doped cores, or pixels, are on a 14-/spl mu/m pitch and deliver 30 dB gain at 1017 nm.

articleTitle: Tapered micro-structured optical fiber pigtails for waveguide coupling
abstract: We demonstrate pigtailed, tapered microstructured optical fiber couplers for use with high-index, small mode-field diameter waveguides. We achieve adiabatic reduction in mode field dimensions to less than 2 /spl mu/m with low excess loss.

articleTitle: Thermal annealing of fiber Bragg gratings directly inscribed by an ultrafast infrared laser
abstract: Thermal characteristics of gratings inscribed by an infrared femtosecond laser are studied at temperatures ranged from 500/spl deg/C to 1050/spl deg/C. Stability of gratings at temperatures up to 900/spl deg/C has been observed.

articleTitle: Optical generation and detection of THz polariton via quasi-phase-matched cascade nonlinear processes
abstract: First-order quasi-phase-matched, THz-wave generation and detection were achieved by using coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering of periodically poled LiNbO/sub 3/ crystals. Wide-frequency tuning (1.8-5.6 THz) was obtained with corresponding domain periods of 75-10 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of adiabatic coupling into SOI photonic crystal coupled-cavity waveguides
abstract: The experimental demonstration of an adiabatic coupling technique between Silicon-on-insulator photonic crystal single-line defect waveguides and coupled-cavity waveguides is reported. Experimental results are compared with three dimensional finite-difference time-domain simulation results showing very good agreement.

articleTitle: Future highly-efficient optical networks
abstract: In the 10-year horizon, optical networks may take evolutionary or revolutionary paths towards higher capacity, robustness, configurability, and flexibility. We will explore key technical challenges that are being pursued within the areas of monitoring for plug-&-play operation, packet switching, and traffic convergence.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation and pulse compression in sub-wavelength-sized waveguides
abstract: We show that using sub-wavelength-diameter waveguides the threshold for supercontinuum generation can be greatly reduced. In addition, we find that soliton-effect pulse compression down to near single cycle durations is predicted.

articleTitle: A new scheme of conical-wedge-shaped fiber endface for high-power laser to single mode fiber coupling
abstract: We propose a new scheme of a conical-wedge-shaped fiber endface for high-power laser to single mode fiber coupling. High coupling efficiency of 84% with simple and reproducible fabrication process is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Proposal of waveguided PPLN SHG device with conversion efficiency modulator
abstract: Novel type of waveguided PPLN SHG device is proposed. The inserted two EO phase modulator can modulate SH output. Numerical simulation shows V/sub /spl pi//=58 V for 940/spl rarr/470 nm. Experimental result of V/sub /spl pi//=30 V was observed approximately.

articleTitle: Investigation of cascadability and optimum inter-regenerator spacing in transmission with all-optical 3R regeneration
abstract: Transmission with cascaded all-optical 3R regeneration is reported using a reconfigurable fibre loop to investigate, for the first time, the impact of varying the inter-regenerator spacing on long distance transmission. Error-free transmission at 10 Gb/s over 20000 km of standard single-mode fibre was achieved with inter-regenerator spacing range of 150-600 km, corresponding to an OSNR range of 30-23 dB/0.1 nm at the regenerator input

articleTitle: Extended ultra-flat bands in photonic crystals
abstract: We create one-dimensional extended ultra-flat bands with relative frequency widths below 1% in two-dimensional photonic crystals. Caused by an interior saddle point, these flat bands lead to an enhanced density of states and improved self-collimation.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet light generation by intense laser filaments propagating in air
abstract: Sub-millimeter diameter filaments can develop from laser self-focusing in air. These filaments produce ultraviolet radiations in form of third harmonics and frequency upshifting. Using high-power laser we observed generation of third harmonic radiation in air.

articleTitle: Transients suppression in reconfigurable WDM ring network self-stabilized by laser action
abstract: We report transients suppression in WDM ring network by lasing action of recirculating amplified stimulated emission noise. A new theoretical model is developed and experimentally verified which provides system transfer functions relating signal/pump power fluctuations.

articleTitle: Sub-picosecond all-optical switch with extinction ratio of 10 dB utilizing GaN intersubband transition
abstract: An all-optical gate switch utilizing intersubband transition in GaN/AlN quantum wells was fabricated by MBE re-growth on an MOCVD-grown GaN. The extinction ratio of 10 dB was achieved with the gate width of 240 fs.

articleTitle: Frequency analysis of single living cell activity by laser speckle microscope
abstract: A laser speckle microscopic imaging system was developed to instantaneously observe human single living cell activity. In the experiments, living and dead HeLa cells were compared and analyzed by using frequency spectra of speckle fluctuations.

articleTitle: Transmission of optical communication signals by distributed parametric amplification
abstract: We have demonstrated, for the first time to our knowledge, distributed parametric amplification, i.e. amplification of 10-Gb/s communication signals along a 75-km transmission fiber by using a co-propagating pump with only 66.5 mW of power.

articleTitle: Two-branch Er:fiber laser system for long-term optical frequency metrology
abstract: We present a fiber-based femtosecond laser for long-term optical frequency measurements. It employs two parallel amplifiers seeded by a single oscillator. The frequency of a cw-laser at 657 nm is coherently monitored over 88 hours.

articleTitle: A diode-stack side-pumped waveguide laser
abstract: We demonstrate an in-plane diode-stack side-pumped planar waveguide laser. For 106 W of absorbed pump power, 58 W of output power is obtained at 1.064 /spl mu/m from a monolithic 3 /spl mu/m-thick double-clad Nd:YAG waveguide.

articleTitle: Observation of MOSFETs without bias voltage using a laser-THz emission microscope
abstract: For inspecting electrical failures in large-scale integration circuits (LSI), we developed a laser-THz emission microscope (LTEM), which records the map of the THZ emission amplitude in a sample upon excitation with fs laser pulses. We successfully obtained the THz emission image of MOSFETs fabricated in a test element group without bias voltage. We also measured MOSFETs in which the connection lines from the electrodes to the p-n junctions were interrupted, and found that the polarity of the temporal waveform of the THz emission from the p-n junction in damaged MOSFETs has the opposite sign compared to that in normal MOSFETs. This result indicates that the LTEM is a potential tool for the inspection of MOSFETs without bias voltage, which is the advantage for the failure analysis of semiconductor devices during the manufacturing process.

articleTitle: Active silicon octagonal micropillar resonator modulators using metal-oxide-semiconductor capacitors
abstract: We propose active silicon waveguide-coupled octagonal micropillar resonator modulators using metal-oxide-semiconductor capacitors. Our initial electrical and optical simulations suggest a high-extinction ratio resonance modulation by selectively embedding capacitors along the octagonal micropillar rim region.

articleTitle: Recent studies of CW stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) in single mode and multimode optical fibers
abstract: We report studies of SBS in optical fibers with the goal of using SBS phase conjugation as a passive beam combiner to build high power (>100 W cw) all fiber laser sources. We propose the development of a near infrared high power fiber laser by phasing two Er doped amplifiers in parallel using stimulated Brillouin scattering in a multimode fiber. We use a 1.5 p.m master oscillator-power amplifier configuration (MOPA) to generate SBS in a multimode fiber. The fiber amplifier consists of two Er doped multimode fiber amplifiers (diode pumped), in parallel, which will combine to generate SBS in the multimode fiber.

articleTitle: Erbium doped waveguide amplifiers (EDWAs) fabricated via a single sol-gel deposition technique
abstract: In this paper we present erbium absorption, gain, fluorescence lifetime and waveguide loss characterisation results for erbium doped waveguide amplifiers (EDWAs) fabricated using a single sol-gel deposition for each of the core and cladding layers.

articleTitle: Real-time wideband optical processing of S-and X-band signals for advanced radar systems
abstract: Real-time, wideband (>1 GHz) analog signal processing is experimentally demonstrated utilizing electro-optical devices and spectrally selective optical materials. Broadband signals are processed directly at S-band and X-band carrier frequencies without any down conversion.

articleTitle: Adaptive optics technologies for industrial and medical applications
abstract: Adaptive optics is a maturing technology. Developed primarily for big-science applications in the military and astronomy areas adaptive optics systems, the components produced to implement adaptive systems, are increasingly finding more down-to-earth uses.

articleTitle: Noise figure measurement of parametric wavelength conversion in a quasi-phase-matched LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguide
abstract: We firstly measure the noise figure of parametric wavelength conversion in a quasi-phase-matched LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguide. The measured noise figures depend on the pump laser quality and conversion efficiency, and agree well with the proposed analytical model.

articleTitle: Electro-optic modulator on silicon-on-insulator substrates using ring resonators
abstract: We study a compact electro-optic modulator using high-index contrast silicon ring resonators on silicon-on-insulator substrate. Optical modulation is achieved using the plasma dispersion effect due to current injection under forward bias of a p-i-n junction.

articleTitle: Two-photon microscopy with high depth of field using an axicon
abstract: We have developed a two-photon microscopy system based on an axicon. This optical component can provide a focal line with a good transverse resolution and a high depth of field that speeds up data acquisition.

articleTitle: Progress in printed organic electronics and hybrid photovoltaics
abstract: We will discuss patterning of conducting polymers using ink jet printing, along with controlled surface oxidation reaction, to yield a variety of patterns with various grey scale levels. We will also present our recent findings on hybrid (organic/inorganic) nanothick solar cells and possible ways to improve their performance

articleTitle: An eight-user time-slotted SPECTS O-CDMA network testbed incorporating a NOLM time gate
abstract: We incorporate time slotting into a 9 Gb/s/user SPECTS O-CDMA network testbed to achieve eight-user capacity. The system uses a NOLM time gate that selects between time-slotted users and suppresses multi-user interference.

articleTitle: Nonlinear properties of hollow-core photonic band-gap fibers
abstract: Our measurements and modeling of two hollow-core photonic band-gap fibers show that glass contribution to the effective non-linearity strongly depends on the fiber structure. We investigate wavelength dependence of total fiber nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Optical phase conjugators for near-infrared diode lasers using Sn/sub 2/P/sub 2/S/sub 6/ crystals
