abstract: We demonstrate fast self-pumped optical phase conjugation at laser diode wavelengths using a novel semiconducting crystal Sn/sub 2/P/sub 2/S/sub 6/ optimized for near-infrared applications. We demonstrate grating recording with phase-conjugate reflectivities above 50% and response times of less than 50 ms in a ring-cavity scheme for 30 mW pump power at 860 nm.

articleTitle: Ultra-high stability optical frequency standard based on laser-cooled neutral calcium
abstract: A beatnote between the Ca and Hg/sup +/ optical frequency standards via a mode-locked fs-laser frequency comb demonstrates the highest frequency stability measured to date. The high stability accelerates evaluation of the Ca standard's systematic shifts.

articleTitle: Fully dispersion compensated /spl sim/500 fs pulse transmission over 50 km SMF and application to ultrafast O-CDMA
abstract: We demonstrate essentially distortionless 50 km fiber transmission for -500 fs pulses using dispersion compensating fiber and a programmable pulse shaper as a spectral phase equalizer. Application in ultrafast O-CDMA system experiments is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A novel self-heterodyne method for combined temporal and spectral high resolution measurement of wavelength transients in tunable lasers
abstract: This paper presents a new experimental optical delayed self-heterodyne method to characterize tunable laser source instantaneous wavelength transients at accuracy of electronic spectrum.

articleTitle: Direct laser writing of three-dimensional photonic crystals in high index of refraction chalcogenide glasses
abstract: We present a two-step method for the direct fabrication of functional three-dimensional photonic crystals in high index of refraction (n=2.45) arsenic-sulphur based thin films. Complete fabrication cycles can be as short as a few hours.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation enhancement in lithium niobate micro-tips
abstract: We have observed a substantial enhancement (40 fold) of the non-phase-matched second harmonic generation efficiency in microfabricated ultra-sharp, lithium niobate micro-tip arrays. The fabrication process and the nonlinear characterization is presented

articleTitle: A comprehensive modeling study of Ag/sup +/ ion-exchange for channel waveguide fabrication
abstract: A systematic study of silver ion-exchange for the fabrication of optical channel waveguides in glass is reported. Diffusion theory, together with measured concentration-dependent diffusion coefficients, is shown to accurately predict the induced refractive index profiles.

articleTitle: V-T relaxation related aspects of quartz-enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy
abstract: Influence of vibrational energy transfer processes on QEPAS-based trace gas detection will be considered. Relevant published results will be analyzed. The potential of QEPAS as research tool of relaxation processes will be discussed.

articleTitle: 3-W cw green generation at 34% efficiency by single-pass frequency-doubling in a bulk periodically poled MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ at room temperature
abstract: About 3 W continuous-wave power at 542 nm with 34% conversion efficiency is obtained at room temperature by single-pass frequency doubling of a Yb-doped fiber laser through a 1-mm-thick, 25-mm-long periodically polled MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/.

articleTitle: 1 nJ all-fiber 108 MHz mode-locked erbium oscillator at 1.56 /spl mu/m
abstract: We report on an all-fiber passively-mode-locked erbium ring oscillator with an output power of 103 mW. The diode-pumped oscillator's repetition rate was about 108 MHz resulting in a pulse energy of about 1 nJ.

articleTitle: Integrated optical circulator in InP
abstract: A polarization independent waveguide circulator design is proposed. Isolation of 24 dB and insertion loss of 1.41 dB is calculated at 1550 nm. Isolation of 20 dB is calculated with the entire device magnetically doped.

articleTitle: 2.05-/spl mu/m-laser-pumped orientation-patterned gallium arsenide (OPGaAs) OPO
abstract: We achieved the highest average power (0.45 W) and efficiency (20% slope) to date from an OPGaAs OPO. QPM structures >1 mm thick were grown by HVPE on 3-inch diameter multi-grating templates produced by MBE.

articleTitle: Electrically pumped InGaAsP/InP microring optical amplifiers and lasers with surface passivation
abstract: InGaAsP/InP microring lasers and optical amplifiers providing gain at 1550 nm are demonstrated. The microrings provide about 10 dB of gain in pulsed mode. Sulfur passivation is used to reduce carrier loss to surface recombination.

articleTitle: Nanometer scale thermal drift of 4 Gbit/s uncooled laser for tight-channel-spacing low-cost WDM
abstract: A 4 Gbit/s directly modulated DBR laser is demonstrated with nanometre scale thermal tuning over an extended 20-70/spl deg/C temperature range. >40 dB side mode suppression over the entire temperature range is achieved.

articleTitle: Sub-100-attosecond timing jitter between two-color mode-locked lasers by active/passive hybrid synchronization
abstract: We demonstrated a timing jitter as low as 83 as between passively-synchronized Ti:sapphire and Cr:forsterite mode-locked lasers from 10 mHz to 100 kHz in combination with a slow active extra-cavity feedback control by use of the balanced cross-correlator.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet microchip cerium fluoride lasers
abstract: Ultraviolet microchip cerium fluoride lasers have been demonstrated with high efficiency (up to 40%) and ultra-low threshold (7 /spl mu/J). These lasers represent simple compact wavelength converters to 290-330 nm for microchip Nd:YVO/sub 4/ laser.

articleTitle: Surface emission from MBE and MOVPE grown quantum cascade lasers
abstract: We report high power single mode surface emission from second order distributed feedback quantum cascade lasers. Two different laser materials are used for the lasers: MOVPE grown InGaAs/InAlAs and MBE grown GaAs/AlGaAs

articleTitle: Generation and detection of terahertz pulses in a birefringent organic crystal
abstract: We demonstrate how ultrashort terahertz pulses are coherently measured in an organic birefringent crystal by terahertz-induced lensing. Velocity-matching schemes for several wavelengths of the optical source and probe light pulses are presented.

articleTitle: 900-1800 nm, all-fiber nanosecond pulse source pumped by a low-power laser diode
abstract: 25-mW-output-power Er/Brillouin-oscillator, a conventional dispersion-shifted fiber, and introduced bending losses are the simplest way to realize nanosecond, all-fiber laser sources operating in 900-1800 nm. Expanding evolution of the spectrum kicked off by multi-cascade-Brillouin-random-process is reported.

articleTitle: Packaging and performance of an ultra-fast 1/spl times/4 optical switch
abstract: We report a packaged ultra-fast 1/spl times/4 fiber-optic switch obtained by cascading two electro-optic scanners. The resulting switch exhibits a fiber-to-fiber insertion loss of 3.2 dB and rise and fall times of 46 ns and 8 ns, respectively.

articleTitle: High brightness polychromatic visible generation in photonic crystal fibers with picosecond Yb pumping
abstract: Pumping of highly-nonlinear microstructured fibers with zero-dispersion around the pump wavelength with kW peak-power picosecond Yb-fiber laser allowed polychromatic picosecond operation down to 525 nm. Methods of extension of operation further to the blue are proposed.

articleTitle: Achieving low loss and low nonlinearity in hollow core photonic crystal fibers
abstract: Loss and nonlinearity in hollow core photonic crystal fibers are shown to be simultaneously reduced by the incorporation of anti-resonant features within the boundary region between the core and the cladding.

articleTitle: Laboratory demonstration of low Earth orbit inter-satellite interferometric ranging
abstract: We describe an interferometric inter-spacecraft ranging system with an expected sensitivity of 1 nm/sqrt(Hz) level or better over frequencies of 10 to 100 mHz. We present our flight system concept and initial breadboard results.

articleTitle: Short pulse high power fiber laser systems
abstract: We review the rapid recent progress in the development of short pulse high-power fiber laser and amplifier devices. Use of cladding pump technology now provides a route to compact and efficient laser and amplifier systems with high beam quality and high output powers. A new Yb-fiber CPA system incorporating a CFBG stretcher with both 2nd and 3rd order dispersion is presented for high pulse energy applications. In addition, a simplified Yb-fiber parabolic amplifier system is also shown to be suitable for producing higher average powers, here up to 25 W.

articleTitle: Starting dynamics of passive mode locking with noise
abstract: The dynamics of onset of passive mode locking in the presence of noise is studied analytically and numerically. A self-starting condition is derived. Earlier results from other theories are obtained as a limiting case.

articleTitle: Directional bend sensor based on an asymmetric modification of the fiber cladding by femtosecond laser
abstract: A femtosecond laser was used to modify a part of the cladding of a standard LPG bend sensor. The device produced wavelength shifts depending upon the direction of bend, thus making a shape sensor.

articleTitle: Mode area limits in practical single-mode fibers
abstract: The upper limits imposed by bend loss on practical mode size in single-mode holey and step-index fibers are identified for a range of wavelengths. Using these results we quantify the advantages offered by holey fibers.

articleTitle: A new scheme of THz-wave difference-frequency generation in highly-absorbing cubic nonlinear crystal
abstract: We propose new method of THz-wave DFG that allows to avoid attenuation of THz-wave in nonlinear material due to leakage of guided wave into radiation mode. A scheme is experimentally tested in millimeter wavelength region.

articleTitle: Organic electro-optic films fabricated by hybrid covalent/ionic self-assembly
abstract: By alternating the deposition interaction between covalent and ionic binding, organic self-assembled films are fabricated with electro-optic coefficients of 20 pm/V. The rapidly deposited multilayer films exhibit excellent temporal and thermal stability.

articleTitle: High power scalable Nd:YAG laser architecture
abstract: Under the Joint High Power Solid-State Laser (JHPSSL) program, Northrop Grumman is developing a laser architecture that can scale to >100 kW with a near-term goal of a 25 kW demonstration. The laser concept uses a single master oscillator to drive parallel power-amplifier chains; output from the amplifier chains are tiled and phased (piston corrected) to provide a spatially coherent beam. Scaling is achieved by adding parallel amplifier chains.

articleTitle: Compact 10 mJ, kilohertz repetition-rate ultrafast laser system
abstract: We demonstrate a Ti:sapphire ultrafast laser-amplifier system, that exhibits an unprecedented performance of 10 mJ pulse energy at 1 kHz, in a sub-30-fs pulse. This performance is obtained using closed loop cryogenic cooling.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical effects for the generation of millimeter wave signals
abstract: A new and simple method for the generation of millimeter-waves with nonlinear effects is presented. With this method tunable millimeter waves with a frequency only determined by the bandwidth of the photodiode can be generated.

articleTitle: Barium titanate thin film electro-optic modulator low half-wave voltage at 1310 nm
abstract: Ferroelectric barium titanate thin film electro-optic modulator 4 mm in length with low half-wave voltage of 2.85 V and effective electro-optic coefficient of 360 pm/V at 310 nm is reported. Contact poling effect on the modulator was investigated.

articleTitle: Novel ring cavity resonators incorporating total internal reflection mirrors and semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: We report fabrication and measurements on novel ring resonators with the multimode interference couplers, total internal reflection mirrors and semiconductor optical amplifiers. Free spectral range and on-off ratio are 244 GHz and 13 dB respectively

articleTitle: IR optical scattering instrument with out-of-plane and retro-reflection capabilities
abstract: An infrared (IR) optical scattering instrument for BRDF measurement has been developed at NIST with out-of-plane and retro-reflection capabilities. In this paper, a description of the BRDF instrument, its use of multi-wavelength sources (785 nm-10.6 /spl mu/m) and a retro-reflection measurement capability, and alignment techniques using a quadrant detector are presented. The related alignment results for the in- and out-of-plane geometries and reflectance of a gold mirror versus incident angle are also reported. The results of BRDF measurements for a concentric groove graphite radiator in the retro-reflection configuration are demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-average-power, depolarized super-continuum generation using a 1.5-/spl mu/m ASE noise source
abstract: We propose a method to generate super-continuum by using ASE noise instead of ultra-short pulse trains. In the experiment, we successfully generate flat continuum of 956 nm with a spectral density of over -10 dBm/nm.

articleTitle: Photo-induced optical and physical property modifications in chalcogenide thin films by femtosecond irradiation
abstract: Multiphoton processes were shown to influence photo-induced exposure response in As-S-Se thin films written with sub-bandgap femtosecond radiation. Structural and/or electronic defects are established to be responsible for composition-dependent effects on the resulting material modifications.

articleTitle: Generation, transmission and wavelength conversion of an 80 Gbit/s RZ-DBPSK-ASK signal
abstract: An 80 Gbit/s RZ-DBPSK-ASK signal is generated using orthogonal phase and amplitude modulation. We demonstrate its transmission over an 80 km SMF+DCF fibre span, and wavelength conversion using FWM in a highly nonlinear PCF

articleTitle: Voltage-assisted cooling: a new route to enhance X/sup (2)/ during thermal poling
abstract: Modifying the standard constant-voltage poling procedure significantly enhances the inbuilt electric field strength (and consequently chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>) and leads to control of the nonlinear region evolution, both crucial parameters to integrate nonlinearity in waveguiding regions

articleTitle: An ultra low jitter pulse source based on coupled optoelectronic oscillators with an intracavity fiber parametric amplifier
abstract: We present a low noise self starting optical pulse source composed of coupled optoelectronic oscillators and an intracavity fiber parametric amplifier. Three picosecond pulses at 10 GHz with a jitter of 29-40 fs are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Pulsed optical tweezers for levitation and manipulation of stuck biological particles
abstract: We report on optical levitation and manipulation of microscopic particles that are stuck on a glass surface with a pulsed optical tweezers. Both the stuck dielectric beads and biological cells are demonstrated to be levitated.

articleTitle: C-band wavelength conversion in ultrasmall silicon-on-insulator waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate four-wave mixing to achieve C-band wavelength conversion in ultrasmall SOI waveguides. This work exploits silicon's large Raman /spl chi//sup (3)/ to further achieve active on-chip functionality. Initial experiments are compared with theoretical calculations.

articleTitle: Nanometer axial position sensing in optical tweezers using differential confocal microscopy
abstract: We use differential confocal microscopy for axial detection in optical tweezers. The fluctuation of a 3 /spl mu/m bead is about 10 nm at 16 mW. This technique is employed for studying protein elasticity and microrheology.

articleTitle: Hot-pressed ceramic Cr/sup 2+/:ZnSe gain-switched laser
abstract: Technology of hot-pressed Cr/sup 2+/:ZnSe ceramic is reported. Comparative gain-switched lasing of hot-pressed ceramic and CVD grown Cr/sup 2+/:ZnSe with slope efficiencies up to 10 % and output energies up to 2 mJ was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Recovery technique for chirped readout of spectral features
abstract: A data processing technique is proposed for use with conventional absorption spectroscopy at arbitrarily fast frequency chirp rates to map spectral features accurately into time-domain signatures. Numerical simulations and experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Effect of nitrogen content and temperature on the f/sub 3 dB/ of 1.3 /spl mu/m dilute-nitride SQW lasers
abstract: Above-threshold frequency response measurements carried out on strain-compensated InGaAs-and-InGaAsN lasers of identical geometry reveal a reduction in the laser relaxation frequency and damping due to the incorporation of nitrogen. Raising of temperature further decreases f/sub 3 dB/.

articleTitle: Acousto-optic polarization dependent mode coupling in a dual mode hollow optical fiber
abstract: We report acousto-optic polarization-dependent coupling in two-mode hollow optical fiber. Local deformation of circular symmetry by traveling acoustic wave results in high birefringence making it suitable for polarization control devices.

articleTitle: Nonlinear frequency conversion in periodic two-dimensional LiNbO/sub 3/ poled by electron-beam lithography
abstract: Modified electron-beam lithography was used for direct poling of LiNbO/sub 3/ at two-dimensional rectangular pattern with 6.4 and 7.4 microns periods. It enabled frequency doubling of 1047 nm light at five input and output angles.

articleTitle: All-optical gate based on surface-mediated effects in nematic liquid crystal cells
abstract: An all optical switch (optical limiter) was constructed and demonstrated using a twisted nematic liquid crystal cell composed of the liquid crystal 5CB (4-pentyl-4'-cyanobiphenyl) with polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) aligning layers. Milliwatt switching levels were observed.

articleTitle: All-optical regenerator based on xpm-induced wavelength shift in highly-nonlinear fiber at 40 Gb/s
abstract: We demonstrate regeneration of a 40-Gb/s signal using an all-optical regenerator based on the XPM-induced wavelength shift in a highly-nonlinear fiber. The noise variance is successfully reduced and the Q-factor is improved by 0.7 dB

articleTitle: Long-range periodic planar nanostructures produced in glass by femtosecond laser dielectric modification
abstract: Polarization dependent periodic nanostructures consisting of long-range arrayed planes of modification, < 20 nm thick and separated by /spl sim/240 /spl plusmn/ 25 nm, are created in fused silica through femtosecond laser irradiation. The periodicity is revealed by ultrahigh spatial resolution chemical etching combined with atomic force microscopy.

articleTitle: Self-guiding of light in a low-index photonic-crystal film
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate diffractionless propagation of light over 12 diffraction lengths and transverse routing of this self-guided light in a two-dimensional low-index photonic crystal film. Experimental results and three-dimensional calculations are in good agreement.

articleTitle: Electrically controlled wavefront modulators made with domain-engineered LiNbO/sub 3/ wafers
abstract: Low noise, electrically controlled diffusers and zone plates were made with domain-engineered LiNbO/sub 3/ wafers. Diffraction-limited zone plates with efficiencies over 37% were achieved. We also present generalized zone plates for creating optical vortexes.

articleTitle: Yellow and green picosecond pulse sources using frequency doubling of Yb fiber pumps in periodically poled waveguides
abstract: 532-nm and 560-nm picosecond pulse sources are demonstrated utilizing second-harmonic generation in periodically-poled KTP waveguides. The pumps were based on ytterbium-doped fiber systems, with wavelength extension to 1.12 /spl mu/m through Raman scattering in the yellow case.

articleTitle: Multiple-harmonic generation on ZnO nanocrystalline film
abstract: Second, third, and fifth harmonics to wavelengths of UV and VUV are generated on a thin film of ZnO nanocrystal using a /spl sim/ 15-femtosecond Ti:sapphire laser oscillator. The third-harmonic conversion efficiency is one of the highest among all other dielectric materials. A 3/sup rd/-order interferometric autocorrelation is demonstrated for routine diagnostic of the femtosecond beam and the 5/sup th/-order autocorrelation is now possible.

articleTitle: A room temperature all-optical polarization switch based on the excitation of spin-polarized "virtual" carriers in quantum wells
abstract: Room temperature operation of a polarization switch based on virtual excitation of spin-polarized carriers in quantum wells is demonstrated, which exhibits a contrast ratio of /spl sim/27:1 and a switching time of /spl sim/575 fs.

articleTitle: Low threshold (I/sub th/<20mA) buried 2.9 THz quantum cascade lasers using a double metal scheme
abstract: We demonstrate buried waveguides in THz quantum cascade lasers based on a double-metal scheme. An increase in lateral thermal conductivity results in a small difference of the maximum operating temperature between pulsed and continuous-wave operation.

articleTitle: 0.3 W cw red microchip VECSEL
abstract: A GaInP/AlGaInP vertical external cavity surface-emitting laser with an optically-contacted, single-crystal diamond microcavity was optically pumped to achieve 0.3 W continuous wave output power at 676 nm, in a circularly-symmetric beam with M/sup 2/ less than 2.

articleTitle: Real-time diagnostic of the defect-domain wall interaction in LiNbO/sub 3/ during domain inversion
abstract: We performed optical spectroscopy in-situ during domain inversion for real-time diagnostic purposes

articleTitle: Detection of activation states of T cells with Raman-tweezers spectroscopy
abstract: We demonstrated that Raman-tweezers spectroscopy can be used to detect different activation states of T cells.

articleTitle: Optical waveguides in hard crystalline materials
abstract: The recent results of our research group and collaborators in the field of fabrication, characterization, and applications of optical waveguides in hard crystalline materials, specifically in sapphire and Ti:sapphire, are reviewed.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal and III-N quantum dot laser
abstract: Deep UV light emitting devices are important for future medical, environmental and IT applications. Generation of DUV light using quantum dots GaN-related materials and nonlinear photonic crystals are demonstrated, and both techniques are compared.

articleTitle: Efficient and compact Yb:YAG ring laser
abstract: A compact 2-mirror Yb:YAG ring laser was demonstrated with a slope efficiency <38.6%. The mode size can be designed by tuning the distance between the gain medium and the optical axis of the cavity.

articleTitle: Photon echoes in an amplifying rare-earth ion-doped crystal
abstract: We report, on the first experimental demonstration of photon echoes in an amplifying rare-earth ion-doped crystal. Population inversion is achieved via optical pumping yielding higher power photon echoes, with an energy gain up to 5.

articleTitle: Characteristics of dilute-nitride quantum well lasers
abstract: Optimizing the MOCVD growth of InGaAsN has yielded high performance 1.3 /spl mu/m-emitting lasers, displaying reduced temperature sensitivity compared with InP-based structures. Studies reveal the impact of nitrogen on the gain, carrier confinement, and laser characteristics.

articleTitle: Fiber optic full color synthesizer
abstract: Color synthesis was achieved using novel 1/spl times/3 hard-polymer-clad-fiber (HPCF) coupler with red, green and blue primaries. With driving LED electronics, the device rendered micro circular pixel covering extended color gamut.

articleTitle: High-order soliton break up in sub-picosecond pulse propagation through photonic crystal fibers
abstract: Numerical calculations of pulse propagation in microstructured fibers show that Raman scattering and self-phase modulation are responsible for an observed series of discrete spectral components through break up of high-order solitons and soliton self-frequency shifting.

articleTitle: Nonlinear transmission of highly conjugated (polypyridyl)metal-(porphinato)zinc(II) compounds
abstract: Several materials that have been demonstrated to have very large excited state NIR absorption coefficients have been examined by nanosecond Z-scan and nonlinear transmission experiments and demonstrate large decreases in transmission with increasing fluence.

articleTitle: Site selective spectroscopy of Eu-doped GaN
abstract: Site-selective combined excitation emission spectroscopy studies have been performed on Eu-doped GaN and numerous sites have been identified. Relative numbers and broadening of these peaks has been investigated for different growth conditions

articleTitle: Biochemical sensors with photonic crystals in the terahertz region
abstract: Promising properties of photonic crystals open up their potential applicability for biosensing applications. We proposed and carried out a detailed study of photonic-crystal based sensors with different configurations using finite-difference time-domain method with recursive convolution.

articleTitle: Novel optoelectronic fibers codrawn from conducting, semiconducting and insulating materials
abstract: We report on the first successful fabrication of functional optoelectronic devices using fiber drawing techniques. The metal-insulator-semiconductor optical fibers have led to the creation of two prototype fiber structures: A fiber photodetector, and a dual electron-photon transport fiber.

articleTitle: Integrated 64-channel optoelectronic interconnect and application to image processing
abstract: Integrated 64-channel parallel optoelectronic interconnect and image processing system is developed using VCSEL and photodetector optical interconnect technology. Analog-to-digital halftoning image processing with appropriate image compression is reported.

articleTitle: Frequency response and polarization insensitivity of strained MQW optical amplifiers
abstract: An SOA with both compressive and tensile strained MQWs spanning the 1470-1540 nm band is presented. A 25 dB gain, negligible ripple, 0.5 dB polarization dependence and modulation bandwidth of 15 GHz is predicted and measured.

articleTitle: Indirect phase control of sub-20-fs deep UV pulses
abstract: We demonstrate that the shaped spectral phase in a sub-20-fs pulse of Ti:sapphire laser is transferred to that in a deep UV pulse at 256 nm with spectral phase interferometry for direct electric field reconstruction (SPIDER) measurement.

articleTitle: Ultrafast quantum optics
abstract: Ultrashort light pulses play an important role in the generation, manipulation and characterization of nonclassical light. Nonclassical light is often generated from a classical pump beam using a nonlinear optical process. One might expect that the high peak intensity of ultrashort pulses would provide the necessary driver for such processes, and this is indeed the case. Ultrashort pulses have been used to generate squeezed states, and quadrature entangled states via three and four wave mixing, photon number states, polarization and frequency or directional entangled photon pairs states via three wave mixing.

articleTitle: Tunable stop-band hollow waveguide bragg reflector with tapered air-core for adaptive dispersion-compensation
abstract: We propose a tunable stop-band hollow waveguide Bragg reflector with a variable tapered air-core. We demonstrate the tunable operation of both bandwidth and center-wavelength by changing a tapered air-core thickness. Wavelength tuning of over 1.0% and stop-band expansion up to 5 nm are realized

articleTitle: Photonic crystal fiber based two-photon-fluorescence microscopy systems at 0.8/spl mu/m and 1.3/spl mu/m wavelength regimes
abstract: We demonstrate hollow-core and large-core photonic-crystal-fiber-based two-photon fluorescence microscopes at 0.8/spl mu/m and 1.3/spl mu/m. The two-photon excitation efficiencies and image performances are comparable to or better than those acquired by the conventional fiber-free system.

articleTitle: Reliable super resolution beam profiler for lasers in manufacturing
abstract: Demonstrated is a first of a kind hybrid analog-digital laser beam profiler based on a digital micro-mirror device. Tests at 1550 nm show a 2 micron profiling resolution over a 600 micron side square zone.

articleTitle: Direct generation of 10 GHz 816 fs pulse train from an asynchronous modelocked Er-fiber laser
abstract: By employing the technique of asynchronous modelocking (ASM), we have successfully demonstrated the direct generation of stable 10 GHz 816 fs pulse trains with super-mode-suppression-ratio >70 dB from a hybrid modelocked Er-fiber laser.

articleTitle: Anticompetition of laser modes in quantum dot lasers
abstract: Laser-mode anticompetition is observed in a quantum-dot laser. The laser is operated at 1168.5 nm and 1262.3 nm wavelength simultaneously using a grating-controlled external cavity. Increasing the power of 1168.5 nm, the power of 1262.3 nm also increases.

articleTitle: Super-broadband continuum at UV-visible wavelengths generated by ultrashort laser-pulses in air
abstract: We report experimental and numerical results on supercontinuum generation at ultraviolet/visible wavelengths produced by the long-range propagation of infrared femtosecond laser pulses in air.

articleTitle: Recent advances in evanescent-wave cavity ring-down spectroscopy
abstract: Evanescent wave cavity ring-down spectroscopy (EW-CRDS) is used to probe surface silanols (SiOH) and hydrogen-bonded water on an amorphous silica surface, revealing considerable ordering. A novel resonator for EW-CRDS of liquids is also described.

articleTitle: Optical scattering of confocal laser scanning reflectance microscopy in turbid media
abstract: We present quantitative analysis of optical scattering in confocal reflectance microscopy as a function of numerical aperture and scattering coefficient. Data is collected from samples of intralipid of varying concentration with objectives up to 1.4NA.

articleTitle: Space-variant polarization manipulation of a thermal emission by a SiO/sub 2/ subwavelength grating supporting surface phonon-polariton
abstract: Space-variant polarization manipulation of thermal emission in a narrow spectral-peak is presented. The emission is attributed to surface phonon-polariton excitation from space-variant subwavelength SiO/sub 2/ gratings. We experimentally demonstrated thermal emission in an axially symmetric polarization distribution.

articleTitle: Domain inversion and optical damage in Zn doped near-stoichiometric lithium niobate crystal
abstract: The electric field to invert the domain in doped near-stoichiometric LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> varies with Zn concentration. Inversion is accomplished with low field of 1.4kV/mm at 2mol% doping where the optical damage resistance of the crystal enhances

articleTitle: Tunable high repetition rate pulse trains by Talbot self-imaging and cross phase modulation
abstract: We report generation of a constant phase ultrafast pulse train with tunable wavelength and adjustable repetition rate, using the Talbot effect in a tunable dispersion compensator followed by cross-phase modulation and spectral filtering.

articleTitle: Optical trapping, manipulation, and sorting of cells and colloids in microfluidic systems with diode laser bars
abstract: We demonstrate a new technique for trapping, sorting, and manipulating cells and micrometer-sized particles within microfluidic systems, using a diode laser bar.

articleTitle: Chirp-controlled soliton fission in tapered optical fibers
abstract: Manipulation of the input pulse chirp during supercontinuum generation in tapered fibers provides precise control of the soliton fission process, and can be applied to compensate for deleterious effects due to untapered pigtails.

articleTitle: Multiplying the repetition rate of passive mode-locked femtosecond lasers by an intracavity flat surface with low reflectivity
abstract: We demonstrate a flexible and phase insensitive method to multiply the repetition-rate of passive mode-locked solid-state lasers in femtosecond regime. It was achieved by inserting a low-reflectivity flat surface inside the oscillator cavity.

articleTitle: Multiple beam optical tweezers for spatially resolved Raman imaging
abstract: Multiple beam tweezers are demonstrated for Raman spectroscopy of living cells. Results are presented for time resolved Raman. Data for spatially resolved Raman is shown and holographic tweezers for cell imaging is proposed.

articleTitle: Tunable CW optical parametric generation using a photonic crystal fiber
abstract: We report on the observation of tunable optical parametric generation in a photonic crystal fiber. We experimentally demonstrate over 30 nm of sideband tunability using a 300 mW CW pump, and 200 nm of tunability using quasi-CW pump.

articleTitle: Combinatorial exploration of novel thin film amorphous oxides
abstract: New systems of erbium-containing amorphous oxides are investigated. The composition-spread approach provides a means for evaluating the maximum Er/sup 3+/ emission in hundreds of combinations of bismuth-, gadolinium-, and aluminum-substituted SiO/sub 2/.

articleTitle: Full PMD compensation for ultrafast pulses
abstract: We demonstrate a full, wavelength-parallel PMD compensation scheme for sub-picosecond pulses. Two programmable double-pass pulse-shapers are used in series to correct the distorted polarization and phase spectra independently for a 602 fs pulse around 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Photonic chirp compression and arbitrary waveform generation for micro and millimeter-wave applications
abstract: A novel approach for the practical implementation of photonic arbitrary waveform generation of microwave signals is explored. Here we describe and demonstrate linear sideband chirp compression over 4 GHz bandwidth with a compression factor of < 15000.

articleTitle: 1.55 /spl mu/m GalnNAsSb lasers on GaAs
abstract: We present a 1.55 /spl mu/m laser grown on GaAs by molecular beam epitaxy. The active layer was a single GaInNAsSb quantum well surrounded by strain-compensating GaNAs barriers. The room temperature threshold current density was 2.4 kA/cm/sup 2/, lasing at 1.553 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Efficient blue-luminescent nanomaterial of semiconducting nanocrystal/silica arrays
abstract: Three-dimensional semiconducting nanocrystals (NCs) of 2-5 nm were densely (8/spl times/10/sup 18//cm/sup 3/) dispersed within mesoporous silica matrices by a plasma-assisted atomic layer deposition method. A constructed Si (Ge) NC/silica arrays is an excellent blue-luminescent nanomaterial.

articleTitle: Using evolutionary algorithms for designing photonic crystals
abstract: We used evolutionary algorithms to systematically search for photonic crystals with large bandgaps. Starting from randomly generated photonic crystals with no bandgaps, the algorithm yielded photonic crystals 12.5% better than the best published human design.

articleTitle: Two wave mixing in erbium-doped fiber amplifier for modulation depth enhancement of optically carried microwave signals
abstract: We experimentally and theoretically analyze an original method based on two wave mixing in erbium doped fiber amplifier for optical carrier reduction of microwave signals. 75 % selective optical carrier attenuation are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Bitwise-controlled all-optical wavelength converter
abstract: We demonstrated a bitwise-controlled all-optical wavelength converter. Intelligent wavelength conversion of packets is performed based on bitwise all-optical processing of data packet headers. The header and payload rates are 5 Gb/s and 10 Gb/s respectively

articleTitle: Radial temperature profiling of VCSELs
abstract: High resolution temperature measurements of thermal lensing in a proton implanted VCSEL are reported. We show that the radial surface temperature profile can be linked to the transverse mode profile.

articleTitle: Localized enhancement of supercontinuum generation using fiber Bragg gratings
abstract: Supercontinuum in a fiber-Bragg grating shows a strong enhancement near the grating resonance, even at wavelengths outside the continuum bandwidth, corresponding to the pump third-harmonic. We also show the power dependence of the grating enhancement.

articleTitle: A variable repetition rate frequency comb for infrared frequency metrology
abstract: A frequency comb generated by a mode-locked fiber laser of variable repetition rate is presented. The spacing of the frequency comb can be scanned while one comb tooth is phase-locked to a stable RF source.

articleTitle: Characteristics of high performance 1.3 /spl mu/m tunnel injection quantum dot lasers
abstract: 1.3 /spl mu/m tunnel injection InAs quantum dot lasers are reported for the first time. They exhibit T/sub 0/ = /spl infin/ (5/spl deg/C /spl les/ T /spl les/ 70/spl deg/C), a -3 dB modulation bandwidth of 11 GHz, and near-zero /spl alpha/-factor and chirp.

articleTitle: All-optical packet switching with all-optical header processing and 2R regeneration
abstract: We demonstrate a 1/spl times/4 10 Gb/s all-optical packet switch with all-optical header processing and 2R regeneration using injection-locked Fabry-Perot lasers diodes. The header and payload rates are 5 Gb/s and 10 Gb/s respectively.

articleTitle: Laser diode pumped 560-590 nm light source using sum-frequency generation in direct bonded quasi-phase matched LiNbO/sub 3/ waveguide
abstract: A combination of laser diodes and a LiNbO/sub 3/ wavelength converter enables us to generate arbitrary wavelengths between 500 and 600 nm. We applied a 560 nm light source to measure the fluorescence of a dye.

articleTitle: Simultaneous determination of size and refractive index of red blood cells by light scattering measurements
abstract: We present a fast Fourier transform-based approach for simultaneous determination of size and refractive index of a collection of red blood cells from the measured angular distribution of scattered light.

articleTitle: Green light generation by QPM SHG with Czochralski-grown stoichiometric lithium tantalate
abstract: Using periodically-poled stoichiometric lithium tantalate, peak power of 21.6 MW/cm/sup 2/ at 532 nm was achieved. A small temperature adjustment was required with 4.4 W SH power at room temperature due to its high thermal conductivity.

articleTitle: Stimulated-Raman-gain cavity-ringdown spectroscopy for high-resolution gas sensing
abstract: A novel form of high-resolution continuous-wave laser spectroscopy employs a cavity-ringdown technique to detect stimulated-Raman-gain effects. This is demonstrated by recording molecular rovibrational Raman spectra of methane gas.

articleTitle: Hot electrons in resonant-phonon terahertz quantum cascade lasers
abstract: The electronic temperatures of individual subbands, the lattice temperature and the population inversion both below and above the laser threshold of THz quantum cascade lasers are extracted by the analysis of interband /spl mu/-probe photoluminescence spectra.

articleTitle: Improved nonlinear active region designs for second-harmonic light generation in quantum cascade lasers
abstract: Nonlinear interaction of laser modes in quantum cascade lasers with novel integrated resonant nonlinear optical intersubband transition designs is discussed. Nonlinear active regions with high nonlinear susceptibility are used to produce second-harmonic generation light.

articleTitle: 1.3-/spl mu/m continuously-tunable fiber-coupled GaInNAs VCSEL
abstract: We report the single-mode operation of a fiber-coupled, tunable GaInNAs VCSEL operating at 1.3-/spl mu/m. Early results show that the device can be continuously tuned, at room temperature, over 14.5-nm with an output power up to 0.12-mW.

articleTitle: Visible-light-induced tenfold reduction of the electric field required for ferroelectric domain nucleation in MgO-doped lithium niobate
abstract: An order of magnitude reduction in the electric field required for ferroelectric domain nucleation is observed in MgO-doped lithium niobate crystals using focused visible light from an Ar-ion laser

articleTitle: Laser-assisted controlled micro-injection into living cells
abstract: A titanium-sapphire laser emitting 100 fs short laser pulses at 800 nm wavelength is employed to inject an impermeable dye into single living cells. The cell morphology remains intact after this process. A new method to analyze dye uptake and evaluate membrane integrity is suggested.

articleTitle: Fabrication of optical waveguides in phosphorus-doped flame hydrolysis silica by direct electron-beam exposure
abstract: The refractive index profiles of optical waveguides fabricated by electron-beam irradiation of phosphorus doped flame-hydrolysis deposited silica were studied by microreflectivity. The results were compared with those obtained for germanium-doped silica.

articleTitle: Unidirectional operation of quantum-dot ring lasers
abstract: First monolithically integrated ridge-waveguide InAs/InGaAs quantum-dot ring lasers are fabricated and characterized. Enhanced by a forward biased S-section waveguide, stable traveling-wave (unidirectional) operation with record suppression ratio of counterpropagating waves approaching 30 dB is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Widely tunable two-frequency Nd:YAG laser
abstract: We report on the experimental demonstration of a single-axis two-frequency Nd:YAG laser, in which the frequency difference is tunable from 11 GHz up to 120 GHz, thanks to a PLZT anisotropic electro-optically tunable etalon.

articleTitle: Ultra-wide spectrum quantum dot superluminescent diodes emitting at 1.3 /spl mu/m
abstract: Wide-spectrum, high-power quantum dot superluminescent diodes emitting at 1.3 /spl mu/m are demonstrated. A new reproducible way of broadening the gain spectrum is proposed leading to 120 nm spectral bandwidth. L-I, spectra and degrees of coherence are presented.

articleTitle: Stabilized two-center holographic recording in doped LiNbO/sub 3/ crystals
abstract: A congruently grown LiNbO/sub 3/:Fe:Mn crystal with high Fe concentrations is experimentally tested to show the improvement in M/# and sensitivity. Particularly, the variation of sensitivity versus recording and sensitizing intensities is investigated in detail.

articleTitle: 1.3 /spl mu/m GaInNAs bandgap difference confinement (BDC) optical amplifier
abstract: A GaInNAs BDC-SOA utilizing bandgap difference for current confinement was developed. Due to strong current and optical confinements in the lateral direction, gain and fiber coupling efficiency were significantly increased compared with a conventional GaInNAs-SOA.

articleTitle: Observations of exciton density of state variations in a ZnO thin film with fs pump-probe experiments
abstract: Variations of exciton density of state around the levels of donor-bound and free excitons in a ZnO thin film are observed with temperature- and photon energy-dependent degenerate fs pump-probe spectroscopy for exploring its exciton dynamics.

articleTitle: High resolution optical imaging of pre-cancer with structured illumination - an integrated approach
abstract: We present an integrated approach to optical imaging of oral and cervical pre-cancer using structured illumination by combining sine approximation image reconstruction algorithm and optically active molecular specific novel contrast agents.

articleTitle: Chirped-pulse cascaded quadratic compression of millijoule-energy, 35-fs pulses
abstract: A new concept - chirped-pulse cascade-compression - is proposed and demonstrated. Initial experiments agree with numerical simulations, including compression of 35 fs, 1.2 mJ-pulses to 20 fs. Scaling to higher pulse energies and compression ratios will be possible.

articleTitle: QPSK homodyne detection using a pilot carrier for multi-bit-per-symbol transmission
abstract: QPSK-homodyne detection using a polarization-multiplexed pilot-carrier in 2-bit/symbol transmission at 20 Gb/s was demonstrated. The proposed scheme provides a simple configuration for bandwidth efficient multi-bit-per-symbol homodyne detection without using an optical phase-locked loop.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of distributed traveling-wave photodetectors with polymer optical waveguide
abstract: We have proposed and demonstrated monolithic distributed MSM photodetectors with polymer optical waveguide. The responsivity of 0.45 A/W is achieved using leaky wave coupling from BCB polymer waveguide to MSM photodetector.

articleTitle: Slowing and stopping photons using cascaded parametric conversion in QPM waveguides
abstract: A new tunable scheme for slowing down and stopping light using the parametric processes in the phase shifted quasi-phase matched waveguides is proposed and its performance is evaluated.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of VCSELs with a horizontal waveguide grating coupler
abstract: A monolithic VCSEL structure with output coupling to an internal waveguide using integrated diffraction gratings was demonstrated. The horizontal waveguides can be used to route optical signals to other components for VCSEL-based photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Quantum efficiency of the cascade emission process in Pr/sup 3+/ doped YF/sup 3/
abstract: The emission quantum efficiency of the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>P0.1 levels of Pr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> under vacuum ultraviolet excitation was determined by comparing the photon fluxes of the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0 </sub>rarr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> emission around 400 nm with the emissions from the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>P0.1 levels

articleTitle: Spatial beam shaping of femtosecond laser pulses application to micromachining and photowriting
abstract: We present focal spot shaping of femtosecond pulses, using a programmable adaptive-optics device. Various shapes are obtained and their suitability for micromachining of metals or photowriting of waveguides in glass is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Buried linear extrinsic defects in colloidal photonic crystals
abstract: Photolithography combined with colloidal self-assembly enables linear defects to be embedded inside an opal film. Such defects can serve as templates for waveguides, and will allow colloidal PBG materials to be evaluated for integrated optics.

articleTitle: Ionic self-assembled multilayers adsorbed on long period fiber gratings for use as biosensors
abstract: We demonstrate that ionic self-assembled multilayers (ISAM) adsorbed on long period gratings (LPG) function effectively as biosensors. Theoretical simulations and experimental measurements confirm that ISAM-coated-LPGs provide a thermally-stable, reusable platform for building efficient optical sensors.

articleTitle: Computer generated holograms embedded in glass fabricated with a femtosecond laser
abstract: We report the design of three-dimensional computer-generated holograms. We fabricated holograms embedded in glass using femtosecond laser induced breakdown and showed three-dimensional effects to improve efficiency.

articleTitle: Chirp limitation on Mach-Zehnder interferometer ultrafast switching employing semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: We show for the first time that for a given switching pulse width, the maximum switching speed obtainable from a Mach-Zehnder interferometer employing semiconductor optical amplifiers is strongly dependent on the SOA chirp characteristics.

articleTitle: Widely tunable 2-micron-band difference frequency generation in direct-bonded quasi-phase-matched LiNbO/sub 3/ ridge waveguide
abstract: We fabricate direct-bonded quasi-phase-matched LiNbO/sub 3/ ridge waveguides for 2.3-micron-band difference frequency generation. A 100-nm bandwidth and a 100-%/W conversion efficiency are obtained for the first time using a 0.937-micron pump and a 1.55-micron-band signal.

articleTitle: Free space optical link by mechanically-active anti-reflection switch array and corner cube reflector
abstract: We demonstrate a laboratory free space optical link by a mechanically-active anti-reflection switch array and a corner cube reflector with a 40% modulation and a 5 kbit/sec data rate for 1.064 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Suppression of optical damage in second harmonic generation of Nd:YAG laser using cerium-doped KTP
abstract: 65% optical-to-optical conversion efficiency was achieved in second harmonic generation of a Nd:YAG laser using 9-ppm cerium-doped KTP. Optical damage was fully suppressed and output power was maintained with heating at 145 degrees Celcius.

articleTitle: Room temperature operation of resonant tunneling quantum dot infrared detectors
abstract: We present a novel tunnel quantum dot infrared photodetector which exhibit large photoresponse at 6/spl mu/m and 17/spl mu/m at 300K and ultra-low dark currents. Peak detectivity is 1.52/spl times/10/sup 7/ cm/spl middot/Hz/sup 1/2//W at 300K for 17/spl mu/m response.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical polarization spin switching in resonant photonic bandgap structures
Terahertz quantum cascade lasers
abstract: Based on a robust THz gain medium and low-loss waveguide structures, we have developed THz quantum-cascade lasers that operate up to 137 K in pulsed mode, 97 K in CW mode, and 141-/spl mu/m wavelength.

articleTitle: Coherent combining in an Yb doped double core fiber laser
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated coherent combining in an Yb doped double core fiber laser. More than 85% of the total output power is combined on the fundamental mode of one of the two cores. This efficient power combining is confirmed by the expected modulated spectrum of the emitted radiation. Finally, this combining method can be scaled with a good efficiency to a larger number of cores with a good efficiency leading to a high power single mode emission.

articleTitle: Photonic time-domain electromagnetic arbitrary waveform generation
abstract: We discuss experiments in which ultrafast optical pulse shaping technology is applied for generation of arbitrarily shaped, ultrawideband voltage waveforms in the range between a few GHz and /spl sim/1 THz.

articleTitle: Towards wafer-scale integration of high-repetition-rate passively mode-locked surface-emitting semiconductor lasers
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication of a key element for monolithic integration of mode-locked VECSELs, namely a quantum-dot-based SESAM with reduced saturation fluence, which allows stable mode locking with similar mode areas on gain and absorber.

articleTitle: Super-high power density, single mode 980nm pump lasers with weak temperature dependence
abstract: A super-high power density, 980 nm, single spatial mode pump laser is reported. The lasers show COD-free at 2000 mW and high characteristic temperature coefficient of 177 K in a wide temperature range of 25-85degC

articleTitle: Photonic crystal lasers with quantum dots active regions and their temperature dependence
abstract: Optically-pumped photonic crystal cavities with InAs quantum dots active regions lase near 1310 nm at room temperature. Absorbed threshold pump powers as low as 25 /spl mu/m, and a T/sub 0/ value of 17 K are obtained.

articleTitle: Multi-watt average power 388 nm UV generation through frequency quadrupling of Yb/Er fiber laser sources
abstract: The frequency quadrupling of up to 50 W average, 1.5 kW peak power Yb/Er single-mode, fibre oscillator/amplifier sources sequentially in periodically poled and bulk LBO crystals allows to achieve UV average powers of 3-10 W around 388 nm.

articleTitle: Broadband optical parametric amplification in the mid-infrared spectral region with periodically poled KTiOPO/sub 4/
abstract: Angle-tunable PPKTP OPA for signals between 1540 nm and 1720 nm was realized in a single periodicity QPM grating. The noncollinear OPA configuration increased the bandwidth from 2.4 THz to 6.9 THz.

articleTitle: Lasing in photonic crystals based on dye-doped holographic polymer-dispersed liquid crystal reflection gratings
abstract: This investigation describes an observation of lasing in photonic crystals (PCs) based on polymer-dispersed liquid crystal (PDLC) reflection gratings, which has a periodic structure of nano-sized (< 200 nm) LC droplets/ polymer in a film.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband near-infrared laser operation of Cr/sup 3+/ centers in chromium doped Li(In,Sc)GeO/sub 4/ olivines
abstract: Tunable laser operation of octahedral Cr/sup 3+/ centers has been demonstrated in LiInGeO/sub 4/ and LiScGeO/sub 4/ single crystals. Tuning range from 1150-1480 nm for LiInGeO/sub 4/ and 1220-1380 nm for LiScGeO/sub 4/ has been achieved.

articleTitle: Miniature fluorescent metabolometer
abstract: The authors describe a non-intrusive method for monitoring the fluorescent reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH) and the reduced flavin adenine dinucleotide (FADH2) fluorescence intensities. The ratio of the fluorescence intensities gives a measure of the oxidation-reduction (redox) state of the tissue. A yeast model has been established to calibrate the instrument.

articleTitle: Two-photon absorption and self-phase modulation measurements with shaped femtosecond laser pulses
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that phase sensitive detection of spectral hole refilling can yield information about self-phase modulation and two-photon absorption coefficients.

articleTitle: Direct determination of range extension due to phase conjugation in a soliton-based DPSK transmission system
abstract: We determine the range extension gained by the use of phase conjugation in a soliton-based optical differential phase-shift-keyed transmission system by comparing bit error ratios computed with importance sampling.

articleTitle: Structure-property relationship for three-photon absorbing fluorene derivatives: a systematic study
abstract: We report the first systematic three-photon absorption structure/property study on a series of three fluorene derivatives with different structural motifs. We demonstrate that symmetric intramolecular charge transfer enhances three-photon absorption on conjugated systems.

articleTitle: Double-clad photonic-crystal-fiber based scanning microscopy
abstract: We report the development of a novel double-clad photonic-crystal-fiber based multiphoton scanning microscope, which has a number of advantages over conventional scanning microscopes.

articleTitle: Dynamical thermal behavior and thermal self-stability of microcavities
abstract: Stability and continuous operation are important for almost any use of a microcavity, we demonstrate here experimentally and theoretically self-stable equilibrium solution for a pump-microcavity system; this mechanism is derived by the thermal nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal GaN light emitting diode
abstract: A photonic crystal GaN light emitting diode was designed and fabricated. An enhancement in the external quantum efficiency of approximately 30% for a device containing a photonic crystal hole patterns was obtained

articleTitle: Propagation-invariant and rotating vectorial Bessel beams by use of quantized Pancharatnam-Berry phase optical elements
abstract: Propagation-invariant and rotating vectorial Bessel beams are presented. The beams are achieved through discrete computer-generated space-variant subwavelength gratings. Propagation- invariant, controlled rotation of a propeller-shaped intensity patterns through simple rotation of a polarizer is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A statistical approach for detection and localization of a fluorescing mouse tumor in intralipid
abstract: A statistical approach is presented for detecting and localizing a fluorescing tumor obscured underneath millimeters of turbid medium. The method is validated in an experimental study using a mouse tumor and folate-iridocyanine dye.

articleTitle: High-power core-doped ceramic Nd:YAG laser
abstract: A composite ceramic Nd:YAG laser with a centrally doped region of 1.5mm in diameter in a 3 mm rod is presented. An output power of 144 W was achieved with an absorbed pump power of 226 W.

articleTitle: Advanced two-photon absorption devices for high speed switching and demultiplexing applications
abstract: We report the study of two-photon absorption in advanced quantum-confined devices. In preliminary experiments, a dynamic range of over 4 decades of signal intensity is observed for the TPA signal in InAs/InGaAs quantum confined devices.

articleTitle: Adiabatically compressed THz waveguides
abstract: We report adiabatically compressed parallel-plate copper waveguides for THz propagation with high throughput compared with straight waveguides of the same separation. This technique can be used for sensitivity enhancement of waveguide THz-TDS.

articleTitle: Development of a high-power light source for large-scale cryogenic gravitational wave telescope (LCGT)
abstract: A 100-W, single-frequency laser system for a Japanese gravitational wave detection project is being developed. We constructed a 121-W Nd:YAG laser and investigated injection locking with a 2-W master laser. Unidirectional oscillation of the ring laser in the fundamental transverse mode was demonstrated by using an intra-cavity Faraday rotator. The intensity noise of the unidirectional ring laser was suppressed to the same level with the linear cavity. The slave cavity below the oscillation threshold was locked by a 2-W master laser. The main difficulty in injection locking was the large fluctuation of the slave cavity. We are now investigating the mode matching in order to achieve injection locking of the high-power laser.

articleTitle: Coherent addition of Q-switched fiber lasers
abstract: We report on the pulse peak power rising of an actively Q-switched erbium doped fiber laser by using two coupled cavities with amplifying fibers in an interferometer configuration.

articleTitle: Self-oscillating millimeter-wave generation using reciprocating optical modulator
abstract: A reciprocating optical modulator (ROM) effectively generates harmonic components of modulation signal. We propose a novel optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) consisting of the ROM. By single-mode self-oscillating operation of the OEO, millimeter-wave-band radio-on-fiber signal is generated.

articleTitle: Absolute frequency measurement of an acetylene-stabilized laser at 1542 nm without carrier-envelope offset frequency control
abstract: Based on a mode-locked Ti:sapphire laser and sum-frequency generation, the absolute frequency of a 1542-nm acetylene-stabilized laser is measured without carrier-envelope offset frequency control. A difference-frequency generation comb at telecom region is also realized.

articleTitle: 980nm high power index-guided (phase) coherent parabolic bow-tie laser arrays
abstract: The theoretical and experimental characterisation of high power, coherent laser arrays are presented. Optical output powers in excess of 2.8 W/facet are achieved in a nearly-diffraction-limited beam, measured without lenses, corresponding to 275 MWcm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>srad<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> brightness

articleTitle: Vertically-coupled MEMS microdisks for tunable optical delays and dynamic dispersion compensation
abstract: Rapidly tunable chromatic dispersion is realized by vertically-coupled microdisk resonators with MEMS-actuated deformable waveguides. Group delays (27 to 65 ps) and dispersions (185 to 1200 ps/nm) are continuously tuned by voltage (<35 V)

articleTitle: Trimming silica planar lightwave circuits using deep ultraviolet ultrafast lasers
abstract: Trimming phase and birefringence errors in hydrogen-free Mach-Zehnder planar waveguide circuits have been demonstrated with a deep ultraviolet femtosecond laser (258nm, 150fs) achieving refractive index change of gt;3.8/spl times/10/sup -4/ and complete compensation of the intrinsic birefringence.

articleTitle: Time dynamics of low jitter single mode laser source for arbitrary repetition rates
abstract: A novel pulse seeding set-up is used to generate low jitter single mode laser pulses from a gain-switched Fabry-Perot laser at arbitrary low repetition rates. A timing jitter below 500 fs is obtained.

articleTitle: Spectral shearing interferometry applied to real time femtosecond pulse field reconstruction
abstract: Real time ultra-short pulse coherent characterization is experimentally demonstrated using a new configuration of spectral interferometry resolved in time (SPIRIT). Complex pulse reconstruction is studied numerically.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a thick holographic Stokesmeter
abstract: Using two sets of multiplexed thick-holographic gratings, we measured the Stokes parameters for three different polarization states of an input beam. These values compared well to values measured using the conventional quarter-wave plate/linear polarizer method.

articleTitle: Stabilization of nonlinear mirror mode-locking by inverse saturable absorber
abstract: Intra-cavity third harmonic generation is used to realize inverse saturable absorption required to suppress passive Q-switching instability in a nonlinear mirror mode-locked laser providing peak power of 918W with pulse width of 29ps.

articleTitle: Compact tunable 1.5 mJ/pulse mid-IR laser
abstract: A tunable OPO pumped by a Yb:YAG laser is reported. The idler output energy is 1.5-mJ/pulse. The energy conversion efficiency is 23.4% to idler at 6.4-mJ pump energy, corresponding to about 70% overall OPO efficiency.

articleTitle: Noninvasive multi-modality nonlinear imaging of heart development using transgenic zebrafish lines tagged with Hc-red fluorescence proteins
abstract: We generated zebrafish lines with two-photon red fluorescence expressed in the heart excited by 1230 nm light. With high penetration and high viability, heart development dynamics deep inside live embryos is noninvasively revealed in vivo.

articleTitle: Nonlinear multigrid inversion for optical diffusion tomography
abstract: A nonlinear multigrid inversion algorithm is presented for solving computationally demanding optimizations in optical diffusion tomography. Simulation results demonstrate the potential for large computational saving, better reconstruction quality, and robust convergence.

articleTitle: Highly efficient external coherent combining of 975 nm single mode laser diodes in a fully fiber integrated interferometric device
abstract: We proposed and demonstrated the coherent phase-locking of two single-mode laser diodes. The originality of the method consists in the use of an Michelson interferometer resonator which selects resonance frequencies leading to a coherent combining. A high power combining efficiency up to 85% has been measured. A high power combining efficiency up to 85% has been measured. This result could be improved by increasing the Q-factor of the laser diode cavities. This brings some novel perspectives for scaling the power of the single-mode laser sources at 975 nm which is of great interest for optical networks and high power devices.

articleTitle: Polarization-independent, frequency-detuning tolerant scheme for pulse rate multiplication using spectral elimination with a birefringence loop mirror filter
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous repetition rate multiplication of pulses at different wavelengths using the spectral elimination approach. With a polarization independent Sagnac comb filter, the unwanted spectral components have been suppressed by over 23 dB.

articleTitle: Absolute frequency measurement of rubidium 5S-7S two-photon transitions using a femtosecond laser comb
abstract: The absolute frequencies of rubidium 5S-7S two-photon transitions at 760 nm are measured to an accuracy of 20 kHz using an optical frequency comb. They serve as important optical frequency standards for telecommunication applications.

articleTitle: Fabrication of two-layer microphotonic structures without planarization
abstract: A novel nanofabrication scheme for two-layer microphotonic structures were proposed and applied to the fabrication of integrated, mode-evolution-based polarization splitters and rotators. Prototype devices demonstrated effective splitting and rotating of polarization with low cross-talk.

articleTitle: Dynamical spectral interferometry for measuring the nonlinear amplitude and phase response of saturable absorber mirrors
abstract: We demonstrate a novel combination of spectral interferometry and pump-probe measurements for determining the spectrally resolved nonlinear amplitude and phase response of saturable absorber mirrors. Measurements on single-quantum-well devices indicate a sub-mrad phase sensitivity.

articleTitle: Fluorescence optical imaging in turbid media using independent component analysis
abstract: An information theory approach for optical imaging of fluorescent inhomogeneities within turbid media using independent component analysis is outlined. Results for localization and characterization of fluorescent objects in turbid media from experiments are presented.

articleTitle: Efficiency and threshold analysis of resonantly diode-laser-pumped 1.6-/spl mu/m Er:YAG laser
abstract: Resonant diode pumping of the 1.6-/spl mu/m Er/sup 3+/(1%):YAG laser is reported with the absorbed photon conversion efficiency of 26%. Fluorescence study indicates that upconversion is a dominant mechanism affecting the solid-state laser threshold.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-insulator tunable waveguide-coupled microdisk resonators with selectively integrated p-i-n diodes
abstract: We report a design and analysis of compact silicon-on-insulator tunable waveguide-coupled microdisk resonators with selectively integrated p-i-n diodes. Our simulations suggest that singlemode resonances can be coupled and blueshifted by free-carrier plasma dispersion effect.

articleTitle: Generation of tunable picosecond MHz repetition rate mid-IR pulses by optical parametric amplification of white-light continuum in GaSe
abstract: The output of the high-repetition-rate all-solid-state picosecond oscillator is used for direct pumping of optical parametric amplifier seeded with the white-light continuum generated in optical fiber to generate tunable mid-IR radiation.

articleTitle: Characterization of dye-doped polymer films for polymer 1D photonic crystals
abstract: The incorporation of a nonlinear dye into a nanolayered polymer structure has the ability to greatly enhance the nonlinear transmission of the dye. Several characteristics of the nanolayered structured were studied to optimize the effect.

articleTitle: Two-photon absorption microscopy of tissue
abstract: Two-photon absorption microscopy (TPAM) has been demonstrated to be able to image melanin with high sensitivity. TPAM opens up a wide range of nonfluorescent molecular targets.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of transverse shift of the center of gravity of a reflected Laguerre-Gaussian light beam
abstract: We report experimental demonstration of transverse shift of reflected optical beams having non-zero orbital angular momentum. Possibility of using such shift for measurement of orbital angular momentum state of a single photon is discussed.

articleTitle: Colloid-based photonic crystal for dfb organic lasers and two-photon-induced polymerization for tunable DFB lasers
abstract: We propose two approaches for the fabrication of DFB lasers in photopolymerizable materials. The gratings are realized either by a periodic arrangement of nanospheres or through two-photon polymerization of a variable-step grating for tunable lasers

articleTitle: Femtosecond waveguide fabrication in bulk niobate (LiNbO/sub 3/)
abstract: We report fabrication of embedded waveguides supporting a well confined 1550 nm propagation mode in a z-cut lithium niobate crystal using focussed femtosecond pulses.

articleTitle: KY(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/:Yb/sup 3+/ planar waveguide laser
abstract: Continuous-wave waveguide lasing in a thin layer of monoclinic KY(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/:Yb/sup 3+/ grown by liquid-phase epitaxy is demonstrated at 1024 nm in the fundamental mode with 50% slope efficiency and 290 mW of output power.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional localization of several scattering targets in a turbid medium using independent component analysis
abstract: Three-dimensional localization of four scattering target in turbid medium was measured using multi-detector multi-source signal acquisition. A novel approach uses independent component analysis to generated lateral map intensity of the targets at the detector plane.

articleTitle: Fundamental mode in index-guided microstructured optical fibers: long wavelength properties
abstract: Using a novel computational method, the fundamental mode in index-guided microstructured optical fibers with genuinely infinite cladding is shown to have no cut-off, but its area grows rapidly when the wavelength crosses a transition region.

articleTitle: Coherent phase-locking of seven laser transmitters on a 408 meter outdoor range
abstract: We operate our laboratory-demonstrated coherent seven-sub-aperture transmitter on our 408 meter free-space range, and demonstrate phase-locking while simultaneously measuring turbulence. The received signal enhancement is near what is expected from analysis.

articleTitle: Mechanisms of refractive index changes in intensively pumped Yb-doped laser crystals
abstract: Mechanisms of refractive index changes in intensively pumped Yb-doped crystals (Yb:YAG and Yb:KYW) were studied using both a polarization interferometer and the transient grating method. The electronic component strongly predominated over thermal index changes.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all optical switching using pulse trapping by orthogonally polarized ultrashort soliton pulse
abstract: Pulse trapping by orthogonally polarized ultrashort soliton pulse in birefringent fiber is investigated both experimentally and numerically. Ultrafast all optical switching using pulse trapping in anomalous dispersion region is demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Observation of anomalously large band-filling effects in InAs/GaSb type-II superlattices: from 2-D to 3-D
abstract: We have demonstrated that type-II InAs/GaSb superlattices exhibit anomalously strong band-filling effects. By varying the width of the barrier or well, we have investigated the effects from 2-D quantum wells to quasi-3-D superlattices.

articleTitle: A compact 100 J/100 GW pump laser for broadband chirped pulse optical parametric amplifier
abstract: The described laser system comprises a Nd:YLF pulse-repetitive laser, a tabletop 100 J pulsed Nd:glass laser and a beam shaper. The system is synchronized with a femtosecond laser and used as pump of optical parametric amplifier.

articleTitle: Adaptive spinning-disk interferometry and the AO-quadrature class of bioCDs
abstract: Adaptive two-wave mixing is used to quantify index variations in transparent optical media including the phase variations and fluctuations arising from immobilized protein patterns on spinning disks.

articleTitle: Growth and characterization of SiGe layers on Ge-lattice-matched substrates by MBE for long wavelength optical devices
abstract: Fully-strained and high-quality Ge-rich SiGe films are grown on Ge-lattice-matched substrates by molecular beam epitaxy. Ge/SiGe quantum well structures are characterized by low-temperature photoluminescence and exhibit efficient quantum confinement and band edge emission.

articleTitle: An optical frequency standard with ultracold calcium atoms
abstract: We present latest results of an optical frequency standard with laser cooled calcium atoms. The current fractional uncertainly of 1.2/spl middot/10/sup -14/ makes this one of the most precisely known optical frequencies. Applications and further developments will be discussed.

articleTitle: All-optical 80 Gbit/s OTDM add-drop multiplexer using a single fiber-based nonlinear optical loop mirror
abstract: We demonstrate a novel scheme of the all-optical, high-speed OTDM add-drop multiplexer (ADM) using a single, fiber NOLM. The key point of this scheme is the simultaneous use of the reflection mode (add function) and the transmission mode (drop function) of the NOLM. Experimental results show that simultaneous add-drop operation at 80 Gbit/s is readily achieved.

articleTitle: Coherent semiconductor amplifier array
abstract: Fiber-coupled semiconductor amplifiers form a coherent laser array. We have demonstrated an architecture that maintains brightness when scaled to higher powers through phase and frequency self-locking of seven diodes

articleTitle: Mid-IR continuum from an optical parametric generator based on orientation-patterned GaAs (OP-GaAs)
abstract: We demonstrate 4.8-8.5-micron infrared continuum from an optical parametric generator (OPG) based on quasi-phasematched GaAs pumped by 1-ps pulses near 3.3 microns. The OPG pump threshold was about 100nJ and conversion efficiency greater than 10%.

articleTitle: MEFISTO: Measuring the electric field of ultrashort pulses by interferometric spectral trace observation
abstract: An analytical way to completely characterize ultrashort pulses is presented. This methodology is based on Fourier analysis of the frequency components of spectrally resolved interferometric autocorrelations. Experimental results are compared with the conventional SHG-FROG technique.

articleTitle: Generation of 2 keV, 30 fs electron pulses via surface plasmon waves
abstract: We report on the generation of 2 keV, 30-fs electron pulses using laser pulses from a multipass Ti:Sapphire amplifier. This work is complemented with test particle code based on the finite-difference time-domain method.

articleTitle: Widely tunable difference frequency generation in a multi-grating orientation-patterned GaAs
abstract: Difference frequency generation in a 17 mm long multi-grating orientation-patterned GaAs structure is demonstrated between 7.2 and 9.2 /spl mu/m. Wavelength tuning curve width of the idler wavelength agrees well with theory.

articleTitle: Simplified spectral phase interferometry for direct field reconstruction using a thick nonlinear crystal
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel implementation of spectral shearing interferometry for measuring the electric field of ultrashort pulses using asymmetric group velocity matching in a long nonlinear crystal.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of slitless spectrometer using spherical beam volume holograms
abstract: A new design for slitless spectrometers is proposed using spherical beam volume holograms. It is shown analytically and experimentally that the spectrometer works very well under spatially incoherent illumination.

articleTitle: Cr/sup 2+/:ZnSe laser pumped over Cr ionization transitions
abstract: Kinetics of Cr/sup 2+/:ZnSe photo-luminescence under UV, Visible and MIR pumping are studied. Cr/sup 2+/:ZnSe lasing using 532nm excitation is reported. Photo-conductance experiments verify (2+)/spl rarr/(1/sup +/)/spl rarr/(2/sup +/)/sup */ ionization transitions of chromium ions resulting in Cr/sup 2+/ excitation.

articleTitle: Compensation of phase distortions introduced by high objectives on sub-10 fs pulses
abstract: The ability of MIIPS to characterize and compensate for the high distortion experienced by a sub-10 fs laser beam passing through a high NA microscope objective is explored.

articleTitle: All-optical control of light using silicon nanophotonic devices
abstract: We present experimental demonstration of fast all-optical switching on silicon using highly light-confining structures. The transmission of the structures can be modulated by up to 94% with switching times of less than 500 ps.

articleTitle: Applying three- and four-order scattering of light in uniaxial crystals to an all-optical logic-based switching
abstract: A multi-order Bragg scattering of light with direct transitions between optical modes in uniaxial crystals is considered. The performed analysis has revealed optical nonlinearity governed by an external electronic signal. All-optical multi-bit registers are proposed.

articleTitle: A surface-emitting distributed-feedback dye laser fabricated by spin-coating organic polymers
abstract: A distributed-feedback dye laser was fabricated by use of alternate spin-coating of a high and a low refractive-index polymer. The laser was emitted from the surface of the dye-doped polymeric multilayer at the designed wavelength.

articleTitle: Dynamic visualization of mitochondria in cardiomyocytes with third harmonic generation microscopy
abstract: Dynamic visualization of mitochondria within cardiomyocytes using third harmonic generation microscopy reveals intensity fluctuations similar to those seen in fluorescence microscopy. These changes bring a photobleaching free method for physiological investigations of mitochondria in cardiomyocytes.

articleTitle: Multispectral multiphoton fluorescence lifetime imaging
abstract: We report the development and detailed calibration of a multispectral multiphoton fluorescence lifetime imaging system that is the combination of a streak camera, a prism spectrophotometer, a gradient index microlens array and an ultrafast laser.

articleTitle: Single mode (SMSR > 40 dB) proton-implanted photonic crystal vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
abstract: We have made proton-implanted photonic crystal vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (PhC-VCSELs) for fiber-optic applications. Single-mode (SMSR >40 dB) CW output power of over 1 mW, with a pulsed output power of exceeding 2 mW has been achieved in the 850 nm range.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of code translation in spectrally phase coded O-CDMA
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated reconfigurable all-optical code translation in a spectrally phase coded O-CDMA testbed with an interference user for both 1-stage and 2-stage code translations.

articleTitle: Polarization memory in the backscattering of light from a turbid medium
abstract: Time-resolved backscattering profiles of circularly and linearly polarized light were measured. The experimentally observed polarization memory effect is used to enhance the image contrast for a target inside large particle suspensions.

articleTitle: Ultra-high precision trace gas detection using difference-frequency generation sources
