abstract: We are describing the progress made towards a compact airborne ultra sensitive atmospheric trace gas sensor using fiber pumped difference frequency sources. A new miniature DFG source design and advanced spectroscopic detection scheme is presented enabling absorbance detection limits of 9E-7 for 100 seconds data acquisition time.

articleTitle: Two-photon fluorescence spectroscopy by resonant single and double grating waveguide structures
abstract: We show how resonant single and double grating-waveguide-structures enhance two-photon fluorescence more than two orders of magnitude without the need for a highly focused laser excitation light. Such resonant devices have an enormous potential for biosensing.

articleTitle: Antimonide semiconductor saturable absorber for mode locking of a 1.5-/spl mu/m Er:Yb:glass laser
abstract: We demonstrate the first antimonide (AlGaAsSb) semiconductor saturable absorber mirror (SESAM) based on InP and grown by MOVPE. We achieved self-starting and passive mode locking of an Er:Yb:glass laser at 1535 nm and 61 MHz.

articleTitle: Design principles for ultrafast thin-disk regenerative amplifiers without conventional stretcher
abstract: We present design principles for ultrafast Yb:KYW thin-disk amplifiers providing ultrashort pulses with high energies at high repetition rates. Without using a conventional stretcher, 10 /spl mu/J, 300 fs pulses were generated at 200 kHz repetition rate. Using the dispersive stretching of the pulses during amplification renders the effort of a complex chirped pulse amplification setup unnecessary.

articleTitle: Highly stable in-line semiconductor fiber laser
abstract: This paper reports the fabrication of a novel narrowband in-line semiconductor fiber-amplifier with 5dB gain at 847nm and discusses the possibilities for implementing such an amplifier in the core of a highly stable SM-fiber laser.

articleTitle: Optimizing two-wave mixing efficiency in photorefractive quantum wells by selective angle tuning
abstract: We observe that the two-wave mixing efficiency in photorefractive AlGaAs/GaAs quantum wells (PRQW) can be controlled by rotating the sample to go from Raman-Nath to the Bragg regime. This has applications in PRQWs like InGaAs/GaAs.

articleTitle: Exciton recycling in graded gap layer-by-layer semiconductor nanocrystal structures
abstract: A funnel like band gap profile is realized in a layer-by-layer assembled structure of CdTe nanocrystals. Recycling of trapped excitons leads to efficient energy transfer along the band gap gradient.

articleTitle: Optical system performance of large-scale photonic integrated circuits
abstract: Four monolithically integrated LS-PICs, each consisting often channels operating at 11.1 Gb/s, for an aggregate rate >400 Gbit/s, have been operated over long distance transmission systems. Performance data of the PICs and system will be presented.

articleTitle: Tunable dispersion compensator for 40-Gb/s optical transmission systems fabricated by reconstruction and equivalent chirp method
abstract: Variable chromatic dispersion in 40-Gb/s fiber system is compensated accurately by the FBG designed with reconstruction-equivalent-chirp method. High performance with tunable range of 175 ps/nm and group delay ripple about /spl plusmn/5 ps is reported.

articleTitle: Hyper-spectral imaging with volume holographic lenses
abstract: We present a hyper-spectral imaging system with volume holographic lenses. The Bragg selectivity of the volume holographic lenses enables the system to achieve high resolution in three spatial dimensions as well as the spectral dimension.

articleTitle: Ultra-sensitive second-harmonic generation frequency-resolved optical gating at 1.55 /spl mu/m by aperiodically poled lithium niobate waveguides
abstract: We report ultrashort pulse measurement by second-harmonic generation frequency-resolved optical gating with 124-aJ coupled pulse energy using aperiodically poled lithium niobate waveguides. The sensitivity (2.7 /spl times/ 10/sup -6/ mW/sup 2/) exceeds previous record by 5 orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Improving content-addressability in a holographic database using new input modulation schemes
abstract: We demonstrate a new modulation scheme for inputting datapages in content-addressable holographic memories. A modified 8:12 balanced-modulation code to address coding subtleties with phase-based schemes is introduced. This technique enhances discrimination capability while content-addressing.

articleTitle: Femtosecond electron diffraction: an atomic level view of condensed phase dynamics
abstract: We use femtosecond electron diffraction to capture the disordering of the solid and the emergence of liquid structure during strongly-driven laser melting. We discuss the impact of femtosecond pulse propagation on bright electron source design.

articleTitle: Acousto-optic femtosecond pulse shaping in the ultraviolet
abstract: A simple method for ultraviolet acousto-optic pulse shaping of spectral phase and amplitude is described. The technique eliminates complications associated with the parametric transfer of the spectral phase of near-infrared pulses through nonlinear processes.

articleTitle: Ultrafast nonlinear switching in a Al/sub 0.3/Ga/sub 0.7/As/AlO/sub x/ two-dimensional photonic crystal
abstract: Fast switching is demonstrated on a two dimensional Al/sub 0.3/Ga/sub 0.7/As photonic crystal slab around 1.5 /spl mu/m. An AlO/sub x/ slab ensures efficient heat sink. A 200% change in the reflectivity is obtained with a recovery time of 8 ps.

articleTitle: Fabrication of three-dimensional polymer photonic crystal by a single beam laser holographic lithography
abstract: In this report, by introducing a specially designed prism, we demonstrate the fabrication of 3-dimensional photonic crystals in polymeric photo-resist by laser holography lithography through a single beam.

articleTitle: Origins of backward second-harmonic-generation emission in a biological sample examined by laser scanning microscopes
abstract: We characterize the backward second-harmonic-generation (SHG) emission in biological samples with a SHG microscope. Contributions from different mechanisms, including direct backward emissions, reflection and back-scattering of the forward emissions, are identified and clarified.

articleTitle: Silicon double inversion of polymeric templates: a new route towards three-dimensional photonic bandgap materials
abstract: We present the successful silicon double inversion of direct laser written polymer templates for three-dimensional (3D) photonic crystals. Combined with plasma pre-treatment it allows for the fabrication of 3D photonic bandgap materials for telecommunication wavelengths.

articleTitle: Large-area surface-emitting "W" mid-IR photonic-crystal distributed-feedback lasers
abstract: Photonic-crystal distributed-feedback gratings are employed to produce vertical emission from very-large-area mid-IR "W" lasers. For a FWHM pump-spot diameter of 400-/spl mu/m, /spl ap/60% of the output is transmitted through a far-field aperture of diameter 1.8/spl deg/.

articleTitle: Efficient 1.3-/spl mu/m laser oscillation and heat generation characteristics in Nd:GdVO/sub 4/ laser under direct pumping into /sup 4/F/sub 3/2/ emitting level
abstract: We demonstrated a near quantum-limited slope efficiency in 1.3-mum cw Nd:GdVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser under a 879-nm (Ti:Sapphire laser) pumping. Large heat generation due to non-radiative decay in Nd:GdVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystal under non-lasing condition was discussed

articleTitle: Performance of a multi-user OCDMA system demonstrator with full clock and data recovery
abstract: We investigate the performance of a multi-user OCDMA system demonstrator with full CDR using a novel OCDMA receiver. We achieve sensitivities (BER<10/sup -10/, 2/sup 20/-1 PRBS) of -19.1, -16.3, and -9.2 dBm for 1-3 users.

articleTitle: Beyond the diffusing-wave spectroscopy model
abstract: We extend the theory of diffusing-wave spectroscopy using a random-walk approach and the radiative transfer equation. The transition between the transport regimes, observed experimentally, is well reproduced, increasing its potential for biological imaging.

articleTitle: Carriers-induced frequency chirp in 2D photonic crystals
abstract: We show that fast carrier dynamics can be extracted from spectral oscillations in femtosecond pump and probe on two dimensional photonic crystals.

articleTitle: A programmable on-chip ultrashort-pulse shaper using a micromachined actuator array and a chirped fiber Bragg grating
abstract: A compact on-chip ultrashort-pulse shaper is demonstrated using fiber gratings and micromachined electro-thermal actuators. Programmable arbitrary-waveform generation can be achieved in a large time window form /spl sim/10-ps to /spl sim/1-ns with femtosecond or picosecond optical pulses.

articleTitle: Quasi-white-light generation in optical superlattice using all-solid-state laser technique
abstract: A quasi-white laser was generated by frequency doubling and tripling a dual-wavelength Nd:YVO/sub 4/ laser, where an optical superlattice in a LiTaO/sub 3/ crystal was regard as a frequency converter for the generation of three-primary-color.

articleTitle: High power optical parametric chirped pulse amplifiers and their applications
abstract: High power optical parametric chirped pulse amplifiers at 1064 nm and 780 nm were demonstrated using LBO crystals pumped by synchronized frequency-doubled Nd:glass laser and Ti:sapphire laser. Some of their applications are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable, multimode 2-D organic photonic crystal lasers
abstract: Holographic polymerization of liquid crystal containing photopolymerizable resins enables one-step, rapid formation of multi-phase structures that exhibit partial photonic band gaps. These holographic polymer dispersed liquid crystals (H-PDLCs) provide a versatile platform for diffractive optical elements because the structures are not limited by multi-phase equilibrium but are controlled by the interference of multiple lasers at discrete angles. Incorporation of laser dyes into H-PDLCs form 1-D and 2-D optically pumped distributed feedback lasers. Linewidths as narrow as 1.8 nm are observed with laser thresholds below 1 mJ/cm/sub 2/ in 2-D columnar structures compared to 9 nm and 25 mJ/cm/sub 2/ exhibited by 1-D H-PDLC Bragg stack lasers. In the 2-D lattices the energy of the laser action can be tuned within the gain spectrum of the lasing medium by an applied electric field.

articleTitle: High sensitivity detection of laser ultrasound by photorefractive CdTe:Ti under an applied ac field
abstract: The performance of a laser ultrasound receiver based on two-wave mixing in titanium doped cadmium telluride crystals under an applied ac field is described. High sensitivity and fast response time is achieved using a low-power laser.

articleTitle: Integrated optical tweezers using arrayed waveguide grating
abstract: We propose and fabricate planar waveguide type optical tweezers that use arrayed waveguide gratings as waveguide lenses. We confirm in experiments that the proposed tweezers can manipulate several particles simultaneously without mechanical movable parts.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive nondegenerate four-wave mixing using circularly polarized pumps in twisted fiber
abstract: We demonstrate polarization-insensitive fiber four-wave mixing in the asymmetric configuration by using two circularly polarized pumps in a circular-birefringence fiber. By twisting a fiber at 15 turns/m, polarization sensitivity is reduced successfully to 0.9 dB.

articleTitle: Trace gas analysis in exhaled human breath for disease diagnosis
abstract: This paper reviews about the molecules that have been found in human breath whose biochemical pathways are known or whose biochemical pathways can be postulated and have been shown to be useful clinically.

articleTitle: 180-Gb/s clock recovery using a multi-section gaincoupled distributed feedback laser
abstract: 180-Gb/s all-optical clock recovery has been demonstrated by using a self-pulsing multi-section gain-coupled distributed feedback laser. This clock recovery scheme has a jitter less than 0.4 ps over a dynamic range of 7dB

articleTitle: Broad-band add multiplexer using novel complex gratings assisted coupler
abstract: Employing a novel single sideband spatial modulation of the complex refractive index, wavelength insensitive light power transfer from an "add" waveguide to a "through" waveguide is accomplished while completely disabling the inverse power transfer ("drop").

articleTitle: Cross resonant optical parametric oscillators: theoretical and experimental study in nanosecond regime
abstract: We investigate theoretically and experimentally a two-crystal optical parametric oscillator where signal and idler are outcoupled after the first and second crystal, respectively. Difference-frequency generation in GaAs slabs from the two beams is also reported.

articleTitle: Optical interconnects using optical far- and near-field interactions for high-density data broadcasting
abstract: Ultrahigh-density data-broadcasting optical interconnects are proposed and experimentally demonstrated using optical near-field interactions between quantum dots, which are forbidden for far-field light, allowing sub-wavelength device functions and far-field excitation for global interconnects.

articleTitle: Micro-lasers on a silicon chip: toward silicon photonics
abstract: Demonstration and performance of micro-lasers on a silicon micro-electronic chip are reviewed. These devices use the Raman and parametric nonlinearities of thermal silica grown on silicon and exhibit sub-100 micro Watt thresholds at high quantum efficiency.

articleTitle: Fluorescence spectroscopy of fiber gratings written with an ultrafast infrared laser and a phase mask
abstract: Confocal fluorescence microscopy was performed on gratings generated in all-silica core optical fiber with an ultrafast infrared laser and a phase mask. Upon excitation with 488 nm light a broad fluorescence centered at 650 nm is observed. The fluorescence intensity varies periodically with a 4.5 /spl mu/m pitch, in reasonable agreement with the 4.284 /spl mu/m grating pitch. The fluorescence is due to non-bridging oxygen hole center defects which are created by the ultrafast laser pulses during grating formation. The fluorescence from these defects photobleach within minutes upon continued excitation with low power cw 488 nm light. After photobleaching the grating structures are still visible with white light microscopy, indicating that an additional -non-bleachable-type of structural modification occurs during grating formation.

articleTitle: Prism based pulse shaper for direct phase manipulation
abstract: We present an efficient prism based pulse shaping scheme suited for octave spanning spectra. Pulse compression down to sub-5-fs was achieved and results for arbitrary pulse shapes with ultrahigh temporal resolution are shown.

articleTitle: A WIRNA receiver architecture based 16 GHz optical analog heterodyne FM link
abstract: We demonstrate a 16 GHz analog heterodyne FM link with pre-emphasis operating at 1540 nm wavelength, with a NF (noise figure) of (40/spl plusmn/1) dB and SFDR (spurious-free dynamic range) of (108/spl plusmn/2) dB-Hz/sup 2/3/, employing a WIRNA (wide-band rectifier narrow-band amplifier) receiver to reduce phase noise.

articleTitle: Internal omni-directional reflector using a low refractive index material for light-emitting diodes
abstract: A triple-layer omni-directional reflector (ODR), which consists of a semiconductor, a transparent quarter-wavelength dielectric layer, and a metal layer, has high reflectivity at all angles of incidence when used as an internal ODR. In this paper, triple-layer ODRs are demonstrated that incorporate nanoporous SiO/sub 2/, a new low-refractive-index (low-n) material with refractive index /spl Lt/1.46. Internal reflectivity measurements, including the angular dependence of R, are presented. The angle-integrated TE/TM-averaged reflectivity of the triple-layer reflector using nanoporous SiO/sub 2/ is 99.4 %. This is the highest ever reported averaged reflectivity for an internal ODR. The mirror loss of the triple-layer ODR is a factor of 7 lower than the mirror loss of conventional metal reflectors. The results indicate the great potential of the ODR for light-emitting diodes with high light-extraction efficiency.

articleTitle: Holographic fabrication of woodpile-type photonic crystals with phase mask techniques
abstract: Photonic crystals with tetragonal or cubic symmetry are fabricable by exposing photoresist SU-8 to interference patterns generated by phase masks. These crystals could have bandgaps up-to 27% of gap-center-frequency if made from silicon.

articleTitle: Raman fiber laser using spectrally shaped multi-wavelength fiber loop mirrors
abstract: A two Stokes fiber Raman laser was fabricated for the first time using only two fiber loop mirrors. The laser operates at 1475 nm, the second Stokes order of a P-doped fiber, when pumped at 1060 nm. The entrance loop acts as a pump injector as well as a high-reflector for both Stokes waves, while the exit loop is a high- reflector for the first Stokes wave and an output coupler of R=52% for the second one. The slope efficiency achieved was 12.4% for 600 m of P-doped fiber, with a threshold of 1.2 W for the second Stokes wave.

articleTitle: Feedback tolerance of injection-locked VCSELs
abstract: We demonstrate that injection locking of VCSELs improves the tolerance to optical feedback. Laser relative intensity noise characterization shows that the critical feedback level is increased with increasing injection ratio.

articleTitle: 3-D fabrication of microfluidic channels in fused silica using focused femtosecond laser beams
abstract: We demonstrate polarization dependence of the etch rate in femtosecond laser fabrication of 3-D microfluidic channels. We also show the existence of an energy threshold at which etching becomes highly selective.

articleTitle: FM mode-locking in monolithic semiconductor lasers
abstract: FM mode-locking in monolithic semiconductor lasers is investigated for the first time, using a travelling-wave laser model. The effects of phase modulation depth and non-zero alpha factor on pulse quality and pulse-width are discussed.

articleTitle: Wavelength selectable lasers with Bragg-wavelength detuned sampled-grating reflectors
abstract: Tunable laser arrays covering forty 50-GHz-spaced channels are realized with novel sampled grating reflectors. The grating design can realize lasers to cover different wavelength bands with simple fabrication and allows high-reflection coating to increase power.

articleTitle: Bioconjugated Au/Ag nanocages as a novel optical imaging contrast and thermal therapeutic agent
abstract: We have synthesized 40-nm Au/Ag nanocages and explored their use as an optical imaging/spectroscopy contrast agent and potentially a thermal therapeutic agent. Cancer cell specific targeting by antibody-conjugated nanocages has also been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Impact of pump-phase modulation on the performance of fiber-optic parametric amplifiers and wavelength convertors
abstract: We show that pump-phase modulation in dual-pump fiber-optic parametric amplifiers produces large signal fluctuations because of fiber dispersion. The performance becomes worse when phase is modulated using pseudorandom bit patterns with a sharp rise time.

articleTitle: Improved light extraction from LEDs utilizing nonplanar dielectric layers from shadow mask deposition
abstract: We demonstrate improved emission from LEDs and resonant-cavity LEDs (RC-LEDs) via shadow mask deposited nonplanar dielectric layers. We review the shadow mask deposition method, and present detailed studies comparing devices with and without such layers

articleTitle: Generation of THz transients with high electric-field
abstract: THz transients in the frequency range of 0.5 - 3 THz with electric field amplitudes of more than 100 kV/cm are generated by optical rectification in GaSe single crystals and measured by electro-optic sampling.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of L5 photonic band gap nanocavities for stimulated raman amplification in monolithic silicon
abstract: The concept, design and fabrication of L5 photonic crystal nanocavities for stimulated Raman amplification in monolithic silicon is suggested for the first time. Specific ultrahigh Q/Vm nanocavities are presented towards significant on-chip silicon Raman amplification

articleTitle: Generation of 356 W peak power from all-semiconductor master oscillator power amplifier (MOPA) system based on extreme chirped pulse amplification (X-CPA) concept
abstract: Based on the X-CPA concept, to authors' knowledge, we demonstrate the generation of a 356 W record peak power from all-semiconductor mode-locked MOPA system implemented with chirped fiber Bragg grating as an extreme pulse stretcher and compressor.

articleTitle: Fingerprinting molecules based on direct measurement of absorption spectrum by frequency-tuning monochromatic THz source
abstract: By measuring the absorption spectra of three families of the common chemicals in the vapor phase, we have demonstrated that THz absorption spectroscopy could be eventually used to fingerprint molecules.

articleTitle: 7 W average power second harmonic generation of quasi-CW Yb source in MgO-doped stoichiometric PPLT
abstract: Application of stoichiometric MgO:PPLT to single-pass, 57%-efficient, 7.05 W average-power SHG of a quasi-CW, single-mode Yb-doped fiber source is demonstrated. Peak-power-density control, reduced photorefraction and nonlinear absorption of sPPLT resulted in near diffraction-limited SH beam quality.

articleTitle: External coupling of molecular dye emission to high-Q microdisk resonators
abstract: We demonstrate the coupling of external emission from dye molecules to the cavity modes provided by a microdisk resonator utilizing a fast and simple fabrication method that combines semiconductor microprocessing with sol-gel supramolecular self-assembly chemistry.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope phase stabilization using single-pulse coherent control in a semiconductor
abstract: We demonstrate carrier-envelope phase stabilization of a mode-locked Ti:sapphire laser using the phase-dependent photocurrent that results from interfering single- and two-photon quantum pathways in low-temperature-grown gallium arsenide.

articleTitle: Single-mode Yb-doped fiber laser at 980 nm for efficient frequency-doubling
abstract: A single-mode Yb-doped fiber laser producing 1 W at 980 nm is demonstrated with a high conversion efficiency of 66%. A 58 mW power at 489 nm is reported by frequency-doubling in a ppLN waveguide.

articleTitle: Low jitter 1.55 /spl mu/m dual semiconductor laser system with electrical phase shifter for quick ultrafast measurements
abstract: We present a dual semiconductor laser system at telecom wavelengths generating pulses below 300 fs. The low-jitter temporal delay of up to 2 ns is achieved electrically by a phase shifter enabling pump-probe measurements within short time.

articleTitle: Novel fabrication techniques for the realisation of passive waveguide polarisation converters
abstract: Design, fabrication and characterisation of GaAs/AIGaAs passive polarisation converters realised through the use of three novel approaches is reported. The devices have been tested at /spl lambda/=0.9/spl mu/m and 1.3/spl mu/m, producing TE-TM conversion efficiencies up to 70%.

articleTitle: The effect of temperature on the efficiency of InGaAs and InGaAsN quantum well laser structures
abstract: We have measured gain and recombination in an InGaAs and an InGaAsN quantum well structure as a function of temperature. We find that the inclusion of nitrogen results in a reduction in the radiative efficiency.

articleTitle: Robustness of femtosecond direct written structures in silica glass
abstract: We demonstrate the extraordinary stability of femtosecond directly written structures to temperature increase. A temperature close to the glass transition is required to degrade birefringence properties and the related nanostructures.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal fibers: fundamentals to emerging applications
abstract: A review of the fundamental properties of photonic crystal fibers is presented. Special focus is held on the emerging fields of application within areas such as actively controlled fiber devices and high-power fiber lasers.

articleTitle: High power, very low noise and long term ageing 1.55 /spl mu/m InP-based Fabry-Perot quantum dash lasers under CW operation
abstract: Under continuous wave operation at room temperature, 50 mW per facet output power, -162 dB/Hz wide spectrum relative intensity noise and 6500 hours accelerated ageing with no failure of quantum dash Fabry-Perot lasers are presented.

articleTitle: Nearly quantum-efficiency limited oscillation of Yb:YAG laser at room temperature
abstract: Highly efficient 1031-nm cw laser oscillation of Yb:YAG crystal has been realized at room temperature with the slope efficiency of 140% and the optical-to-optical efficiency of 89% for the absorbed pump power

articleTitle: Micromechanical resonators with integrated optical waveguides for sensing applications
abstract: Low-power indium phosphide microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) cantilever resonators with integrated optical waveguides for bio-chemical sensing are presented. Resonant frequencies up to 168.8 kHz (Q=26.5) have been measured in air and mass detection of 510 fg/100 Hz is possible.

articleTitle: High-power near-diffraction-limited wavelength-beam-combined diode arrays
abstract: We have demonstrated wavelength beam combining of 100-element, 100-mum pitch slab-coupled optical waveguide laser (SCOWL) diode array with 35-W output peak power with M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup><1.35 in both directions in a single cavity

articleTitle: Spectral hole burning of acetylene gas inside a photonic bandgap optical fiber
abstract: We have observed saturated-absorption spectra of acetylene gas inside a photonic bandgap fiber. Significant signal sizes observed at low pump powers (<20 mW) indicate the utility of this technology for portable optical frequency references.

articleTitle: Bi-directional DPSK transmission of 16/spl times/10 Gb/s DWDM channels over 80 km SMF-28 using semiconductor optical amplifiers
abstract: The use of SOAs as in-line amplifiers in WDM systems leads to crosstalk as a result of cross-gain modulation. Constant intensity modulation format such as differential phase-shift-keying is in principle immune to XGM-induced crosstalk in SOAs. We report the reduction of crosstalk in a bi-directional system and successfully realize 16/spl times/10 Gb/s DWDM signals transmission over 80 km SMF-28 using DPSK modulation format for the first time.

articleTitle: 80 Gbit/s OTDM demultiplexer based on polarization rotation and XPM induced wavelength shift in a 1-m Bi/sub 2/O/sub 3/ nonlinear fiber
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the use of a only 1-m long Bi/sub 2/O/sub 3/ based nonlinear fiber with a nonlinearity /spl gamma/ of sim;1100 W/sup -1/km/sup -1/ within an all-fiberized 80 Gbit/s OTDM data demultiplexer based on polarization rotation and XPM induced wavelength shift. Error-free demultiplexing of all 8 channels is readily achieved.

articleTitle: High power amplification of solid-state Nd:YAG laser with short pulses of 300 ps/5 kHz
abstract: A double pass diode-pumped Nd:YAG rod laser pre-amplifier for EUV lithography has been demonstrated. An average output power as great as 81 W with excellent beam quality is available for injection pulse duration of 300 ps.

articleTitle: Stabilized frequency comb with a self-referenced femtosecond Cr:forsterite laser
abstract: The frequency comb of a Cr:forsterite femtosecond laser is stabilized using the f-to-2f self-referencing technique. The frequency noise of the comb components at 1064, 1314, and 1550 nm differs significantly from the noise of f/sub 0/.

articleTitle: Scaling up laser diode pumped mid-infrared fiber laser to 10-watt-level
abstract: The 10-Watt-level diode pumped erbium-doped ZBLAN fiber lasers at 2.7 /spl mu/m under different ways of pumping are studied and analyzed through numerical simulations. Experiments on a fiber laser with output power of 5.4 W are described.

articleTitle: Pump-probe scheme for optical coherence tomography using indocyanine green mixed with albumin or human plasma
abstract: Use of indocyanine green (ICG) in a pump-probe scheme for OCT is proposed. The study illustrates that ICG in protein solution shows unusual pump-probe imaging potential, indicating its usefulness as a contrast agent for OCT.

articleTitle: Phase-matched second harmonic generation at 1064 nm quaternary crystals of silver thiogermanogallate
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time to our knowledge, frequency doubling of 1064 nm radiation in sulphide crystals of Ag/sub x/Ga/sub x/Ge/sub 1-x/S/sub 2/ having engineerable birefringence and superior nonlinearity in comparison to oxide crystals.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical deflection of spatial solitons in Al/sub x/Ga/sub 1-x/As waveguides
abstract: Femtosecond laser pulses are used to generate and deflect spatial solitons in an AlGaAs slab waveguide; contributions to the deflection process from Kerr, carrier and thermal effects are identified.

articleTitle: Experimental and theoretical study of a 10 Gb/s multi-mode fiber link with connection offsets
abstract: We experimentally and theoretically investigate the effect of connection offsets in a 10 Gb/s multimode fiber link. To accurately model the experiments, we must take into account the evolution of individual modes within a single mode group.

articleTitle: Controlled mode interaction based wide-band and robust optical switching unit in silica-on-silicon
abstract: We present a novel wide band and robust planar lightwave circuit (PLC) switching unit having two switching states with low cross talk. The CMI based SU does not require post fabrication trimming and can be used as a normally dark VOA.

articleTitle: Photoionization of trapped carriers in avalanche photodiodes to reduce afterpulsing during Geiger-mode photon counting
abstract: We reduced the afterpulsing probability by a factor of five in a Geiger-mode photon-counting InGaAs avalanche photodiode by using sub-band-gap (/spl lambda/=1.95 /spl mu/m) laser diode illumination, which we believe photoionizes the trapped carriers.

articleTitle: Comprehensive statistical investigation of SCM-based transmission over 300 m of FDDI-grade multimode fiber
abstract: Rigorous statistical analysis is applied for the first time to identify optimal launch conditions and carrier frequencies for SCM transmission over worst-case MMF. The feasibility of multichannel schemes for 10 Gb/s over 300 m is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Design, fabrication, and characterization of a free spectral range doubled ring-resonator filter
abstract: Two-point coupling is used to double the free-spectral-range (FSR) of a ring-resonator filter. The filter, designed using rigorous electromagnetic simulations and fabricated using direct e-beam write, demonstrates 22 dB unwanted resonance suppression yielding an effective 40.8 nm FSR

articleTitle: Tapered high-fill photonic crystal fiber
abstract: We taper a 90% air-fill fraction, air core, photonic crystal fiber and observe a multitude of partial band gaps along the length of the taper. We simulate this geometry with the FDTD and plane wave expansion methods.

articleTitle: Direct chromatic dispersion determination of higher-order mode fibers using OLCR technique
abstract: Phase-sensitive optical low-coherence reflectometry is demonstrated to measure the chromatic dispersion value in short lengths of higher-order mode fibers. All spatial modes were simultaneously characterized from a single measurement without the use of spatial mode transformers.

articleTitle: Characterisation of systems for raman-assisted high-speed wavelength conversion
abstract: Raman-assisted wavelength conversion for ultra-high speed data is characterised in approaches: a novel scheme based on cross-phase modulation using specially designed notch filters and a 160 Gb/s experiment based on self-phase modulation

articleTitle: Sampling of optical waveforms using linear optics
abstract: The technique of linear optical sampling is reviewed. Samples of the electric field of an optical source are measured with high bandwidth and sensitivity using its interference with a train of sampling pulses.

articleTitle: Single mode performance of a single mode injection locked quantum dot laser
abstract: An injection locked QD laser is demonstrated to provide single longitudinal mode operation with a 40 dB SMSR and an improvement in RIN peak from 1.3-2.3 GHz. Alpha factor is measured to be 0.8.

articleTitle: Ten-fold improvement in the photoluminescence quantum efficiency of quantum-size-effect-tunable (1000-2000 nm) and solution-processed PbS nanocrystal films
abstract: PbS nanocrystals for infrared applications have previously shown to have very low photoluminescence quantum efficiency (/spl sim/ 1%) when solution-processed into the solid state. We show a ten-fold improvement through the use of polymer-nanocrystal composites.

articleTitle: Control and manipulation of femtosecond laser filaments by the use of vortex phase elements
abstract: Diffractive optical elements, vortex phase plates of varying charge, were used as an effective method to control single and multi-filament propagation of femtosecond pulses in air. Application to few-cycle pulse generation is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A quantum cascade laser sensor for SO/sub 2/ and SO/sub 3/
abstract: A dual room temperature QCL-based direct absorption spectrometer independently measures SO/sub 2/ and SO/sub 3/ to a precision of 1 to 2 ppmv-m/Hz/sup -1/2/ at a data rate of 100 Hz.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband THz wave detection beyond 80 THz using photoconductive antenna
abstract: Detection limit of photoconductive antenna in mid-infrared region was investigated using ultrabroadband THz wave generated with a GaSe crystal. We found that antenna technique has potential for detection of higher frequency region beyond 80 THz.

articleTitle: Applications of time-resolved fluorescence spectroscopy to atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and brain tumors diagnosis
abstract: This paper presents the development of an apparatus and associated practical methodologies for time-resolved laser-induced fluorescence spectroscopy (TR-LIFS) of tissues that account for clinical needs and overcome some of the barriers that have limited its implementations in clinical settings. These include rapid fluorescence data acquisition with high temporal resolution and sensitivity within a broad range of emission wavelengths; rapid data processing, analysis and display; and compact and portable instrumentation.

articleTitle: In-band OSNR monitoring using cascaded four-wave mixing in a fibre optical parametric amplifier
abstract: We present an in-band optical signal to noise ratio monitor using an optical parametric amplifier. The device creates a new wave with an average output power dependent on the optical signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration and theoretical analysis of slow light in a semiconductor waveguide at GHz frequencies
abstract: Experimental demonstration and theoretical analysis of slow light in a semiconductor waveguide at GHz frequencies slow-down of light by a factor of two in a semiconductor waveguide at room temperature with a bandwidth of 16.7 GHz using the effect of coherent pulsations of the carrier density. The achievable delay is shown to be limited by the short lifetime. The maximum time delay observed reflects an approximately two-fold increase of the group refractive index, corresponding to a time delay of approximately 20 % of the carrier (population) lifetime. The experimental observations are well-explained by a model accounting for the absorption saturation in the waveguide, when using a lifetime that depends on the reverse bias.

articleTitle: Frequency comb dynamics of a solitonic fiber laser: theory
abstract: The effects of Raman scattering, self-steepening, and higher-order dispersion on a fiber-laser frequency comb are analyzed using perturbation theory. Transfer functions are derived for the comb response to change in cavity length or pump power.

articleTitle: The physics and limits of femtosecond laser micromachining
abstract: Laser-induced optical breakdown by femtosecond pulses is extraordinarily precise when the energy is near threshold. We examine the limits of femtosecond machining through studies of damage induced by tightly focused pulses in a variety of materials.

articleTitle: Red organic light-emitting diode with non-doping DCM as emitter
abstract: A new kind of non-doping red OLED was fabricated, using partially conjugated PPV as hole-transport material and non-doping DCM as emitter. The new OLED shows good performance of pure red luminescence

articleTitle: A nanophotonic NOT-gate using near-field optically coupled quantum dots
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, operation of a nanometric (20 nm) optical NOT-gate using quantum dots coupled by an optical near-field interaction. We propose that the complete set of logic gates can be realized.

articleTitle: Quasi-phase matched difference-frequency generator with adhered ridge waveguide fabricated by dry etching method
abstract: We demonstrate 13 mm-long quasi-phase-matched difference-frequency generation device with adhered ridge waveguides fabricated by ECR-RIE dry etching method in periodically poled Zn:LN. The obtained SHG normalized conversion efficiency was 260%/Wcm/sup 2/ in the telecommunication band.

articleTitle: 1.5/spl mu/m photon-counting optical time domain reflectometry with a single-photon detector using up-conversion in a PPLN waveguide
abstract: A 1.5 /spl mu/m single-photon detector, which combines up-conversion in a PPLN waveguide with a silicon avalanche photodiode, is used to demonstrate photon-counting OTDR. The system exhibits good sensitivity, high spatial resolution and small measurement time.

articleTitle: 195 W injection-locked single-frequency laser system
abstract: In this paper a high-power ring resonator is presented with four end-pumped laser heads injection-locked via an intermediate 12 W laser to a single frequency NPRO. With this setup a linearly polarized, single-frequency, fundamental mode output power of 195 W was demonstrated. This is the first time that injection-locking for a high power laser was highest injection-locked single-frequency output power.

articleTitle: Threshold and spectral characteristics of quantum dot lasers fabricated by selective area epitaxy
abstract: The threshold and spectral characteristics of patterned quantum dot lasers fabricated by selective area MOCVD crystal growth are presented Full three-dimensional confinement of carriers in an engineered quantum structure is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Extended bandwidth cw-pumped infrared supercontinuum generation in low water-loss PCF
abstract: Extension of continuous-wave-pumped supercontinuum generation beyond 1380 nm is demonstrated in a PCF with 6-fold reduced water-peak absorption around this wavelength. Extended bandwidth sources with Yb-fiber CW pumps can be employed for advanced, sub-micron resolution OCT.

articleTitle: Widely tunable narrow-linewidth nanosecond optical parametric generator with self-injection seeding
abstract: We report a widely tunable narrow-linewidth nanosecond optical parametric generator (OPG). For self-injection seeding a small fraction of the OPG output is spectrally filtered and, after delay in a fiber, superimposed with the succeeding pump-pulse.

articleTitle: Fiber optic two-photon fluorescence microendoscopy: towards brain imaging in freely moving mice
abstract: We introduce a compact and lightweight (3.7 g) two-photon fluorescence microendoscope, which is based on a flexible photonic bandgap fiber and a DC micromotor, and which is designed for brain imaging in freely moving mice.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive amplification produced by degenerate four-wave mixing in a fiber
abstract: Degenerate scalar and vector four-wave mixing produce phase-sensitive amplification in a fiber. The quantum-mechanical properties of these schemes are described, and formulas for the field-quadrature and photon-number variances are derived.

articleTitle: Yb:NaGd(WO/sub 4/)/sub 2/ tunable solid-state laser operation with Ti:sapphire and diode laser pumping
abstract: Room temperature laser operation near 1030 nm of Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> in the disordered crystal NaGd(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with slope efficiencies exceeding 30%, output powers more than 300 mW, and tuning from 1016 to 1049 nm are demonstrated

articleTitle: Reconfigurable wavelength-selective reflector consisting of coupled polymeric microring resonators
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel reconfigurable wavelength-selective reflector for planar lightwave technology based on coupled microring resonators. Narrow-band reflection and strong side-lobe suppression are demonstrated in an optical polymer device using the Vernier effect

articleTitle: Fast and efficient light intensity modulation in SOI with gate-all-around transistor phase modulator
abstract: We report fast modulation (>30 GHz) in a SOI resonant cavity using integrated Bragg mirrors and a gate-all-around transistor as active element. Modulation depth >90% can be obtained in 12.5 /spl mu/m long devices.

articleTitle: High performance hybrid EDFA-FOPA pre-amplifier for 40 Gb/s transmission
abstract: We demonstrated a novel application of a FOPA, i.e. the operation of a hybrid pre-amplifier built with a single-pump FOPA as a second stage of an EDFA pre-amplifier and its application on a 40-Gb/s system.

articleTitle: 946-nm Nd:YAG laser under ground-state direct diode-pumping at 869 nm
abstract: We have demonstrated, what we believe is for the first time, direct diode-pumping at 869 nm into the emitting level of a quasi-three-level Nd:YAG laser operating at 946 nm

articleTitle: Matched photonic bandgap fiber and fiber Bragg grating dispersion for a totally in-fiber stretch pulse amplification system
abstract: By matching the linear and cubic dispersion terms of photonic bandgap fiber, using a crafted chirped fiber Bragg grating, linear stretch pulse amplification to nearly ideal compression is achieved in an all fiber system.

articleTitle: Metallo-dielectric photonic crystals for reproducible surface-enhanced Raman substrates
abstract: Planar photonic crystals comprised of metals and dielectrics show huge enhancements in the surface-enhanced Raman scattering of attached molecules. Plasmon engineering is key to these properties including reproducibility (std.dev.<9%), beamed output, resonances and orientation.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of electronic and electro-optical devices exploiting the AlGaN/GaN-LiNbO/sub 3/ material system
abstract: The development of the monolithic integration of AlGaN/GaN FETs with LiNbO/sub 3/ structures for optical signal processing is presented. Wc also present new III-nitride material growth details and electronic device performance.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of waveguide-coupled hexagonal micropillar resonators with round-corners in silicon nitride
abstract: We report laterally waveguide-coupled hexagonal micropillar resonators with designed round-corners in silicon nitride. Our experiments reveal highly efficient coupled nearly singlemode resonances in a large-sized micropillar with an optimized round-corner radius

articleTitle: Generation of 8-12 /spl mu/m radiation by self-difference frequency mixing in Cr:ZnSe
abstract: We present what we believe to be the first results on mid-infrared generation, by self-difference frequency generation, in Fresnel birefringence quasi-phase matched Cr:ZnSe laser slabs.

articleTitle: Extremely thin, single-crystal films of LiNbO/sub 3/ fabricated using localized He+ ion-implantation
abstract: We demonstrate that extremely thin, i.e., /spl sim/2-3/spl mu/m, single-crystal films of LiNbO/sub 3/ can be formed on a wafer using patterned ion-implantation followed by chemical etching. Control of the membrane thickness and its waveguiding properties are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Dispersion management for microscope objectives
abstract: We demonstrated experimentally that the dispersion of a Zeiss 40/spl times/ /1.2 Achroplan objective can be compensated by means of chirped mirrors over a bandwidth of 170 nm at 800 nm. The interferometric autocorrelation trace recorded at the focus of the microscope objective with a two-photon diode indicated a pulse duration of <14 fs.

articleTitle: Coupled cavity phenomena within MEMS-tunable long-wavelength VCSELs
abstract: We present a tunable VCSEL emitting around 1.55 /spl mu/m with a maximum tuning range of 43 nm. To investigate the effects of coupled cavities within such a structure, simulations have been performed and compared to experimental results.

articleTitle: High-intensity THz radiation from a scalable large-aperture emitter
abstract: Using a novel metal-semiconductor-metal (MSM) structure, we combine a large-active-emitter volume with strong electric fields for carrier acceleration. We obtain THz field amplitudes of 6 kV/cm using excitation pulse energies of 10 /spl mu/J.

articleTitle: Ultrasound detection using polymer microring resonators
abstract: High Q-factor polymer microring resonators were experimentally demonstrated in ultrasound detection. They have sensitivity as high as 3/spl times/10/sup -3/ kP/sub a//sup -1/. We propose a method to form multi-element ultrasonic arrays for imaging applications.

articleTitle: Fluidic photonic integrated circuit (FPIC) cytometric detection
abstract: We present a fluidic photonic integrated circuit (FPIC) performing the detection function for flow cytometry. An array waveguide design was chosen to achieve superb sensitivity and the time-of-flight measurement for each particle flowing by.

articleTitle: Broadly tunable, synchronously pumped OPOs in the fs- and ps- time regime with novel tuning regime
abstract: Here we demonstrate fixed frequency, synchronously pumped, broadly tuneable optical parametric oscillators in the fs- and ps- time regime on the basis of periodically poled crystals. Up to 500 nm tuning can be achieved in the NIR with fixed pump frequency and a single optics set. The key feature is a novel optics set up for tuning synchronously pumped broadband resonators. The use of a ring resonator for intra cavity SHG generation leads to highly efficient generation of pulses in the VIS range. Automated tuning makes it an ideal tool for MPE- and SHG microscopy.

articleTitle: Sub-micron thin films of lithium niobate single crystals prepared by crystal ion slicing and wafer bonding
abstract: Sub-micron thin films of single crystal lithium niobate are prepared by ion implantation and wafer bonding. The thin film exhibit high crystalline quality and have identical optical and electro-optical properties to bulk single crystals

articleTitle: Polarization-based identification of bulk contributions in surface nonlinear optics
abstract: Bulk and surface contributions to the second-order nonlinearity of isotropic surfaces are unambiguously identified by polarization measurements. Measurements on an air-glass interface reveal that the bulk contributions dominate in transmission but are negligible in reflection.

articleTitle: A novel TDM method for serrodyne modulation with high sideband suppression for arbitrary waveform generation
abstract: A novel TDM approach has been incorporated with serrodyning to shift the frequency of an arbitrary carrier up to /spl plusmn/1 MHz with highest sideband suppression ever reported. This technique also realizes endless phase modulation.

articleTitle: Microjoule femtosecond laser pulses from a cavity dumped Yb:KYW oscillator
abstract: Pulses with energies of 1 /spl mu/J are obtained from an electro-optically cavity-dumped diode-pumped femtosecond Yb:KYW oscillator at a repetition frequency of 1 MHz, making this device a powerful laser source for nonlinear experiments.

articleTitle: Nearly quantum-limited noise performance of passively mode-locked 10-GHz Er:Yb:glass lasers
abstract: The repetition phase noise and carrier phase noise of a passively mode-locked Er:Yb:Glass laser has been investigated. A nearly quantum-limited noise performance was found at high Fourier frequencies where technical noise contributions are negligible.

articleTitle: Investigations of fiber Kerr switch: nonlinear phase shift measurements and optical time-division demultiplexing of 320 Gbit/s DPSK signals
abstract: We investigated the cross-phase modulation (XPM) induced phase shift in a highly nonlinear fiber using a Kerr-switch configuration. The switch was tested as demultiplexer of RZ-DPSK data signals up to 320 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: LiInSe/sub 2/ nanosecond optical parametric oscillator
abstract: We report for the first time Nd:YAG laser pumped nanosecond optical parametric oscillation in the mid-infrared chalcogenide crystal LiInSe/sub 2/ with signal and idler tunable between 1.49 and 1.57 /spl mu/m, and 3.3 and 3.72 /spl mu/m, respectively.

articleTitle: Quantitative study of the performance statistics of WDM systems under different channel spacings
abstract: We show that: fiber drift contributes noticeably to the performance fluctuations of a typical terrestrial WDM system; diminishing channel spacing decreases polarization-dependent loss-induced performance fluctuations, but it can be offset by inter-channel crosstalk.

articleTitle: Highly-efficient optical sampling based on two-photon absorption in a semiconductor micro-cavity device
abstract: We demonstrate a highly-efficient optical sampling system based upon the nonlinear process of two-photon absorption in a specially designed semiconductor microcavity. The sensitivity of the system is around 0.1 mW/sup 2/ and the temporal resolution is 2 ps.

articleTitle: Stable modelocked operation from a quantum-dot laser in a broad temperature range
abstract: We demonstrate stable modelocking operation in a two-section quantum-dot laser at temperatures ranging from 20/spl deg/C to 80/spl deg/C. The level of reverse bias, from which stable mode locking exists, was found to be lower for higher temperature.

articleTitle: New Yb:Hf-doped silica fiber for high-power fiber lasers
abstract: We report an efficient cladding-pumped Yb-doped HfO/sub 2/-SiO/sub 2/ fiber laser that generated 122 W of continuous-wave output power at 1.08 /spl mu/m with a slope efficiency of 74% with respect to the absorbed pump power.

articleTitle: Mitigating laser damage in glasses and crystals, using pulsetrain-burst (<100 MHz) ultrafast laser processing
abstract: Damage to optics caused by lasers may be mitigated by material-processing with ultrafast lasers. Ultrahigh (<100 MHz) repetition-rate pulsetrains afford special control of residual heat. We describe studies in fused silica and crystals.

articleTitle: Air-hole collapse and mode transitions in microstructured fiber photonic wires
abstract: We demonstrate robust low-bend loss microstructured fiber photonic wires, which posses a transition from an embedded regime, insensitive to the surroundings, into an evanescent sensing regime, through controlled air-hole collapse.

articleTitle: Q-switched laser operation of 8% ceramic Nd:YAG
abstract: We report what we believe to be the first demonstration of Q-switched, diode-pumped lasing from highly concentrated (8%) ceramic Nd:YAG. Fluorescence kinetics and laser experiments indicate the material's potential for high repetition rate operation.

articleTitle: All-solid-state, compact, and coherent blue source producing 118 mW at 440 nm by intracavity-frequency-tripling Nd:YAG laser beam
abstract: Coherent blue light is efficiently generated based on a novel scheme, i.e. intracavity frequency tripling by using partly-periodically-poled KTiOPO/sub 4/. An average power of 118 mW for the blue light is produced for a 10-W pump.

articleTitle: InGaAs-AlAsSb quantum cascade lasers emitting at 4.4 /spl mu/m
abstract: We report the first realization of In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.53</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.47 </sub>As/AlAs<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.56</sub>Sb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.44</sub> quantum cascade lasers grown on InP substrates. Stable optical and electrical characteristics as well as good structural quality of epitaxial layers demonstrate the significant potential of this system

articleTitle: S-, C- and L-band continuously tunable fiber laser using thulium- and erbium-doped fibers
abstract: A hybrid-cavity fiber laser using thulium-doped fluoride fiber and erbium-doped fiber presents a narrow linewidth that can be continuously tuned in the S, C and L bands, from 1445 nm to 1590 nm.

articleTitle: Threshold-reduced compact terahertz-wave parametric oscillator
abstract: We demonstrated a threshold-reduced compact terahertz-wave parametric oscillator, which uses high performance mirrors. It achieved threshold intensity reduction of 23%. We obtained THz-wave radiation in the range of 0.96 to 3 THz, thereby enhancing the output energy.

articleTitle: High-average-power visible generation in periodically-poled nearly-stoichiometric lithium tantalate
abstract: Sum-frequency generation has been used to generate more than 12 W of average power at 589 nm in a single pass through a crystal of periodically-poled, undoped, nearly-stoichiometric lithium tantalate.

articleTitle: 3D periodic nano-structures in glass irradiated by ultrashort light pulses
abstract: Three-dimensional periodic nano-structures are observed in silica glass irradiated by intense femtosecond laser pulses. The structures could present the first evidence of nano-vortex formation in electron laser plasma.

articleTitle: A 70-mm-long periodically-poled Mg doped stoichiometric LiNbO/sub 3/ for low-threshold optical parametric generation
abstract: We report a 70-mm-long periodically-poled 1-mol% Mg-doped stoichiometric LiNbO/sub 3/ for optical parametric generation. Low bulk OPG threshold of 127 m W (19 /spl mu/J) and slope efficiency of 41% were obtained with microchip-laser pumping.

articleTitle: Novel metal-defined electro-optic polymer phase modulator
abstract: We demonstrate novel metal-defined electro-optic polymer modulators for the first time. Phase modulators fabricated using this technique have a driving voltage of 5.6 V and an extinction ratio of /spl sim/18 dB at 1.55 /spl mu/m wavelength. This approach is a promising fabrication technique alternative for passive and EO polymer devices.

articleTitle: 120-W short-length rod-type photonic crystal fiber laser
abstract: We report on a novel ytterbium-doped fiber design which combines the advantages of rod and fiber gain media. 120 W output power in single-mode beam quality are obtained from a 48 cm long fiber cane.

articleTitle: All fiber integrated, kilowatt level, subpicosecond chirped pulse ytterbium amplification system using an aircore photonic bandgap fiber
abstract: All fiber integrated chirped pulse amplification at 1.06 mum using an aircore photonic bandgap fiber is demonstrated. The system output pulses have a peak power of 2.3 kW and duration of 740 fs

articleTitle: Short-tenn spectrl stabilit of super-continuum source using noise-like pulses generated from an EDF laser
abstract: We experimentally investigate shot-term spectral stability of supercontinuum sources. We show that a supercontinuum source using noise-like pulses generated from an EDF fiber laser achieves excellent stability within plusmn0.05dB in the almost entire wavelength range

articleTitle: High resolution spectroscopy with a femtosecond laser frequency comb
abstract: The output of a mode-locked femtosecond-laser is used for high resolution spectroscopy of Cs in an atomic beam. The laser is referenced directly to a stable RF signal from the NIST time-scale. By changing the laser's repetition rate, the Cs D/sub 1/ and D/sub 2/ transitions are detected with high resolution.

articleTitle: A novel detection scheme for THz waves based on upconversion at room temperature
abstract: We have implemented a new scheme for detecting THz waves based on upconversion. This scheme allows us to measure the peak power, wavelength, linewidth, and pulse width of a THz wave at room temperature.

articleTitle: Materials for GHz, sub-1 Volt electro-optic modulation
abstract: Factors that define the electro-optic activity and bandwidth of organic materials are discussed as are auxiliary properties of optical loss, thermal stability, and photostability. The unique processing advantages of organic materials are reviewed.

articleTitle: An electronically tunable ultrafast laser source applied to fluorescence imaging and fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy
abstract: We demonstrate that spectral selection from a supercontinuum generated in a microstructured fibre can provide a continuously electronically tunable ultrafast spatially coherent source for confocal microscopy and both scanning and wide field fluorescence lifetime imaging.

articleTitle: High-average-power picosecond drive source for photocathode injectors
abstract: We report a diode-pumped, Nd:YVO/sub 4/, picosecond MOPA system based on passively mode-locked oscillator enabled by SESAM/spl reg/ technology that produces >20 W of average power at 532 nm.

articleTitle: Supermode suppression of harmonically modelocked slab coupled optical waveguide amplifier ring laser
abstract: We report the first harmonic modelocking of a slab coupled optical waveguide amplifier (SCOWA) generating 7.5 mW without external amplification. A novel concept of supermode suppression utilizing the SCOWA itself as an intracavity etalon was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low-noise, high-energy, single-mode, femtosecond fiber laser system
abstract: Truly single-mode amplification of femtosecond pulses from a fiber oscillator to /spl sim/100 nJ is demonstrated. Amplitude and phase noise characterization of the source and its robustness demonstrates its potential for many applications.

articleTitle: Near-field sensor using photonic crystal slabs
abstract: We introduce a novel displacement sensing mechanism using photonic crystal slabs coupled in the near-field regime. The characteristics are completely different from conventional Fabry-Perot sensors, and high sensitivity can be obtained without using high-reflectivity mirrors.

articleTitle: Asynchronous optical sampling for high-speed characterization of integrated THz resonator arrays
abstract: Two femtosecond lasers with slightly differing repetition rates near 1 GHz are employed in an asynchronous optical sampling technique for high-speed characterization of integrated THz resonators. Delay scanning at kilohertz frequencies paves way for high-throughput analytics.

articleTitle: Modulational instabilities in normal dispersion regime leading to white-light supercontinuum generation
abstract: We report on modulational instability process in large normal dispersion regime leading to supercontinuum generation at visible wavelengths (350-700 nm) in air-silica microstructured optical fibers.
